CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_phms_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (
    id,
    display_name,
    avatar_url,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(
      new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'display_name',
      new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name',
      new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'name'
    ),
    coalesce(
      new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'avatar_url',
      new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'picture'
    ),
    now(),
    now()
  )
  on conflict (id) do nothing;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase06_capture_emergency_snapshot(p_person_id uuid, p_requested_by uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_id uuid;
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.persons WHERE id=p_person_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'person not found'; END IF;
 INSERT INTO public.medication_emergency_snapshots(person_id,requested_by,payload,source_record_ids)
 SELECT p_person_id,p_requested_by,
 jsonb_build_object('generated_at',now(),'emergency_profile', (SELECT to_jsonb(ep) FROM public.medication_emergency_summary_v ep WHERE ep.person_id=p_person_id LIMIT 1),
 'medications',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cm)) FROM public.medication_current_list_v cm WHERE cm.person_id=p_person_id),'[]'::jsonb),
 'allergies',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'allergen',a.allergen,'reaction',a.reaction,'severity',a.severity,'verification',a.verified_status)) FROM public.allergies a WHERE a.person_id=p_person_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL),'[]'::jsonb),
 'recent_administrations',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT * FROM public.medication_daily_administration_v dv WHERE dv.person_id=p_person_id AND dv.occurred_at>=now()-interval '3 days' ORDER BY dv.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100) x),'[]'::jsonb)),
 jsonb_build_object('captured_at',now(),'schema','phase06_v1')
 RETURNING id INTO v_id;
 RETURN v_id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_attach_line_intake_storage(p_source_id uuid, p_bucket_id text, p_object_name text, p_mime_type text, p_byte_size bigint, p_checksum_sha256 text, p_original_filename text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'storage', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_source public.data_intake_sources%rowtype;
  v_session public.data_intake_sessions%rowtype;
  v_asset_id uuid;
  v_existing public.phms_storage_assets%rowtype;
  v_mismatch_asset_id uuid;
begin
  if p_source_id is null then raise exception 'source_id_required'; end if;
  if p_bucket_id <> 'phms-intake-temp' then raise exception 'intake_temp_bucket_required'; end if;
  if p_object_name is null or p_object_name !~* '^intake/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp|pdf)$' then
    raise exception 'invalid_intake_object_path';
  end if;
  if p_mime_type not in ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp','application/pdf') then
    raise exception 'unsupported_media_type';
  end if;
  if p_byte_size is null or p_byte_size <= 0 or p_byte_size > 10485760 then
    raise exception 'invalid_file_size';
  end if;
  if p_checksum_sha256 is null or p_checksum_sha256 !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' then
    raise exception 'invalid_sha256';
  end if;

  select * into v_source
  from public.data_intake_sources
  where id=p_source_id
  for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'intake_source_not_found'; end if;

  select * into v_session
  from public.data_intake_sessions
  where id=v_source.session_id
  for update;
  if not found or v_session.channel <> 'line' then
    raise exception 'line_intake_session_required';
  end if;

  if v_source.storage_asset_id is not null then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok',true,
      'idempotent_replay',true,
      'session_id',v_source.session_id,
      'source_id',v_source.id,
      'storage_asset_id',v_source.storage_asset_id,
      'duplicate_file',coalesce((v_source.source_metadata->>'duplicate_file')::boolean,false)
    );
  end if;

  if not exists(
    select 1 from storage.objects o
    where o.bucket_id=p_bucket_id and o.name=p_object_name
  ) then
    raise exception 'storage_object_not_found';
  end if;

  -- Retry of the same path: attach the already registered asset.
  select * into v_existing
  from public.phms_storage_assets a
  where a.bucket_id=p_bucket_id
    and a.object_name=p_object_name
    and a.deleted_at is null
  limit 1;

  if found then
    update public.data_intake_sources
    set storage_asset_id=v_existing.id,
        source_url='storage://'||v_existing.bucket_id||'/'||v_existing.object_name,
        source_metadata=coalesce(source_metadata,'{}'::jsonb)
          || jsonb_build_object(
               'storage_bucket',v_existing.bucket_id,
               'storage_path',v_existing.object_name,
               'mime_type',v_existing.mime_type,
               'byte_size',v_existing.byte_size,
               'checksum_sha256',v_existing.checksum_sha256,
               'storage_status','stored',
               'storage_attach_replay',true
             )
    where id=v_source.id;

    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok',true,'idempotent_replay',true,
      'session_id',v_session.id,'source_id',v_source.id,
      'storage_asset_id',v_existing.id,
      'storage_bucket',v_existing.bucket_id,
      'storage_path',v_existing.object_name
    );
  end if;

  -- Exact bytes already stored for the same submitter + compatible Person:
  -- reuse the existing logical asset and discard the just-uploaded temp object.
  select a.* into v_existing
  from public.phms_storage_assets a
  where lower(a.checksum_sha256)=lower(p_checksum_sha256)
    and a.deleted_at is null
    and a.created_by=v_source.submitted_by
    and (
      (v_session.person_id is not null and a.person_id=v_session.person_id)
      or
      (v_session.person_id is null and a.person_id is null)
    )
    and (
      a.lifecycle_state='confirmed'
      or exists(
        select 1
        from public.data_intake_sources os
        join public.data_intake_sessions ods on ods.id=os.session_id
        where os.storage_asset_id=a.id
          and ods.status not in ('cancelled','rejected')
      )
    )
  order by
    case when a.lifecycle_state='confirmed' then 0 else 1 end,
    a.created_at
  limit 1;

  if found then
    update public.data_intake_sources
    set storage_asset_id=v_existing.id,
        source_url='storage://'||v_existing.bucket_id||'/'||v_existing.object_name,
        source_metadata=coalesce(source_metadata,'{}'::jsonb)
          || jsonb_build_object(
               'storage_bucket',v_existing.bucket_id,
               'storage_path',v_existing.object_name,
               'mime_type',v_existing.mime_type,
               'byte_size',v_existing.byte_size,
               'checksum_sha256',lower(p_checksum_sha256),
               'storage_status','reused_existing',
               'duplicate_file',true,
               'duplicate_reason','exact_sha256',
               'duplicate_of_asset_id',v_existing.id,
               'discard_uploaded_object',p_object_name,
               'canonical_commit',false
             )
    where id=v_source.id;

    update public.data_intake_sessions
    set status='cancelled',
        context_snapshot=coalesce(context_snapshot,'{}'::jsonb)
          || jsonb_build_object(
               'duplicate_file',true,
               'duplicate_reason','exact_sha256',
               'duplicate_of_asset_id',v_existing.id
             ),
        updated_at=now()
    where id=v_session.id;

    insert into public.data_intake_actions(
      session_id,actor_user_id,action,after_data,reason
    ) values(
      v_session.id,v_source.submitted_by,'reconcile',
      jsonb_build_object(
        'source_id',v_source.id,
        'storage_asset_id',v_existing.id,
        'duplicate_file',true,
        'duplicate_reason','exact_sha256',
        'checksum_sha256',lower(p_checksum_sha256),
        'discard_uploaded_object',p_object_name,
        'canonical_commit',false
      ),
      'exact_sha256_duplicate_file'
    );

    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok',true,
      'idempotent_replay',false,
      'session_id',v_session.id,
      'source_id',v_source.id,
      'storage_asset_id',v_existing.id,
      'storage_bucket',v_existing.bucket_id,
      'storage_path',v_existing.object_name,
      'duplicate_file',true,
      'duplicate_reason','exact_sha256',
      'duplicate_of_asset_id',v_existing.id,
      'discard_uploaded_object',true,
      'discard_bucket',p_bucket_id,
      'discard_object_name',p_object_name,
      'session_status','cancelled'
    );
  end if;

  -- Same bytes exist but are tied to another Person. Do NOT reuse.
  if v_session.person_id is not null then
    select a.id into v_mismatch_asset_id
    from public.phms_storage_assets a
    where lower(a.checksum_sha256)=lower(p_checksum_sha256)
      and a.deleted_at is null
      and a.person_id is not null
      and a.person_id<>v_session.person_id
      and (
        a.lifecycle_state='confirmed'
        or exists(
          select 1
          from public.data_intake_sources os
          join public.data_intake_sessions ods on ods.id=os.session_id
          where os.storage_asset_id=a.id
            and ods.status not in ('cancelled','rejected')
        )
      )
    order by a.created_at
    limit 1;
  end if;

  insert into public.phms_storage_assets(
    bucket_id,object_name,asset_kind,lifecycle_state,
    person_id,permission_resource,
    original_filename,mime_type,byte_size,checksum_sha256,
    created_by,captured_at,metadata
  )
  values(
    p_bucket_id,p_object_name,'intake_source','temporary',
    v_session.person_id,'health',
    nullif(p_original_filename,''),p_mime_type,p_byte_size,lower(p_checksum_sha256),
    v_source.submitted_by,now(),
    coalesce(p_metadata,'{}'::jsonb)
      || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'intake_session_id',v_session.id,
          'intake_source_id',v_source.id,
          'line_message_id',v_source.line_message_id,
          'sha256_person_mismatch_asset_id',v_mismatch_asset_id
         ))
  )
  returning id into v_asset_id;

  update public.data_intake_sources
  set storage_asset_id=v_asset_id,
      source_url='storage://'||p_bucket_id||'/'||p_object_name,
      source_metadata=
        coalesce(source_metadata,'{}'::jsonb)
        || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
             'storage_bucket',p_bucket_id,
             'storage_path',p_object_name,
             'mime_type',p_mime_type,
             'byte_size',p_byte_size,
             'checksum_sha256',lower(p_checksum_sha256),
             'original_filename',nullif(p_original_filename,''),
             'storage_status','stored',
             'sha256_person_mismatch',v_mismatch_asset_id is not null,
             'sha256_person_mismatch_asset_id',v_mismatch_asset_id
           ))
  where id=v_source.id;

  insert into public.data_intake_actions(session_id,actor_user_id,action,after_data,reason)
  values(
    v_session.id,
    v_source.submitted_by,
    case when v_mismatch_asset_id is null then 'edit' else 'reconcile' end,
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'source_id',v_source.id,
      'storage_asset_id',v_asset_id,
      'storage_bucket',p_bucket_id,
      'storage_path',p_object_name,
      'mime_type',p_mime_type,
      'byte_size',p_byte_size,
      'checksum_sha256',lower(p_checksum_sha256),
      'sha256_person_mismatch',v_mismatch_asset_id is not null,
      'sha256_person_mismatch_asset_id',v_mismatch_asset_id
    )),
    case when v_mismatch_asset_id is null then null else 'same_sha256_different_person' end
  );

  return jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'idempotent_replay',false,
    'session_id',v_session.id,
    'source_id',v_source.id,
    'storage_asset_id',v_asset_id,
    'storage_bucket',p_bucket_id,
    'storage_path',p_object_name,
    'duplicate_file',false,
    'person_mismatch_sha256',v_mismatch_asset_id is not null,
    'person_mismatch_asset_id',v_mismatch_asset_id
  ));
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_cancel_group_line_notification(p_notification_id uuid, p_lock_token uuid, p_reason text DEFAULT 'group_not_active_or_ready'::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_count integer;
BEGIN
 UPDATE public.notifications SET
   status='cancelled',last_error=left(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_reason),''),'group_not_active_or_ready'),240),
   locked_at=null,lock_token=null,updated_at=now()
 WHERE id=p_notification_id AND lock_token=p_lock_token AND status='sending'
   AND channel='line' AND payload->>'line_destination_type'='group';
 GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count=ROW_COUNT;
 RETURN v_count=1;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_claim_line_notifications(p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(notification_id uuid, lock_token uuid, line_user_id text, event_type text, title text, message text, payload jsonb, attempt_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_limit integer:=greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,20),50));
begin
  update public.notifications n
  set status='cancelled',
      last_error='source_no_longer_active',
      updated_at=now(),locked_at=null,lock_token=null
  where n.status in ('pending','failed')
    and (
      (
        n.event_type='appointment_reminder'
        and not exists(
          select 1 from public.appointments a
          where a.id=n.related_record_id
            and a.deleted_at is null
            and a.status in ('scheduled','confirmed')
            and a.appointment_at>now()
            and a.appointment_at is not distinct from
              private.phms_try_timestamptz(n.payload->>'appointment_at')
        )
      )
      or (
        n.event_type='appointment_post_visit'
        and not exists(
          select 1 from public.appointments a
          where a.id=n.related_record_id
            and a.deleted_at is null
            and a.status in ('confirmed','arrived','completed')
            and a.followup_recorded_at is null
        )
      )
      or (
        n.event_type in ('appointment_group_reminder','appointment_group_post_visit')
        and (
          not exists(
            select 1 from public.appointment_line_group_targets gt
            where gt.id=private.phms_try_uuid(n.payload->>'group_target_id')
              and gt.appointment_id=n.related_record_id
              and gt.status='active'
          )
          or not exists(
            select 1 from public.appointments a
            where a.id=n.related_record_id
              and a.deleted_at is null
              and (
                (n.event_type='appointment_group_reminder'
                 and a.status in ('scheduled','confirmed')
                 and a.appointment_at>now())
                or
                (n.event_type='appointment_group_post_visit'
                 and a.status in ('confirmed','arrived','completed')
                 and a.followup_recorded_at is null)
              )
          )
        )
      )
      or (
        n.event_type='medication_reminder'
        and not exists(
          select 1
          from public.person_medications pm
          join public.medication_regimens r
            on r.person_medication_id=pm.id
           and r.id=private.phms_try_uuid(n.payload->>'regimen_id')
          where pm.id=n.related_record_id
            and pm.deleted_at is null
            and pm.status='regular'
            and r.deleted_at is null
            and r.is_current=true
        )
      )
    );

  update public.notifications n
  set status='cancelled',last_error='group_not_active_or_ready',updated_at=now(),locked_at=null,lock_token=null
  where n.status in ('pending','failed')
    and n.channel='line'
    and n.payload->>'line_destination_type'='group'
    and not public.phms_line_group_delivery_allowed(n.payload->>'line_destination_id');

  return query
  with picked as (
    select
      n.id,
      case
        when n.payload->>'line_destination_type'='group'
          then nullif(n.payload->>'line_destination_id','')
        else li.line_user_id
      end destination_id
    from public.notifications n
    left join lateral (
      select x.line_user_id
      from public.line_identities x
      where x.user_id=n.recipient_user_id
        and coalesce(x.is_active,false)=true
        and x.onboarding_status='ready'
      order by x.updated_at desc nulls last,x.created_at desc
      limit 1
    ) li on true
    where n.channel='line'
      and n.status='pending'
      and coalesce(n.next_attempt_at,n.scheduled_for,n.created_at)<=now()
      and coalesce(n.scheduled_for,n.created_at)<=now()
      and n.attempt_count<n.max_attempts
      and (n.payload->>'line_destination_type' is distinct from 'group'
        or public.phms_line_group_delivery_allowed(n.payload->>'line_destination_id'))
      and (
        (n.payload->>'line_destination_type'='group'
         and nullif(n.payload->>'line_destination_id','') is not null)
        or li.line_user_id is not null
      )
    order by coalesce(n.scheduled_for,n.created_at),n.created_at
    limit v_limit
    for update of n skip locked
  ),
  claimed as (
    update public.notifications n
    set status='sending',attempt_count=n.attempt_count+1,
        locked_at=now(),lock_token=gen_random_uuid(),updated_at=now()
    from picked p
    where n.id=p.id
    returning n.id,n.lock_token,n.event_type,n.title,n.message,n.payload,n.attempt_count
  )
  select
    c.id,c.lock_token,p.destination_id,
    c.event_type,c.title,c.message,c.payload,c.attempt_count
  from claimed c
  join picked p on p.id=c.id
  order by c.id;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_diagnostic_appointment_detail(p_line_user_id text, p_appointment_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE ctx record; ap record; procedures jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO ctx FROM private.phms_line_crud_context(p_line_user_id,'appointment','view');
 IF ctx.actor_user_id IS NULL OR ctx.target_person_id IS NULL OR ctx.active_family_id IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'diagnostic_permission_denied';
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO ap FROM public.appointments
 WHERE id=p_appointment_id AND person_id=ctx.target_person_id
 AND family_id=ctx.active_family_id AND appointment_type='investigation'
 AND deleted_at IS NULL;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'diagnostic_appointment_not_found'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'id',pi.id,'code',pi.procedure_code,'name_th',pi.procedure_name_th,
  'name_en',pi.procedure_name_en,'sequence_no',pi.sequence_no,
  'status',pi.status,'completed_at',pi.completed_at,
  'result_reference',pi.result_reference) ORDER BY pi.sequence_no),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO procedures
 FROM public.appointment_procedure_items pi WHERE pi.appointment_id=ap.id;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'appointment_id',ap.id,'person_id',ap.person_id,
 'appointment_at',ap.appointment_at,'hospital_name',ap.hospital_name,
 'location_detail',ap.location_detail,'arrival_lead_minutes',ap.arrival_lead_minutes,
 'procedures',procedures);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_ensure_appointment_slip_task(p_appointment_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.appointment_tasks t
    where t.appointment_id=p_appointment_id and t.status<>'cancelled'
      and (t.source_key='system:appointment_slip:v1'
        or (t.task_type='document' and t.title ~* '(ใบนัด|บัตรนัด|ใบนัดหมาย|บัตรนัดหมาย)'))
  ) then
    insert into public.appointment_tasks(appointment_id,task_type,title,status,source_key)
    values(p_appointment_id,'document','📄 เอาใบนัดไปด้วย','pending','system:appointment_slip:v1')
    on conflict do nothing;
  end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_escalate_access_request(p_request_id uuid, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid;
  v_family_id uuid;
  v_requester uuid;
  v_status text;
begin

  v_actor := auth.uid();

  if v_actor is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required';
  end if;

  select
    family_id,
    requester_user_id,
    status
  into
    v_family_id,
    v_requester,
    v_status
  from public.permission_requests
  where id = p_request_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Permission request not found';
  end if;

  if v_status <> 'pending' then
    raise exception 'Only pending requests can be escalated';
  end if;

  if not private.can_manage_permissions(v_family_id) then
    raise exception 'Insufficient permission to escalate request';
  end if;

  update public.permission_requests
  set
    routing_level = 'owner',
    escalated_by = v_actor,
    escalated_at = now(),
    review_note = coalesce(p_note, 'Escalated to owner'),
    updated_at = now()
  where id = p_request_id;

  insert into public.audit_logs (
    family_id,
    actor_user_id,
    target_user_id,
    event_type,
    resource,
    record_id,
    new_data,
    description,
    created_at
  )
  values (
    v_family_id,
    v_actor,
    v_requester,
    'access_request_escalated',
    'permissions',
    p_request_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'routing_level', 'owner'
    ),
    coalesce(p_note, 'Permission request escalated to owner'),
    now()
  );

  perform private.notify_family_owners(
    v_family_id,
    'access_request_escalated',
    'มีคำขอสิทธิ์รอเจ้าของอนุมัติ',
    'คำขอสิทธิ์เกินขอบเขตของผู้ดูแลและถูกส่งต่อมายังเจ้าของ',
    p_request_id,
    null
  );

  return 'escalated_to_owner';

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_finish_line_login(p_line_user_id text, p_auth_user_id uuid, p_display_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_picture_url text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_person uuid;
  v_line_id uuid;
  v_account_id uuid;
  v_primary_user_id uuid;
begin
  if p_line_user_id is null or p_auth_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'missing identity';
  end if;

  v_account_id := private.phms_ensure_account_for_user(p_auth_user_id, 'system_anchor');

  select a.primary_auth_user_id
  into v_primary_user_id
  from public.accounts a
  where a.id = v_account_id;

  insert into public.line_login_accounts(
    line_user_id,auth_user_id,account_id,display_name,picture_url
  )
  values(
    p_line_user_id,v_primary_user_id,v_account_id,p_display_name,p_picture_url
  )
  on conflict(line_user_id) do update
  set auth_user_id = excluded.auth_user_id,
      account_id = excluded.account_id,
      display_name = coalesce(excluded.display_name, public.line_login_accounts.display_name),
      picture_url = coalesce(excluded.picture_url, public.line_login_accounts.picture_url),
      updated_at = now();

  update public.line_identities
  set account_id = v_account_id,
      user_id = v_primary_user_id,
      display_name = coalesce(p_display_name,display_name),
      picture_url = coalesce(p_picture_url,picture_url),
      linking_completed_at = now(),
      onboarding_started_at = coalesce(onboarding_started_at,now()),
      updated_at = now()
  where line_user_id = p_line_user_id
  returning id into v_line_id;

  if v_line_id is null then
    raise exception 'line_identity_not_found';
  end if;

  insert into public.user_contexts(user_id,active_scope)
  values(v_primary_user_id,'personal')
  on conflict(user_id) do nothing;

  perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line_id,v_primary_user_id);

  select p.id
  into v_person
  from public.persons p
  where p.linked_account_id = v_account_id
     or p.linked_user_id = v_primary_user_id
  order by p.created_at
  limit 1;

  if v_person is null then
    insert into public.persons(
      linked_user_id,linked_account_id,display_name,status
    )
    values(
      v_primary_user_id,
      v_account_id,
      coalesce(nullif(p_display_name,''),'PHMS user'),
      'active'
    )
    returning id into v_person;
  else
    update public.persons
    set linked_account_id = v_account_id,
        linked_user_id = v_primary_user_id,
        updated_at = now()
    where id = v_person;
  end if;

  update public.line_identities
  set onboarding_status='ready',
      onboarding_completed_at=coalesce(onboarding_completed_at,now())
  where id = v_line_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'account_id',v_account_id,
    'user_id',v_primary_user_id,
    'person_id',v_person,
    'line_identity_id',v_line_id
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_get_line_active_person_access_overview(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
 v_line record; v_ctx private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype; v_fp public.family_persons%rowtype; v_person public.persons%rowtype;
 v_person_name text; v_person_code text; v_actor_can_manage boolean:=false;
 v_members jsonb:='[]'::jsonb; v_requests jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
begin
 select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
 perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.line_identity_id,v_line.user_id);
 select c.* into v_ctx from private.line_identity_contexts c where c.line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;
 if not found or v_ctx.active_scope<>'family' or v_ctx.active_family_id is null or v_ctx.active_family_person_id is null
 then raise exception 'active_family_person_required'; end if;

 if not exists(select 1 from public.family_memberships fm
               where fm.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id and fm.user_id=v_line.user_id and fm.status='active')
 then raise exception 'family_context_not_accessible'; end if;

 select * into v_fp from public.family_persons
 where id=v_ctx.active_family_person_id and family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id and coalesce(status,'active')='active';
 if not found then raise exception 'active_family_person_not_found'; end if;

 select * into v_person from public.persons
 where id=v_fp.person_id and coalesce(status,'active')='active';
 if not found then raise exception 'active_person_not_found'; end if;

 perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',v_line.user_id::text,true);
 if not (
   coalesce(v_person.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id,false)
   or private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,v_fp.id,'persons','view')
   or private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,v_fp.id,'medications','view')
   or private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,v_fp.id,'appointments','view')
   or private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,v_fp.id,'health_data','view')
 ) then
   raise exception 'person_access_overview_view_required';
 end if;
 v_person_name:=private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,v_fp.id);
 v_person_code:=substr(encode(digest(v_fp.id::text||':'||v_line.line_identity_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12);
 v_actor_can_manage:=private.can_manage_family_person_permissions(v_line.user_id,v_fp.id);

 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'member_code',substr(encode(digest(fm.user_id::text||':'||v_line.line_identity_id::text||':'||fm.family_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
   'user_id',fm.user_id,
   'display_name',private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fm.family_id,fm.user_id),
   'roles',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(distinct r.role order by r.role)
                     from public.family_role_assignments r
                     where r.family_id=fm.family_id and r.user_id=fm.user_id and r.status='active'),'[]'::jsonb),
   'is_self',fm.user_id=v_line.user_id,
   'is_owner',private.user_has_family_role(fm.user_id,fm.family_id,array['owner']),
   'is_person_self',coalesce(v_person.linked_user_id=fm.user_id,false),
   'is_primary',private.phms_is_medical_primary(fm.user_id,v_fp.id),
   'is_caregiver',exists(
     select 1 from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca
     where ca.family_id=fm.family_id
       and ca.family_person_id=v_fp.id
       and ca.caregiver_user_id=fm.user_id
       and ca.status='active'
   ),
   'access_level',case
     when private.phms_is_medical_primary(fm.user_id,v_fp.id) then 'primary'
     when coalesce(v_person.linked_user_id=fm.user_id,false) then 'self'
     when exists(select 1 from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca
                 where ca.family_person_id=v_fp.id and ca.caregiver_user_id=fm.user_id and ca.status='active') then 'person'
     when exists(select 1 from public.family_permissions x
                 where x.family_id=fm.family_id and x.user_id=fm.user_id
                   and (coalesce(x.can_view,false) or coalesce(x.can_create,false) or coalesce(x.can_update,false) or coalesce(x.can_delete,false))) then 'family'
     when exists(select 1 from public.person_permissions x
                 where x.family_id=fm.family_id and x.family_person_id=v_fp.id and x.user_id=fm.user_id and x.status='active'
                   and (coalesce(x.can_view,false) or coalesce(x.can_create,false) or coalesce(x.can_update,false) or coalesce(x.can_delete,false) or coalesce(x.can_receive_notifications,false))) then 'person'
     else 'none' end,
   'has_family_scope',private.user_has_family_role(fm.user_id,fm.family_id,array['owner','admin'])
      or exists(select 1 from public.family_permissions x
                where x.family_id=fm.family_id and x.user_id=fm.user_id
                  and (coalesce(x.can_view,false) or coalesce(x.can_create,false) or coalesce(x.can_update,false) or coalesce(x.can_delete,false))),
   'has_person_scope',coalesce(v_person.linked_user_id=fm.user_id,false)
      or exists(select 1 from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca
                where ca.family_person_id=v_fp.id and ca.caregiver_user_id=fm.user_id and ca.status='active')
      or exists(select 1 from public.person_permissions x
                where x.family_id=fm.family_id and x.family_person_id=v_fp.id and x.user_id=fm.user_id and x.status='active'
                  and (coalesce(x.can_view,false) or coalesce(x.can_create,false) or coalesce(x.can_update,false) or coalesce(x.can_delete,false) or coalesce(x.can_receive_notifications,false))),
   'permissions',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'resource',r.resource,
      'view',private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_fp.id,r.resource,'view'),
      'create',private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_fp.id,r.resource,'create'),
      'update',private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_fp.id,r.resource,'update'),
      'delete',private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_fp.id,r.resource,'delete'),
      'receive_notifications',private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_fp.id,r.resource,'receive_notifications'),
      'family_scope',private.user_has_family_role(fm.user_id,fm.family_id,array['owner','admin'])
        or exists(select 1 from public.family_permissions x where x.family_id=fm.family_id and x.user_id=fm.user_id and x.resource=r.resource
          and (coalesce(x.can_view,false) or coalesce(x.can_create,false) or coalesce(x.can_update,false) or coalesce(x.can_delete,false))),
      'person_scope',coalesce(v_person.linked_user_id=fm.user_id,false)
        or exists(select 1 from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca where ca.family_person_id=v_fp.id and ca.caregiver_user_id=fm.user_id and ca.status='active')
        or exists(select 1 from public.person_permissions x where x.family_id=fm.family_id and x.family_person_id=v_fp.id
          and x.user_id=fm.user_id and x.resource=r.resource and x.status='active')
   ) order by r.ord)
   from (values ('persons'::text,1),('appointments'::text,2),('health_data'::text,3),('medications'::text,4),('emergency'::text,5),('documents'::text,6),('expenses'::text,7)) r(resource,ord))
 ) order by (fm.user_id=v_line.user_id) desc,
            private.user_has_family_role(fm.user_id,fm.family_id,array['owner']) desc,
            lower(private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fm.family_id,fm.user_id))),'[]'::jsonb)
 into v_members
 from public.family_memberships fm
 where fm.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id and fm.status='active';

 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'request_code',substr(encode(digest(prq.id::text||':'||v_line.line_identity_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
   'requester_display_name',private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,prq.family_id,prq.requester_user_id),
   'request_type',prq.request_type,
   'resource',prq.resource,
   'requested_action',prq.requested_action,
   'reason',prq.reason,
   'created_at',prq.created_at
 ) order by prq.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)
 into v_requests
 from public.permission_requests prq
 where prq.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
   and prq.family_person_id=v_fp.id
   and prq.status='pending'
   and prq.request_type in ('permission','person_bundle')
   and (not v_actor_can_manage or
        prq.request_type='person_bundle' or
        private.can_grant_permission(prq.family_id,prq.family_person_id,prq.resource,prq.requested_action));

 return jsonb_build_object(
   'family_id',v_ctx.active_family_id,'family_person_id',v_fp.id,'person_id',v_person.id,
   'person_code',v_person_code,'person_name',coalesce(v_person_name,'บุคคลในครอบครัว'),
   'actor_is_owner',private.is_family_owner(v_ctx.active_family_id),
   'actor_can_manage_permissions',v_actor_can_manage,
   'primary_status',(select state from private.medical_primary_responsibilities where family_person_id=v_fp.id),
   'primary_member_name',(select private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,v_fp.family_id,mp.primary_user_id) from private.medical_primary_responsibilities mp where mp.family_person_id=v_fp.id and mp.state='active'),
   'members',v_members,'pending_requests',v_requests,
   'member_count',jsonb_array_length(v_members),'pending_request_count',jsonb_array_length(v_requests)
 );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_get_line_context_state(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(line_identity_id uuid, user_id uuid, active_scope text, active_family_id uuid, active_family_person_id uuid, family_name text, family_person_name text, context_ready boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare v_line public.line_identities%rowtype; v_ctx private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype;
begin
 select * into v_line from public.line_identities li where li.line_user_id=p_line_user_id and li.is_active=true order by li.updated_at desc nulls last,li.created_at desc limit 1;
 if not found then raise exception 'line_identity_not_found'; end if;
 if v_line.user_id is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_linked'; end if;
 perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.id,v_line.user_id);
 select c.* into v_ctx from private.line_identity_contexts c where c.line_identity_id=v_line.id;
 return query
 select v_line.id,v_line.user_id,v_ctx.active_scope,v_ctx.active_family_id,v_ctx.active_family_person_id,
        f.family_name,
        case when v_ctx.active_family_person_id is null then null else private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,v_ctx.active_family_person_id) end,
        case
          when v_ctx.active_scope='personal' then exists(select 1 from public.persons p where p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active')
          when v_ctx.active_scope='family' and v_ctx.active_family_id is not null and v_ctx.active_family_person_id is null then true
          when v_ctx.active_scope='family' and v_ctx.active_family_person_id is not null then private.user_can_see_family_person(v_line.user_id,v_ctx.active_family_person_id)
          else false end
 from (select 1) z left join public.families f on f.id=v_ctx.active_family_id;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_get_line_intake_review_source(p_line_user_id text, p_source_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line public.line_identities%rowtype;
  v_source public.data_intake_sources%rowtype;
  v_session public.data_intake_sessions%rowtype;
  v_asset public.phms_storage_assets%rowtype;
  v_person_name text;
  v_candidates jsonb;
  v_count integer;
  v_validation_blocking integer;
  v_conflict_blocking integer;
  v_person_mismatch integer;
  v_duplicate integer;
begin
  if p_source_id is null then raise exception 'source_id_required'; end if;

  select * into v_line from public.line_identities
  where line_user_id=p_line_user_id and coalesce(is_active,false)=true
  limit 1;
  if not found or v_line.user_id is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_linked'; end if;

  select * into v_source from public.data_intake_sources
  where id=p_source_id and submitted_by=v_line.user_id
  limit 1;
  if not found then raise exception 'intake_source_not_found_or_not_owned'; end if;

  select * into v_session from public.data_intake_sessions
  where id=v_source.session_id and submitted_by=v_line.user_id
  limit 1;
  if not found then raise exception 'intake_session_not_found_or_not_owned'; end if;

  if v_source.storage_asset_id is not null then
    select * into v_asset from public.phms_storage_assets where id=v_source.storage_asset_id;
  end if;

  if v_session.person_id is not null then
    select coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.display_name),''),
                    nullif(btrim(concat_ws(' ',p.first_name,p.last_name)),''),
                    'ไม่ระบุชื่อ')
    into v_person_name
    from public.persons p where p.id=v_session.person_id;
  end if;

  select
    coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',c.id,
      'candidate_type',c.candidate_type,
      'ordinal',c.ordinal,
      'fingerprint_sha256',c.fingerprint_sha256,
      'normalized_data',c.normalized_data,
      'confidence_data',c.confidence_data,
      'validation_data',c.validation_data,
      'conflict_data',c.conflict_data,
      'reconciliation_data',c.reconciliation_data,
      'review_status',c.review_status
    ) order by c.ordinal,c.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    count(*),
    count(*) filter (
      where jsonb_array_length(coalesce(c.validation_data->'blocking_errors','[]'::jsonb))>0
    ),
    count(*) filter (
      where jsonb_array_length(coalesce(c.conflict_data->'blocking_conflicts','[]'::jsonb))>0
    ),
    count(*) filter (
      where coalesce((c.conflict_data->>'person_mismatch')::boolean,false)
    ),
    count(*) filter (
      where coalesce((c.conflict_data->>'duplicate_detected')::boolean,false)
    )
  into
    v_candidates,v_count,v_validation_blocking,v_conflict_blocking,v_person_mismatch,v_duplicate
  from public.data_intake_candidates c
  where c.source_id=v_source.id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'source_id',v_source.id,
    'source_code',substr(v_source.id::text,1,12),
    'session_id',v_session.id,
    'session_status',v_session.status,
    'person_id',v_session.person_id,
    'person_name',v_person_name,
    'person_required',v_session.person_id is null,
    'document_type',v_source.document_type,
    'classification_confidence',v_source.classification_confidence,
    'raw_text',coalesce(v_source.raw_text,''),
    'raw_text_length',length(coalesce(v_source.raw_text,'')),
    'extraction_status',v_source.source_metadata->>'extraction_status',
    'candidate_count',v_count,
    'blocking_candidate_count',v_validation_blocking,
    'blocking_conflict_count',v_conflict_blocking,
    'person_mismatch_count',v_person_mismatch,
    'duplicate_candidate_count',v_duplicate,
    'source_duplicate_file',coalesce((v_source.source_metadata->>'duplicate_file')::boolean,false),
    'source_sha256_person_mismatch',coalesce((v_source.source_metadata->>'sha256_person_mismatch')::boolean,false),
    'candidates',v_candidates,
    'storage_asset_id',v_source.storage_asset_id,
    'bucket_id',v_asset.bucket_id,
    'object_name',v_asset.object_name,
    'mime_type',v_asset.mime_type,
    'byte_size',v_asset.byte_size,
    'checksum_sha256',v_asset.checksum_sha256,
    'can_confirm',
      coalesce(v_source.source_metadata->>'extraction_status','')='completed'
      and v_session.person_id is not null
      and v_count>0
      and v_validation_blocking=0
      and v_conflict_blocking=0
      and v_session.status='review',
    'canonical_commit',false
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_get_line_notification_person_photo(p_notification_id uuid, p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare v_n public.notifications%rowtype; v_line public.line_identities%rowtype; v_object text; v_name text;
begin
 select * into v_n from public.notifications n where n.id=p_notification_id;
 if not found or v_n.family_person_id is null then return jsonb_build_object('available',false); end if;
 select * into v_line from public.line_identities li
 where li.line_user_id=p_line_user_id and li.is_active=true and li.user_id=v_n.recipient_user_id
 order by li.updated_at desc nulls last limit 1;
 if not found then return jsonb_build_object('available',false); end if;
 select coalesce(
   (select ph.object_name
    from public.person_photo_preferences pref
    join public.person_photos ph on ph.id=pref.photo_id
    where pref.viewer_user_id=v_n.recipient_user_id
      and pref.family_person_id=v_n.family_person_id
      and ph.status='active'
      and (ph.uploaded_by=v_n.recipient_user_id or ph.visibility='shared')
    limit 1),
   (select ph.object_name from public.person_photos ph
    where ph.family_person_id=v_n.family_person_id
      and ph.status='active' and ph.visibility='shared' and ph.is_person_shared_default=true
    limit 1)
 ) into v_object;
 select private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_n.recipient_user_id,v_n.family_person_id) into v_name;
 return jsonb_build_object('available',v_object is not null,'bucket_id','phms-person-photos','object_name',v_object,'person_name',v_name);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_get_line_prelink_person_setup(p_line_user_id text, p_person_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
 v_person record;v_p public.persons%rowtype;
 v_roles jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;v_access jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;v_helpers jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
 v_self_manage boolean:=true;
begin
 select * into v_person from private.resolve_line_family_person_code(p_line_user_id,p_person_code);
 perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',v_person.actor_user_id::text,true);

 select p.* into v_p
 from public.family_persons fp join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
 where fp.id=v_person.family_person_id;

 v_self_manage:=private.family_person_self_manage_enabled(v_person.family_person_id);

 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(pr.role order by pr.role),'[]'::jsonb)
 into v_roles
 from private.family_person_pending_roles pr
 where pr.family_person_id=v_person.family_person_id and pr.role='admin';

 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'target_person_code',substr(encode(digest(pa.target_family_person_id::text||':'||v_person.line_identity_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
  'target_name',private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_person.actor_user_id,pa.target_family_person_id),
  'access_kind',case when pa.is_caregiver then 'assistant' else 'viewer' end,
  'is_caregiver',pa.is_caregiver,
  'profile_level',pa.profile_level,
  'medications_level',pa.medications_level,
  'appointments_level',pa.appointments_level,
  'health_level',pa.health_level,
  'emergency_level',pa.emergency_level,
  'receive_notifications',pa.receive_notifications
 ) order by private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_person.actor_user_id,pa.target_family_person_id)),'[]'::jsonb)
 into v_access
 from private.family_person_pending_access pa
 where pa.subject_family_person_id=v_person.family_person_id;

 with helpers as (
  select
   private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_person.actor_user_id,v_person.family_id,ca.caregiver_user_id) display_name,
   'linked'::text helper_state,ca.caregiver_user_id::text stable_id
  from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca
  where ca.family_person_id=v_person.family_person_id and ca.status='active'
  union all
  select private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_person.actor_user_id,pa.subject_family_person_id),
         'prelink'::text,pa.subject_family_person_id::text
  from private.family_person_pending_access pa
  where pa.target_family_person_id=v_person.family_person_id and pa.is_caregiver=true
 )
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'display_name',display_name,'state',helper_state
 ) order by lower(display_name),stable_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 into v_helpers from helpers;

 return jsonb_build_object(
  'person_code',lower(btrim(p_person_code)),
  'family_person_id',v_person.family_person_id,
  'person_name',private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_person.actor_user_id,v_person.family_person_id),
  'account_linked',v_p.linked_user_id is not null,
  'self_manage',v_self_manage,
  'pending_roles',v_roles,
  'pending_access',v_access,
  'helpers',v_helpers
 );
end;
$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
 v_line record; v_person public.persons%rowtype;
 v_fp uuid; v_object text; v_mime text; v_shared boolean:=false;
begin
 select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
 select * into v_person from public.persons p
 where p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'

 where pref.viewer_user_id=v_line.user_id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_get_line_setup_state(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(line_identity_id uuid, user_id uuid, onboarding_status text, has_self_person boolean, self_person_id uuid, self_person_name text, active_family_count integer, setup_ready boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_self public.persons%rowtype;
  v_family_count integer:=0;
  v_self_label text;
begin
  select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);

  select p.* into v_self
  from public.persons p
  where p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
  order by p.created_at,p.id
  limit 1;

  if v_self.id is not null then
    select private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.id)
    into v_self_label
    from public.family_persons fp
    join public.family_memberships fm
      on fm.family_id=fp.family_id
     and fm.user_id=v_line.user_id
     and fm.status='active'
    where fp.person_id=v_self.id
      and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    order by fp.created_at
    limit 1;
  end if;

  select count(*)::int into v_family_count
  from public.family_memberships fm
  join public.families f on f.id=fm.family_id
  where fm.user_id=v_line.user_id
    and fm.status='active'
    and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active';

  return query select
    v_line.line_identity_id,
    v_line.user_id,
    v_line.onboarding_status,
    (v_self.id is not null),
    v_self.id,
    case when v_self.id is null then null
      else coalesce(
        nullif(btrim(v_self_label),''),
        nullif(btrim(v_self.nickname),''),
        nullif(btrim(concat_ws(' ',v_self.first_name,v_self.last_name)),''),
        'ข้อมูลของฉัน'
      )
    end,
    v_family_count,
    (v_self.id is not null or v_family_count>0);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_get_my_user_context()
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, active_scope text, active_family_id uuid, active_family_person_id uuid, self_person_id uuid, self_person_status text, context_ready boolean, context_changed_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if v_uid is null then
    raise exception 'authentication_required';
  end if;

  insert into public.user_contexts(user_id, active_scope, active_family_id, active_family_person_id, context_changed_at)

         uc.active_scope,

         uc.active_family_person_id,

         case when uc.active_scope = 'personal'
              then (p.id is not null and p.status = 'active')
              else true end as context_ready,
         uc.context_changed_at

    left join public.persons p on p.linked_user_id = uc.user_id
   where uc.user_id = v_uid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_get_or_create_line_auth_user(p_line_user_id text, p_display_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_picture_url text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_uid uuid;
  v_account_id uuid;
begin
  if p_line_user_id is null or btrim(p_line_user_id) = '' then
    raise exception 'line_user_id_required';
  end if;

  -- Canonical path: LINE identity -> account -> primary auth anchor.
  select li.account_id
  into v_account_id
  from public.line_identities li
  where li.line_user_id = p_line_user_id
  limit 1;

  if v_account_id is not null then
    select a.primary_auth_user_id
    into v_uid
    from public.accounts a
    where a.id = v_account_id;

    if v_uid is not null then
      return v_uid;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- Legacy compatibility path.
  select lla.account_id, lla.auth_user_id
  into v_account_id, v_uid
  from public.line_login_accounts lla
  where lla.line_user_id = p_line_user_id;

  if v_account_id is not null then
    select a.primary_auth_user_id
    into v_uid
    from public.accounts a
    where a.id = v_account_id;
    return v_uid;
  end if;

  if v_uid is not null then
    v_account_id := private.phms_ensure_account_for_user(v_uid, 'legacy_line_anchor');

    update public.line_identities
    set account_id = v_account_id,
        user_id = v_uid,
        updated_at = now()
    where line_user_id = p_line_user_id;

    update public.line_login_accounts
    set account_id = v_account_id,
        updated_at = now()
    where line_user_id = p_line_user_id;

    return v_uid;
  end if;

  -- First-time LINE onboarding creates an internal compatibility anchor.
  -- The LINE user ID is NOT stored as the canonical account identifier.
  v_uid := gen_random_uuid();

  insert into auth.users(
    instance_id,id,aud,role,email,encrypted_password,
    raw_app_meta_data,raw_user_meta_data,
    created_at,updated_at,
    confirmation_token,recovery_token,email_change_token_new,email_change,
    phone_change,phone_change_token,email_change_token_current,
    reauthentication_token,is_sso_user,is_anonymous
  )
  values(
    '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
    v_uid,
    'authenticated',
    'authenticated',
    null,
    null,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'provider','phms_internal',
      'providers',jsonb_build_array()
    ),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'display_name',p_display_name,
      'avatar_url',p_picture_url
    ),
    now(),now(),
    '','','','','','','','',
    false,false
  );

  v_account_id := private.phms_ensure_account_for_user(v_uid, 'system_anchor');

  insert into public.line_login_accounts(
    line_user_id,auth_user_id,account_id,display_name,picture_url
  )
  values(
    p_line_user_id,v_uid,v_account_id,p_display_name,p_picture_url
  )
  on conflict(line_user_id) do update
  set auth_user_id = excluded.auth_user_id,
      account_id = excluded.account_id,
      display_name = coalesce(excluded.display_name, public.line_login_accounts.display_name),
      picture_url = coalesce(excluded.picture_url, public.line_login_accounts.picture_url),
      updated_at = now();

  update public.line_identities
  set account_id = v_account_id,
      user_id = v_uid,
      display_name = coalesce(p_display_name, display_name),
      picture_url = coalesce(p_picture_url, picture_url),
      updated_at = now()
  where line_user_id = p_line_user_id;

  return v_uid;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_intake_review_candidate(p_candidate_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_action text, p_edited_data jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ declare c public.data_intake_candidates%rowtype; newstatus text; begin select * into c from public.data_intake_candidates where id=p_candidate_id for update; if not found then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error','candidate_not_found'); end if; if p_action not in ('confirm','edit','reject') then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error','invalid_action'); end if; newstatus:=case p_action when 'confirm' then 'accepted' when 'edit' then 'edited' else 'rejected' end; update public.data_intake_candidates set normalized_data=case when p_action='edit' and p_edited_data is not null then p_edited_data else normalized_data end, review_status=newstatus, updated_at=now() where id=p_candidate_id; insert into public.data_intake_actions(session_id,candidate_id,actor_user_id,action,before_data,after_data,reason) values(c.session_id,c.id,p_actor_user_id,case p_action when 'confirm' then 'confirm' when 'edit' then 'edit' else 'reject' end,c.normalized_data,case when p_action='edit' and p_edited_data is not null then p_edited_data else c.normalized_data end,p_reason); return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'review_status',newstatus); end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_intake_session_summary(p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ select jsonb_build_object('session_id',s.id,'status',s.status,'person_id',s.person_id,'sources',(select count(*) from public.data_intake_sources x where x.session_id=s.id),'candidates',(select count(*) from public.data_intake_candidates c where c.session_id=s.id),'pending_review',(select count(*) from public.data_intake_candidates c where c.session_id=s.id and c.review_status in ('pending','needs_review')),'accepted',(select count(*) from public.data_intake_candidates c where c.session_id=s.id and c.review_status in ('accepted','edited')),'rejected',(select count(*) from public.data_intake_candidates c where c.session_id=s.id and c.review_status='rejected')) from public.data_intake_sessions s where s.id=p_session_id $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_intake_validate_candidate(p_candidate_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ declare c public.data_intake_candidates%rowtype; errs jsonb:='[]'::jsonb; warns jsonb:='[]'::jsonb; result jsonb; begin select * into c from public.data_intake_candidates where id=p_candidate_id; if not found then return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'error','candidate_not_found'); end if; if c.person_id is null then errs:=errs||jsonb_build_array('person_required'); end if; if c.candidate_type is null or btrim(c.candidate_type)='' then errs:=errs||jsonb_build_array('candidate_type_required'); end if; if c.normalized_data='{}'::jsonb then warns:=warns||jsonb_build_array('normalized_data_empty'); end if; result:=jsonb_build_object('blocking_errors',errs,'warnings',warns,'validated_at',now()); update public.data_intake_candidates set validation_data=result, review_status=case when jsonb_array_length(errs)>0 then 'needs_review' else review_status end, updated_at=now() where id=p_candidate_id; return jsonb_build_object('ok',jsonb_array_length(errs)=0,'validation',result); end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_internal_get_intake_source(p_source_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v public.data_intake_sources%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v
  from public.data_intake_sources
  where id=p_source_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'intake_source_not_found';
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'id',v.id,
    'session_id',v.session_id,
    'submitted_by',v.submitted_by,
    'source_kind',v.source_kind,
    'document_type',v.document_type,
    'raw_text',v.raw_text,
    'source_metadata',coalesce(v.source_metadata,'{}'::jsonb),
    'storage_asset_id',v.storage_asset_id,
    'line_message_id',v.line_message_id
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_internal_merge_intake_source_metadata(p_source_id uuid, p_patch jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_meta jsonb;
begin
  update public.data_intake_sources
  set source_metadata=coalesce(source_metadata,'{}'::jsonb)||coalesce(p_patch,'{}'::jsonb)
  where id=p_source_id
  returning source_metadata into v_meta;

  if v_meta is null then
    raise exception 'intake_source_not_found';
  end if;

  return v_meta;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_care_map(p_line_user_id text, p_group_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_ctx private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype;
  v_person_id uuid;
  v_key text:=lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_group_key,''),'[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g'));
  v_groups jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_items jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
  perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.line_identity_id,v_line.user_id);
  select * into v_ctx from private.line_identity_contexts where line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;

  if v_ctx.active_family_person_id is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'reason','active_person_required');
  end if;

  if not private.user_can_access_family_person(
    v_line.user_id,v_ctx.active_family_person_id,'appointments','view'
  ) then
    raise exception 'appointment_view_required';
  end if;

  select fp.person_id into v_person_id
  from public.family_persons fp
  where fp.id=v_ctx.active_family_person_id;

  if nullif(v_key,'') is null then
    with base as (
      select a.*,
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.care_topic),''),nullif(btrim(a.department),''),'ยังไม่จัดกลุ่ม') group_label,
        lower(regexp_replace(
          coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.care_topic),''),nullif(btrim(a.department),''),'ยังไม่จัดกลุ่ม'),
          '[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g'
        )) group_key
      from public.appointments a
      where a.person_id=v_person_id and a.deleted_at is null
    ), g as (
      select
        group_key,
        (array_agg(group_label order by appointment_at desc nulls last))[1] group_label,
        count(*) appointment_count,
        count(distinct nullif(btrim(hospital_name),'')) hospital_count,
        count(distinct nullif(btrim(doctor_name),'')) doctor_count,
        max(appointment_at) latest_at,
        array_remove(array_agg(distinct nullif(btrim(hospital_name),'')),null) hospitals,
        array_remove(array_agg(distinct nullif(btrim(department),'')),null) departments,
        array_remove(array_agg(distinct nullif(btrim(doctor_name),'')),null) doctors
      from base
      group by group_key
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'group_key',group_key,
      'group_label',group_label,
      'appointment_count',appointment_count,
      'hospital_count',hospital_count,
      'doctor_count',doctor_count,
      'latest_at',latest_at,
      'hospitals',to_jsonb(hospitals),
      'departments',to_jsonb(departments),
      'doctors',to_jsonb(doctors)
    )) order by latest_at desc nulls last),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_groups from g;

    return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'mode','groups','groups',v_groups);
  end if;

  with base as (
    select a.*,
      lower(regexp_replace(
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.care_topic),''),nullif(btrim(a.department),''),'ยังไม่จัดกลุ่ม'),
        '[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g'
      )) group_key
    from public.appointments a
    where a.person_id=v_person_id and a.deleted_at is null
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'code',substr(id::text,1,12),
    'title',title,
    'appointment_at',appointment_at,
    'status',status,
    'care_topic',care_topic,
    'hospital_name',hospital_name,
    'department',department,
    'doctor_name',doctor_name,
    'hospital_hn',hospital_hn,
    'contact_phone',contact_phone,
    'contact_email',contact_email,
    'arrival_lead_minutes',arrival_lead_minutes
  )) order by appointment_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from base where group_key=v_key;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'mode','items','group_key',p_group_key,'items',v_items);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_chain(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_cur public.appointments%rowtype;
  v_previous jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_next jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_limit int:=least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,50),1),100);
  v_linked_count int:=0;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_line_appointment_access(
    p_line_user_id,p_record_code
  )
  limit 1;

  if coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false) is not true then
    raise exception 'appointment_links_not_accessible';
  end if;

  select * into v_cur
  from public.appointments
  where id=v_ref.record_id
    and deleted_at is null;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'appointment_not_found';
  end if;

  with component as materialized (
    select *
    from private.phms_appointment_component(v_cur.id,v_limit)
  )
  select count(*)::int-1
  into v_linked_count
  from component;

  with component as materialized (
    select *
    from private.phms_appointment_component(v_cur.id,v_limit)
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'record_id',x.id,
      'record_code',substr(x.id::text,1,12),
      'appointment_at',x.appointment_at,
      'title',x.title,
      'hospital_name',x.hospital_name,
      'department',x.department,
      'doctor_name',x.doctor_name,
      'care_topic',x.care_topic,
      'status',x.status,
      'visit_outcome_notes',x.visit_outcome_notes,
      'diagnosis_summary',x.diagnosis_summary,
      'treatment_summary',x.treatment_summary,
      'next_steps',x.next_steps,
      'medication_plan_notes',x.medication_plan_notes,
      'test_results_summary',x.test_results_summary,
      'distance_from_current',x.distance
    ))
    order by x.appointment_at,x.created_at,x.id
  ),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_previous
  from (
    select p.*,c.distance
    from component c
    join public.appointments p on p.id=c.appointment_id
    where p.id<>v_cur.id
      and p.deleted_at is null
      and p.appointment_at is not null
      and v_cur.appointment_at is not null
      and p.appointment_at<v_cur.appointment_at
    order by p.appointment_at,p.created_at,p.id
    limit v_limit
  ) x;

  with component as materialized (
    select *
    from private.phms_appointment_component(v_cur.id,v_limit)
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'record_id',x.id,
      'record_code',substr(x.id::text,1,12),
      'appointment_at',x.appointment_at,
      'title',x.title,
      'hospital_name',x.hospital_name,
      'department',x.department,
      'doctor_name',x.doctor_name,
      'care_topic',x.care_topic,
      'status',x.status,
      'distance_from_current',x.distance
    ))
    order by x.appointment_at,x.created_at,x.id
  ),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_next
  from (
    select p.*,c.distance
    from component c
    join public.appointments p on p.id=c.appointment_id
    where p.id<>v_cur.id
      and p.deleted_at is null
      and p.status not in ('cancelled','no_show')
      and p.appointment_at is not null
      and v_cur.appointment_at is not null
      and p.appointment_at>v_cur.appointment_at
    order by p.appointment_at,p.created_at,p.id
    limit v_limit
  ) x;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'record_code',substr(v_cur.id::text,1,12),
    'person_name',v_ref.target_person_name,
    'linked_count',greatest(v_linked_count,0),
    'group_size',greatest(v_linked_count,0)+1,
    'previous_count',jsonb_array_length(v_previous),
    'previous_appointments',v_previous,
    'next_count',jsonb_array_length(v_next),
    'next_appointments',v_next
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_defer_slip(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_appt public.appointments%rowtype;
  v_task public.appointment_tasks%rowtype;
  v_when timestamptz;
  v_rec uuid;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,'appointment',p_record_code,'update'
  )
  limit 1;

  select * into v_appt
  from public.appointments
  where id=v_ref.record_id and deleted_at is null;

  if not found then raise exception 'appointment_not_found'; end if;

  select * into v_task
  from public.appointment_tasks
  where appointment_id=v_appt.id
    and status='pending'
    and task_type='document'
    and title='เพิ่มรูปใบนัด'
  order by created_at desc
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    insert into public.appointment_tasks(
      appointment_id,task_type,title,instruction,due_at,created_by
    )
    values(
      v_appt.id,'document','เพิ่มรูปใบนัด',
      'แนบรูปใบนัดหรือเอกสารยืนยันนัดเข้ากับนัดนี้',
      case
        when v_appt.appointment_at>now()+interval '24 hours'
          then v_appt.appointment_at-interval '24 hours'
        when v_appt.appointment_at>now()+interval '3 hours'
          then v_appt.appointment_at-interval '2 hours'
        else now()+interval '15 minutes'
      end,
      v_ref.actor_user_id
    )
    returning * into v_task;
  end if;

  v_when:=case
    when v_appt.appointment_at>now()+interval '24 hours'
      then v_appt.appointment_at-interval '24 hours'
    when v_appt.appointment_at>now()+interval '3 hours'
      then v_appt.appointment_at-interval '2 hours'
    else now()+interval '15 minutes'
  end;

  for v_rec in
    select distinct r.recipient_user_id
    from private.phms_notification_recipients(v_appt.person_id,'appointments') r
    where r.recipient_user_id is not null
  loop
    insert into public.notifications(
      family_id,recipient_user_id,person_id,family_person_id,
      event_type,title,message,related_record_id,
      channel,priority,status,scheduled_for,next_attempt_at,
      payload,dedupe_key,created_at,updated_at
    )
    values(
      v_appt.family_id,v_rec,v_appt.person_id,v_appt.family_person_id,
      'appointment_missing_slip','📎 เพิ่มรูปใบนัด',
      'นัดเพื่อ: '||coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_appt.title),''),'นัดหมาย')||
        E'\nยังไม่ได้แนบรูปใบนัด หากมีรูปหรือไฟล์ใบนัดให้เพิ่มเข้ากับนัดนี้',
      v_appt.id,'line','normal','pending',v_when,v_when,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'appointment_id',v_appt.id,
        'appointment_code',substr(v_appt.id::text,1,12),
        'task_id',v_task.id
      ),
      'appointment-missing-slip:'||v_appt.id::text||':'||v_rec::text,
      now(),now()
    )
    on conflict(dedupe_key) where dedupe_key is not null
    do update set
      status='pending',
      scheduled_for=excluded.scheduled_for,
      next_attempt_at=excluded.next_attempt_at,
      message=excluded.message,
      payload=excluded.payload,
      updated_at=now(),
      locked_at=null,
      lock_token=null,
      last_error=null;
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'appointment_code',substr(v_appt.id::text,1,12),
    'task_code',substr(v_task.id::text,1,12),
    'remind_at',v_when
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_documents(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_sensitive record;
  v_items jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_can_sensitive boolean:=false;
  v_can_ops boolean:=false;
  v_can_health boolean:=false;
  v_is_completed boolean:=false;
begin
  -- ชั้นที่ 1: ต้องมีสิทธิ์ดู "นัด" ก่อน
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_line_appointment_access(
    p_line_user_id,p_record_code
  )
  limit 1;

  v_can_ops:=coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false);
  v_can_health:=v_ref.active_family_person_id is not null
    and private.user_can_access_family_person(
      v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,'documents','view'
    );
  select coalesce(a.status,'scheduled')='completed'
  into v_is_completed
  from public.appointments a where a.id=v_ref.record_id;
  -- ชั้นที่ 2: สิทธิ์ข้อมูลการเงิน/ประวัติ เป็นคนละ policy
  begin
    select * into v_sensitive
    from private.phms_line_appointment_sensitive_access(
      p_line_user_id,p_record_code
    )
    limit 1;
    v_can_sensitive:=coalesce(
      v_sensitive.can_view_sensitive,false
    );
    -- v_can_ops is limited to appointment managers and assignees; self-view alone does not grant operations access
  exception when others then
    v_can_sensitive:=false;
  end;

  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'link_id',adl.id,
        'link_kind',adl.link_kind,
        'usage_relation',adl.usage_relation,
        'origin_appointment_code',case
          when coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false)
           and adl.origin_appointment_id is not null
          then substr(adl.origin_appointment_id::text,1,12)
          else null
        end,
        'origin_title',case when coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false) then oa.title end,
        'origin_hospital_name',case when coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false) then oa.hospital_name end,
        'origin_appointment_at',case when coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false) then oa.appointment_at end,
        'origin_care_topic',case when coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false) then oa.care_topic end,
        'is_origin_for_this_appointment',case when coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false) then
          coalesce(adl.origin_appointment_id,adl.appointment_id)=adl.appointment_id end,
        'used_in_appointment_count',case when coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false) then (
          select count(distinct l2.appointment_id)::int
          from public.appointment_document_links l2
          where l2.storage_asset_id=coalesce(adl.storage_asset_id,md.storage_asset_id)
            and coalesce(adl.storage_asset_id,md.storage_asset_id) is not null
        ) end,
        'title',coalesce(
          nullif(btrim(md.title),''),
          nullif(
            btrim(sa.metadata->>'display_title'),''
          ),
          nullif(btrim(sa.original_filename),''),
          'เอกสารนัด'
        ),
        'document_type',md.document_type,
        'document_date',md.document_date,
        'note',coalesce(
          nullif(btrim(adl.note),''),
          nullif(
            btrim(md.metadata->>'note'),''
          ),
          nullif(
            btrim(md.metadata->>'description'),''
          )
        ),
        'storage_asset_id',
          coalesce(
            adl.storage_asset_id,
            md.storage_asset_id
          ),
        'medical_document_id',
          adl.medical_document_id,
        'bucket_id',
          coalesce(
            sa.bucket_id,
            md.storage_bucket
          ),
        'object_name',
          coalesce(
            sa.object_name,
            md.storage_path
          ),
        'mime_type',
          coalesce(
            sa.mime_type,
            md.mime_type
          ),
        'original_filename',
          coalesce(
            sa.original_filename,
            md.original_filename
          ),
        'created_at',adl.created_at,
        'created_by_name',case
          when adl.created_by is null then 'ระบบ'
          else private.family_user_label_for_viewer(
            v_ref.actor_user_id,
            v_ref.active_family_id,
            adl.created_by
          )
        end,
        'preparation_task_code',case
          when pt.id is not null
          then substr(pt.id::text,1,12)
          else null
        end,
        'preparation_status',pt.status,
        'preparation_completed_at',pt.completed_at,
        'is_financial_document',
          coalesce(adl.link_kind,'') in (
            'receipt',
            'payment_slip',
            'payment_qr',
            'payment_other'
          )
      ))
      order by adl.created_at desc
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_items
  from public.appointment_document_links adl
  left join public.medical_documents md
    on md.id=adl.medical_document_id
  left join public.phms_storage_assets sa
    on sa.id=coalesce(
      adl.storage_asset_id,
      md.storage_asset_id
    )
  left join public.appointments oa
    on oa.id=adl.origin_appointment_id
  left join public.appointment_tasks pt
    on pt.appointment_id=adl.appointment_id
   and pt.source_document_link_id=adl.id
   and pt.status<>'cancelled'
  where adl.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
    and v_can_health
    and (
      -- เอกสารปฏิบัติงานก่อนนัด: ต้องได้รับมอบหมายหรือจัดการนัดได้
      (v_can_ops and adl.link_kind in ('source','preparation'))
      -- เอกสารทางคลินิก: ต้องมีสิทธิ์สุขภาพกลาง แม้เป็นผู้ได้รับมอบหมาย
      or (v_can_health and (v_can_ops or v_is_completed)
          and adl.link_kind in ('result','certificate','referral','other'))
      -- หลักฐานการเงิน: ต้องมีสิทธิ์ค่าใช้จ่ายแยกจากสิทธิ์สุขภาพ
      or (v_can_sensitive and (v_can_ops or v_is_completed)
          and adl.link_kind in ('receipt','payment_slip','payment_qr','payment_other'))
    );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'person_name',v_ref.target_person_name,
    'can_update',
      coalesce(v_ref.can_update,false) and v_can_health and private.user_can_access_family_person(v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,'documents','update'),
    'can_view_appointment_documents',v_can_health and (v_can_ops or v_is_completed),
    'can_view_after_documents',v_is_completed and v_can_health,
    'can_view_financial_documents',
      v_can_health and (v_can_ops or v_is_completed) and v_can_sensitive,
    'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_expense_summary(p_line_user_id text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 12)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_prep record;
  v_person_id uuid;
  v_person_name text;
  v_limit int:=least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,12),1),30);
  v_total_paid numeric(14,2):=0;
  v_visit_count int:=0;
  v_zero_count int:=0;
  v_by_hospital jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_by_category jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_by_cgd_category jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_cgd_comparisons jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_recent jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
  select * into v_prep from public.phms_prepare_line_main_command(p_line_user_id,'appointments');

  if v_prep.flow_state<>'ready' then
    raise exception 'appointment_context_not_ready';
  end if;

  if v_prep.active_scope='family' and v_prep.active_family_person_id is not null then
    select fp.person_id into v_person_id
    from public.family_persons fp
    where fp.id=v_prep.active_family_person_id
      and fp.status='active';
  else
    select p.id into v_person_id
    from public.persons p
    where p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id
      and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
    order by p.created_at
    limit 1;
  end if;

  if v_person_id is null then raise exception 'target_person_not_found'; end if;
  v_person_name:=coalesce(v_prep.target_person_name,'บุคคล');

  select coalesce(sum(e.paid_amount),0),count(*)::int,
         count(*) filter (where coalesce(e.paid_amount,0)=0)::int
  into v_total_paid,v_visit_count,v_zero_count
  from public.healthcare_expenses e
  join public.appointments a on a.id=e.appointment_id and a.deleted_at is null
  where e.person_id=v_person_id
      and private.phms_user_can_view_appointment_finance(
        v_line.user_id,e.appointment_id
      )
    and e.deleted_at is null
    and e.appointment_id is not null
    and e.paid_amount is not null;

  with h as (
    select
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.hospital_name),''),'ไม่ระบุสถานพยาบาล') hospital_name,
      count(*)::int visit_count,
      round(sum(coalesce(e.paid_amount,0)),2) paid_total,
      round(avg(coalesce(e.paid_amount,0)),2) paid_average,
      max(e.expense_date) last_date
    from public.healthcare_expenses e
    join public.appointments a on a.id=e.appointment_id and a.deleted_at is null
    where e.person_id=v_person_id
      and private.phms_user_can_view_appointment_finance(
        v_line.user_id,e.appointment_id
      )
      and e.deleted_at is null
      and e.appointment_id is not null
      and e.paid_amount is not null
    group by 1
    order by paid_total desc,last_date desc
    limit 12
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'hospital_name',hospital_name,
    'visit_count',visit_count,
    'paid_total',paid_total,
    'paid_average',paid_average,
    'last_date',last_date
  ) order by paid_total desc,last_date desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_by_hospital
  from h;

  with c as (
    select
      i.category,
      count(*)::int item_count,
      round(sum(i.amount),2) amount_total,
      round(avg(i.amount),2) amount_average
    from public.healthcare_expense_items i
    join public.healthcare_expenses e on e.id=i.expense_id and e.deleted_at is null
    where e.person_id=v_person_id
      and private.phms_user_can_view_appointment_finance(
        v_line.user_id,e.appointment_id
      )
      and i.deleted_at is null
    group by i.category
    order by amount_total desc
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'category',category,
    'item_count',item_count,
    'amount_total',amount_total,
    'amount_average',amount_average
  ) order by amount_total desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_by_category
  from c;

  with cgd as (
    select
      i.cgd_category_code,
      cc.name_th cgd_category_name,
      count(*)::int item_count,
      round(sum(i.amount),2) amount_total,
      round(avg(i.amount),2) amount_average
    from public.healthcare_expense_items i
    join public.healthcare_expenses e on e.id=i.expense_id and e.deleted_at is null
    left join public.cgd_medical_service_categories cc on cc.code=i.cgd_category_code
    where e.person_id=v_person_id
      and private.phms_user_can_view_appointment_finance(
        v_line.user_id,e.appointment_id
      )
      and i.deleted_at is null
      and i.cgd_category_code is not null
    group by i.cgd_category_code,cc.name_th
    order by amount_total desc
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'cgd_category_code',cgd_category_code,
    'cgd_category_name',cgd_category_name,
    'item_count',item_count,
    'amount_total',amount_total,
    'amount_average',amount_average
  ) order by amount_total desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_by_cgd_category
  from cgd;

  with base as (
    select
      i.cgd_item_code,
