      coalesce(nullif(btrim(i.cgd_item_name),''),nullif(btrim(i.label),''),'รายการบริการ') item_name,
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.hospital_name),''),'ไม่ระบุสถานพยาบาล') hospital_name,
      i.amount
    from public.healthcare_expense_items i
    join public.healthcare_expenses e on e.id=i.expense_id and e.deleted_at is null
    join public.appointments a on a.id=e.appointment_id and a.deleted_at is null
    where e.person_id=v_person_id
      and private.phms_user_can_view_appointment_finance(
        v_line.user_id,e.appointment_id
      )
      and i.deleted_at is null
      and nullif(btrim(i.cgd_item_code),'') is not null
  ),
  eligible as (
    select cgd_item_code
    from base
    group by cgd_item_code
    having count(distinct hospital_name)>=2
  ),
  stats as (
    select
      b.cgd_item_code,
      min(b.item_name) item_name,
      count(*)::int sample_count,
      count(distinct b.hospital_name)::int hospital_count,
      round(min(b.amount),2) min_amount,
      round(max(b.amount),2) max_amount,
      round(avg(b.amount),2) avg_amount
    from base b
    join eligible e on e.cgd_item_code=b.cgd_item_code
    group by b.cgd_item_code
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'cgd_item_code',s.cgd_item_code,
    'cgd_item_name',s.item_name,
    'sample_count',s.sample_count,
    'hospital_count',s.hospital_count,
    'min_amount',s.min_amount,
    'max_amount',s.max_amount,
    'avg_amount',s.avg_amount,
    'spread_amount',round(s.max_amount-s.min_amount,2),
    'hospitals',(
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'hospital_name',x.hospital_name,
        'sample_count',x.sample_count,
        'average_amount',x.average_amount,
        'min_amount',x.min_amount,
        'max_amount',x.max_amount
      ) order by x.average_amount desc)
      from (
        select
          b2.hospital_name,
          count(*)::int sample_count,
          round(avg(b2.amount),2) average_amount,
          round(min(b2.amount),2) min_amount,
          round(max(b2.amount),2) max_amount
        from base b2
        where b2.cgd_item_code=s.cgd_item_code
        group by b2.hospital_name
      ) x
    )
  ) order by s.max_amount-s.min_amount desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_cgd_comparisons
  from stats s;

  with r as (
    select
      substr(a.id::text,1,12) record_code,
      e.expense_date,
      a.hospital_name,
      a.department,
      e.paid_amount,
      e.coverage_used,
      e.coverage_type,
      e.payment_method,
      e.payer
    from public.healthcare_expenses e
    join public.appointments a on a.id=e.appointment_id and a.deleted_at is null
    where e.person_id=v_person_id
      and private.phms_user_can_view_appointment_finance(
        v_line.user_id,e.appointment_id
      )
      and e.deleted_at is null
      and e.appointment_id is not null
      and e.paid_amount is not null
    order by e.expense_date desc,e.created_at desc
    limit v_limit
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'record_code',record_code,
    'expense_date',expense_date,
    'hospital_name',hospital_name,
    'department',department,
    'paid_amount',paid_amount,
    'coverage_used',coverage_used,
    'coverage_type',coverage_type,
    'payment_method',payment_method,
    'payer',payer
  )) order by expense_date desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_recent
  from r;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'person_name',v_person_name,
    'visit_count',v_visit_count,
    'zero_payment_visit_count',v_zero_count,
    'total_paid',v_total_paid,
    'by_hospital',v_by_hospital,
    'by_category',v_by_category,
    'by_cgd_category',v_by_cgd_category,
    'cgd_price_comparisons',v_cgd_comparisons,
    'recent',v_recent
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_explorer(p_line_user_id text, p_scope text DEFAULT 'current'::text, p_mode text DEFAULT 'upcoming'::text, p_dimension text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_group_key text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_state private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype;
  v_crud record;
  v_family_id uuid;
  v_current_fp uuid;
  v_current_person uuid;
  v_scope text:=lower(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_scope),''),'current'));
  v_mode text:=lower(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_mode),''),'upcoming'));
  v_dim text:=lower(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_dimension),''),''));
  v_key text:=lower(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_group_key),''),''));
  v_limit integer:=least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,50),1),100);
  v_people_count integer:=0;
  v_groups jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_items jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_person_name text;
  v_crud_ok boolean:=false;
begin
  if v_scope not in ('current','all') then raise exception 'invalid_appointment_scope'; end if;
  if v_mode not in ('upcoming','past') then raise exception 'invalid_appointment_mode'; end if;
  if v_dim not in ('','care','department','hospital','day','month','year') then
    raise exception 'invalid_appointment_dimension';
  end if;

  select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
  perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.line_identity_id,v_line.user_id);
  select * into v_state
  from private.line_identity_contexts
  where line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;

  begin
    select * into v_crud
    from private.phms_line_crud_context(p_line_user_id,'appointment','view')
    limit 1;
    v_crud_ok:=found;
  exception when others then
    v_crud_ok:=false;
  end;

  if v_crud_ok then
    v_current_person:=v_crud.target_person_id;
    v_family_id:=coalesce(v_crud.active_family_id,v_state.active_family_id);
    v_current_fp:=coalesce(v_crud.active_family_person_id,v_state.active_family_person_id);
  else
    v_current_person:=null;
    v_family_id:=v_state.active_family_id;
    v_current_fp:=v_state.active_family_person_id;
  end if;

  if v_family_id is not null and v_current_fp is null then
    select fp.id,fp.person_id
    into v_current_fp,v_current_person
    from public.family_persons fp
    join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
    where fp.family_id=v_family_id
      and fp.setup_status='ready'
      and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
      and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
      and private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'appointments','view')
    order by
      coalesce(p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id,false) desc,
      fp.created_at
    limit 1;
  end if;

  if v_family_id is null then
    select fp.family_id,fp.id,fp.person_id
    into v_family_id,v_current_fp,v_current_person
    from public.family_persons fp
    join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
    join public.family_memberships fm
      on fm.family_id=fp.family_id
     and fm.user_id=v_line.user_id
     and fm.status='active'
    where fp.setup_status='ready'
      and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
      and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
      and private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'appointments','view')
    order by
      coalesce(p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id,false) desc,
      fm.created_at,
      fp.created_at
    limit 1;
  end if;

  if v_current_fp is null or v_family_id is null then
    raise exception 'appointment_family_context_required';
  end if;

  v_person_name:=private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,v_current_fp);

  select count(*)::int
  into v_people_count
  from public.family_persons fp
  join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
  where fp.family_id=v_family_id
    and fp.setup_status='ready'
    and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
    and private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'appointments','view');

  if v_dim<>'' and v_key='' then
    with base as (
      select
        a.*,
        fp.id as fp_id,
        private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.id) as person_name,
        case v_dim
          when 'care' then coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.care_topic),''),'ยังไม่ระบุกลุ่มการรักษา')
          when 'department' then coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.department),''),'ยังไม่ระบุแผนก')
          when 'hospital' then coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.hospital_name),''),'ยังไม่ระบุสถานพยาบาล')
          when 'day' then to_char(coalesce(a.appointment_at, (a.planned_visit_date::timestamp + interval '12 hours') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok','YYYY-MM-DD')
          when 'month' then to_char(coalesce(a.appointment_at, (a.planned_visit_date::timestamp + interval '12 hours') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok','YYYY-MM')
          when 'year' then to_char(coalesce(a.appointment_at, (a.planned_visit_date::timestamp + interval '12 hours') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok','YYYY')
        end as group_label,
        case v_dim
          when 'day' then to_char(coalesce(a.appointment_at, (a.planned_visit_date::timestamp + interval '12 hours') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok','YYYY-MM-DD')
          when 'month' then to_char(coalesce(a.appointment_at, (a.planned_visit_date::timestamp + interval '12 hours') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok','YYYY-MM')
          when 'year' then to_char(coalesce(a.appointment_at, (a.planned_visit_date::timestamp + interval '12 hours') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok','YYYY')
          else lower(regexp_replace(
            case v_dim
              when 'care' then coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.care_topic),''),'ยังไม่ระบุกลุ่มการรักษา')
              when 'department' then coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.department),''),'ยังไม่ระบุแผนก')
              when 'hospital' then coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.hospital_name),''),'ยังไม่ระบุสถานพยาบาล')
            end,
            '[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g'
          ))
        end as group_key,
        coalesce(
          a.appointment_at - make_interval(mins=>greatest(coalesce(a.arrival_lead_minutes,0),0)),
          a.appointment_at,
          (a.planned_visit_date::timestamp + interval '12 hours') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'
        ) as arrival_at
      from public.appointments a
      join public.family_persons fp
        on fp.person_id=a.person_id
       and fp.family_id=v_family_id
      join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
      where a.deleted_at is null
        and (a.appointment_at is not null or (a.planned_visit_date is not null))
        and fp.setup_status='ready'
        and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
        and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
        and private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'appointments','view')
        and (v_scope='all' or fp.id=v_current_fp)
        and (
          (v_mode='upcoming'
            and (a.appointment_at>=now() or (a.appointment_at is null and a.visit_mode='walk_in' and a.planned_visit_date >= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date))
            and coalesce(a.status,'scheduled') in ('planned','scheduled','confirmed','arrived'))
          or
          (v_mode='past' and (a.appointment_at<now() or (a.appointment_at is null and a.visit_mode='walk_in' and a.planned_visit_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date)))
        )
    ), grp as (
      select
        group_key,
        (array_agg(group_label order by
          case when v_mode='upcoming' then arrival_at end asc nulls last,
          case when v_mode='past' then coalesce(appointment_at,arrival_at) end desc nulls last
        ))[1] as group_label,
        count(*)::int as appointment_count,
        count(distinct fp_id)::int as person_count,
        min(arrival_at) as next_arrival_at,
        max(coalesce(appointment_at,arrival_at)) as latest_at
      from base
      group by group_key
    )
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'group_key',group_key,
        'group_label',group_label,
        'appointment_count',appointment_count,
        'person_count',person_count,
        'next_arrival_at',next_arrival_at,
        'latest_at',latest_at
      )
      order by
        case when v_mode='upcoming' then next_arrival_at end asc nulls last,
        case when v_mode='past' then latest_at end desc nulls last,
        lower(group_label)
    ),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_groups
    from (
      select * from grp
      order by
        case when v_mode='upcoming' then next_arrival_at end asc nulls last,
        case when v_mode='past' then latest_at end desc nulls last,
        lower(group_label)
      limit v_limit
    ) s;

    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok',true,
      'mode','groups',
      'appointment_mode',v_mode,
      'scope',v_scope,
      'dimension',v_dim,
      'current_person_name',v_person_name,
      'accessible_people_count',v_people_count,
      'groups',v_groups
    );
  end if;

  with base as (
    select
      a.*,
      fp.id as fp_id,
      private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.id) as person_name,
      substr(encode(digest(fp.id::text||':'||v_line.line_identity_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12) as person_code,
      coalesce(
        a.appointment_at - make_interval(mins=>greatest(coalesce(a.arrival_lead_minutes,0),0)),
        a.appointment_at,
        (a.planned_visit_date::timestamp + interval '12 hours') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok'
      ) as arrival_at,
      case
        when v_dim='care' then lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.care_topic),''),'ยังไม่ระบุกลุ่มการรักษา'),'[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g'))
        when v_dim='department' then lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.department),''),'ยังไม่ระบุแผนก'),'[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g'))
        when v_dim='hospital' then lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(nullif(btrim(a.hospital_name),''),'ยังไม่ระบุสถานพยาบาล'),'[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g'))
        when v_dim='day' then to_char(coalesce(a.appointment_at, (a.planned_visit_date::timestamp + interval '12 hours') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok','YYYY-MM-DD')
        when v_dim='month' then to_char(coalesce(a.appointment_at, (a.planned_visit_date::timestamp + interval '12 hours') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok','YYYY-MM')
        when v_dim='year' then to_char(coalesce(a.appointment_at, (a.planned_visit_date::timestamp + interval '12 hours') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok','YYYY')
        else ''
      end as group_key
    from public.appointments a
    join public.family_persons fp
      on fp.person_id=a.person_id
     and fp.family_id=v_family_id
    join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
    where a.deleted_at is null
      and (a.appointment_at is not null or (a.planned_visit_date is not null))
      and fp.setup_status='ready'
      and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
      and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
      and private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'appointments','view')
      and (v_scope='all' or fp.id=v_current_fp)
      and (
        (v_mode='upcoming'
          and (a.appointment_at>=now() or (a.appointment_at is null and a.visit_mode='walk_in' and a.planned_visit_date >= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date))
          and coalesce(a.status,'scheduled') in ('planned','scheduled','confirmed','arrived'))
        or
        (v_mode='past' and (a.appointment_at<now() or (a.appointment_at is null and a.visit_mode='walk_in' and a.planned_visit_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date)))
      )
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(item order by sort_at),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from (
    select
      case when v_mode='upcoming' then b.arrival_at else null end as sort_future,
      case when v_mode='past' then coalesce(b.appointment_at,b.arrival_at) else null end as sort_past,
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'code',substr(b.id::text,1,12),
        'person_code',b.person_code,
        'person_name',b.person_name,
        'title',b.title,
        'appointment_at',b.appointment_at,
        'planned_visit_date',b.planned_visit_date,
        'visit_time_known',b.visit_time_known,
        'visit_mode',b.visit_mode,
        'walk_in_reason',b.walk_in_reason,
        'arrival_at',b.arrival_at,
        'arrival_lead_minutes',b.arrival_lead_minutes,
        'status',b.status,
        'care_topic',b.care_topic,
        'appointment_type',b.appointment_type,
        'hospital_name',b.hospital_name,
        'hospital_hn',null,
        'department',b.department,
        'doctor_name',b.doctor_name,
        'location_detail',null,
        'coverage_type',null,
        'preparation_notes',null,
        'note',null
      )) as item,
      case
        when v_mode='upcoming' then extract(epoch from b.arrival_at)
        else -extract(epoch from coalesce(b.appointment_at,b.arrival_at))
      end as sort_at
    from base b
    where v_dim='' or b.group_key=v_key
    order by
      case when v_mode='upcoming' then b.arrival_at end asc nulls last,
      case when v_mode='past' then coalesce(b.appointment_at,b.arrival_at) end desc nulls last,
      b.id
    limit v_limit
  ) x;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'mode','items',
    'appointment_mode',v_mode,
    'scope',v_scope,
    'dimension',nullif(v_dim,''),
    'group_key',nullif(v_key,''),
    'current_person_name',v_person_name,
    'accessible_people_count',v_people_count,
    'count',jsonb_array_length(v_items),
    'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_finance(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_sensitive record;
  v_appt public.appointments%rowtype;
  v_exp public.healthcare_expenses%rowtype;
  v_items jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_docs jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_line_appointment_access(
    p_line_user_id,p_record_code
  )
  limit 1;

  select * into v_sensitive
  from private.phms_line_appointment_sensitive_access(
    p_line_user_id,p_record_code
  )
  limit 1;

  if coalesce(v_sensitive.can_view_sensitive,false) is not true then
    raise exception 'appointment_finance_not_accessible';
  end if;

  select * into v_appt
  from public.appointments where id=v_ref.record_id;

  select * into v_exp
  from public.healthcare_expenses
  where appointment_id=v_ref.record_id and deleted_at is null
  order by created_at desc limit 1;

  if v_exp.id is not null then
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',i.id,'category',i.category,'label',i.label,'amount',i.amount,
      'note',i.note,'sort_order',i.sort_order,
      'cgd_category_code',i.cgd_category_code,
      'cgd_category_name',cc.name_th,
      'cgd_item_code',i.cgd_item_code,
      'cgd_item_name',i.cgd_item_name,
      'hospital_item_code',i.hospital_item_code,
      'cgd_reference_rate',i.cgd_reference_rate,
      'cgd_rate_effective_date',i.cgd_rate_effective_date,
      'cgd_source_ref',i.cgd_source_ref,
      'cgd_match_status',i.cgd_match_status
    )) order by i.sort_order,i.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_items
    from public.healthcare_expense_items i
    left join public.cgd_medical_service_categories cc
      on cc.code=i.cgd_category_code
    where i.expense_id=v_exp.id and i.deleted_at is null;
  end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'link_id',l.id,'link_kind',l.link_kind,
    'title',coalesce(
      nullif(btrim(md.title),''),
      nullif(btrim(sa.metadata->>'display_title'),''),
      nullif(btrim(sa.original_filename),''),
      case l.link_kind
        when 'receipt' then 'ใบเสร็จ'
        when 'payment_slip' then 'สลิปชำระเงิน'
        when 'payment_qr' then 'QR ชำระเงิน'
        else 'หลักฐานการชำระเงิน'
      end
    ),
    'mime_type',coalesce(sa.mime_type,md.mime_type),
    'created_at',l.created_at
  )) order by l.created_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_docs
  from public.appointment_document_links l
  left join public.medical_documents md on md.id=l.medical_document_id
  left join public.phms_storage_assets sa
    on sa.id=coalesce(l.storage_asset_id,md.storage_asset_id)
  where l.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id and v_ref.active_family_person_id is not null and private.user_can_access_family_person(v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,'documents','view')
    and l.link_kind in (
      'receipt','payment_slip','payment_qr','payment_other'
    );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'record_code',substr(v_ref.record_id::text,1,12),
    'person_name',v_ref.target_person_name,
    'hospital_name',v_appt.hospital_name,
    'appointment_at',v_appt.appointment_at,
    'appointment_title',v_appt.title,
    'appointment_department',v_appt.department,
    'appointment_care_topic',v_appt.care_topic,
    'appointment_coverage_type',v_appt.coverage_type,
    'can_update',coalesce(v_sensitive.can_update_appointments,false),
    'expense',case when v_exp.id is null then null else
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',v_exp.id,'expense_date',v_exp.expense_date,
        'currency',btrim(v_exp.currency::text),
        'paid_amount',v_exp.paid_amount,
        'total_amount',v_exp.total_amount,
        'coverage_used',v_exp.coverage_used,
        'coverage_type',v_exp.coverage_type,
        'covered_amount',v_exp.covered_amount,
        'payment_status',v_exp.payment_status,
        'payment_method',v_exp.payment_method,
        'payment_method_code',v_exp.payment_method_code,
        'payer',v_exp.payer,
        'payer_user_id',v_exp.payer_user_id,
        'payer_family_person_id',v_exp.payer_family_person_id,
        'notes',v_exp.notes,
        'payment_recorded_at',v_exp.payment_recorded_at
      )) end,
    'items',v_items,
    'payment_documents',v_docs
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_finance_upsert(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text, p_paid_amount numeric, p_coverage_used boolean DEFAULT false, p_coverage_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_covered_amount numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, p_payment_method text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_payer text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_items jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_payment_method_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_payer_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_payer_family_person_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_appt public.appointments%rowtype;
  v_result jsonb;
  v_had_expense boolean:=false;
  v_expense_id uuid;
  v_person_name text;
  v_event_type text;
  v_title text;
  v_message text;
  v_version text;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,'appointment',p_record_code,'update'
  )
  limit 1;

  select * into v_appt
  from public.appointments
  where id=v_ref.record_id and deleted_at is null
  limit 1;

  if not found then raise exception 'appointment_not_found'; end if;

  select exists(
    select 1
    from public.healthcare_expenses e
    where e.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
      and e.deleted_at is null
  ) into v_had_expense;

  v_result:=public.phms_line_appointment_finance_upsert_core(
    p_line_user_id,
    p_record_code,
    p_paid_amount,
    p_coverage_used,
    p_coverage_type,
    p_covered_amount,
    p_payment_method,
    p_payer,
    p_notes,
    p_items,
    p_payment_method_code,
    p_payer_user_id,
    p_payer_family_person_id
  );

  -- Historical appointments should notify only meaningful record changes,
  -- not assignment/ack chatter. Finance is one of the meaningful changes.
  if v_appt.appointment_at < now() then
    begin
      v_expense_id:=nullif(v_result->>'expense_id','')::uuid;
    exception when others then
      v_expense_id:=null;
    end;

    select coalesce(
      nullif(btrim(p.display_name),''),
      nullif(btrim(p.nickname),''),
      nullif(btrim(concat_ws(' ',p.first_name,p.last_name)),''),
      'ผู้ป่วย'
    )
    into v_person_name
    from public.persons p
    where p.id=v_appt.person_id;

    v_event_type:=case when v_had_expense
      then 'appointment_finance_updated'
      else 'appointment_finance_added'
    end;

    v_title:=case when v_had_expense
      then '💰 แก้ไขค่าใช้จ่ายหลังนัด'
      else '💰 เพิ่มค่าใช้จ่ายหลังนัด'
    end;

    v_message:=concat(
      '👤 ',coalesce(v_person_name,'ผู้ป่วย'),
      E'\n📌 นัดเพื่อ: ',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_appt.title),''),'นัดหมาย'),
      E'\n📆 วันที่นัด: ',to_char(v_appt.appointment_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'),
      E'\n💵 จ่ายจริง: ฿',to_char(coalesce((v_result->>'paid_amount')::numeric,0),'FM999G999G990D00'),
      case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_result->>'coverage_type','')),'') is not null
        then E'\n🏥 สิทธิ/ความคุ้มครอง: '||(v_result->>'coverage_type') else '' end,
      case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_result->>'payer','')),'') is not null
        then E'\n👤 ผู้จ่าย: '||(v_result->>'payer') else '' end
    );

    v_version:=coalesce(
      (
        select to_char(e.payment_recorded_at,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS')
        from public.healthcare_expenses e
        where e.id=v_expense_id
      ),
      to_char(clock_timestamp(),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS')
    );

    with recipients as (
      select r.recipient_user_id as user_id
      from private.phms_notification_recipients(v_appt.person_id,'appointments') r

      union
      select aa.user_id
      from public.appointment_assignees aa
      where aa.appointment_id=v_appt.id
        and aa.user_id is not null
        and aa.status in ('assigned','accepted')
        and private.person_notification_enabled(
          aa.user_id,v_appt.family_person_id,'appointments'
        )

      union
      select ar.recipient_user_id
      from public.appointment_reminders ar
      where ar.appointment_id=v_appt.id
        and ar.recipient_user_id is not null
        and private.person_notification_enabled(
          ar.recipient_user_id,v_appt.family_person_id,'appointments'
        )

      union
      select nt.target_user_id
      from public.record_notification_targets nt
      where nt.record_id=v_appt.id
        and nt.target_type='user'
        and nt.target_user_id is not null
        and nt.enabled=true
        and nt.resource in ('appointment','appointments')
        and private.person_notification_enabled(
          nt.target_user_id,v_appt.family_person_id,'appointments'
        )
    )
    insert into public.notifications(
      family_id,recipient_user_id,person_id,family_person_id,
      event_type,title,message,related_record_id,channel,priority,status,
      scheduled_for,next_attempt_at,payload,dedupe_key,created_at,updated_at
    )
    select
      v_appt.family_id,r.user_id,v_appt.person_id,v_appt.family_person_id,
      v_event_type,v_title,left(v_message,4500),v_appt.id,
      'line','normal','pending',now(),now(),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'appointment_code',substr(v_appt.id::text,1,12),
        'expense_id',v_expense_id,
        'paid_amount',v_result->'paid_amount',
        'coverage_type',v_result->'coverage_type',
        'payer',v_result->'payer',
        'historical_appointment',true
      ),
      'appointment-finance:'||v_appt.id::text||':'||
        coalesce(v_expense_id::text,'none')||':'||v_version||':'||r.user_id::text,
      now(),now()
    from recipients r
    where r.user_id is not null
      and r.user_id is distinct from v_ref.actor_user_id
    on conflict(dedupe_key) where dedupe_key is not null do nothing;
  end if;

  return v_result;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_followup_candidates(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 8)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_prev public.appointments%rowtype;
  v_items jsonb;
  v_limit integer:=greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,8),8));
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,'appointment',p_record_code,'view'
  )
  limit 1;

  select * into v_prev
  from public.appointments
  where id=v_ref.record_id;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'record_id',a.id,
      'record_code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),
      'appointment_at',a.appointment_at,
      'title',a.title,
      'hospital_name',a.hospital_name,
      'department',a.department,
      'doctor_name',a.doctor_name,
      'care_topic',a.care_topic,
      'status',a.status
    ))
    order by a.appointment_at,a.created_at
  ),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from (
    select a.*
    from public.appointments a
    join public.family_persons fp on fp.id=a.family_person_id
    where a.person_id=v_prev.person_id
      and a.id<>v_prev.id
      and a.deleted_at is null
      and a.appointment_at>v_prev.appointment_at
      and a.status not in ('cancelled','no_show')
      and (a.followup_of_appointment_id is null or a.followup_of_appointment_id=v_prev.id)
      and private.user_can_access_family_person(
        v_ref.actor_user_id,fp.id,'appointments','update'
      )
    order by a.appointment_at,a.created_at
    limit v_limit
  ) a;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'previous_record_id',v_prev.id,
    'previous_record_code',substr(v_prev.id::text,1,12),
    'previous_appointment_at',v_prev.appointment_at,
    'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_link_candidates(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 8, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_cur public.appointments%rowtype;
  v_items jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_total int:=0;
  v_group_size int:=1;
  v_limit int:=least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,8),1),12);
  v_offset int:=greatest(coalesce(p_offset,0),0);
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,'appointment',p_record_code,'update'
  ) limit 1;

  select * into v_cur
  from public.appointments
  where id=v_ref.record_id and deleted_at is null;
  if not found then raise exception 'appointment_not_found'; end if;

  select count(*)::int into v_group_size
  from private.phms_appointment_component(v_cur.id,200);

  with component as materialized (
    select appointment_id
    from private.phms_appointment_component(v_cur.id,200)
  ),
  candidates as (
    select
      a.*,
      (comp.appointment_id is not null) as is_connected,
      exists(
        select 1
        from private.appointment_links l
        where l.deleted_at is null
          and (
            (l.appointment_id_a=v_cur.id and l.appointment_id_b=a.id)
            or
            (l.appointment_id_a=a.id and l.appointment_id_b=v_cur.id)
          )
      ) as is_direct_link,
      a.followup_of_appointment_id as linked_previous_id,
      lp.title as linked_previous_title,
      lp.appointment_at as linked_previous_at
    from public.appointments a
    join public.family_persons fp on fp.id=a.family_person_id
    left join component comp on comp.appointment_id=a.id
    left join public.appointments lp on lp.id=a.followup_of_appointment_id
    where a.person_id=v_cur.person_id
      and a.id<>v_cur.id
      and a.deleted_at is null
      and a.status not in ('cancelled','no_show')
      and private.user_can_access_family_person(
        v_ref.actor_user_id,fp.id,'appointments','update'
      )
  )
  select count(*)::int into v_total from candidates;

  with component as materialized (
    select appointment_id
    from private.phms_appointment_component(v_cur.id,200)
  ),
  candidates as (
    select
      a.*,
      (comp.appointment_id is not null) as is_connected,
      exists(
        select 1
        from private.appointment_links l
        where l.deleted_at is null
          and (
            (l.appointment_id_a=v_cur.id and l.appointment_id_b=a.id)
            or
            (l.appointment_id_a=a.id and l.appointment_id_b=v_cur.id)
          )
      ) as is_direct_link,
      a.followup_of_appointment_id as linked_previous_id,
      lp.title as linked_previous_title,
      lp.appointment_at as linked_previous_at
    from public.appointments a
    join public.family_persons fp on fp.id=a.family_person_id
    left join component comp on comp.appointment_id=a.id
    left join public.appointments lp on lp.id=a.followup_of_appointment_id
    where a.person_id=v_cur.person_id
      and a.id<>v_cur.id
      and a.deleted_at is null
      and a.status not in ('cancelled','no_show')
      and private.user_can_access_family_person(
        v_ref.actor_user_id,fp.id,'appointments','update'
      )
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'record_id',c.id,
    'record_code',substr(c.id::text,1,12),
    'appointment_at',c.appointment_at,
    'title',c.title,
    'hospital_name',c.hospital_name,
    'department',c.department,
    'doctor_name',c.doctor_name,
    'care_topic',c.care_topic,
    'status',c.status,
    'is_connected',c.is_connected,
    'is_direct_link',c.is_direct_link,
    'relation_to_current',case
      when c.is_direct_link and c.appointment_at<v_cur.appointment_at then 'previous'
      when c.is_direct_link and c.appointment_at>v_cur.appointment_at then 'next'
      when c.is_connected and c.appointment_at<v_cur.appointment_at then 'connected_previous'
      when c.is_connected and c.appointment_at>v_cur.appointment_at then 'connected_next'
      when c.is_connected then 'connected'
      else 'unlinked'
    end,
    'linked_previous_code',case
      when c.linked_previous_id is not null
      then substr(c.linked_previous_id::text,1,12)
      else null
    end,
    'linked_previous_title',c.linked_previous_title,
    'linked_previous_at',c.linked_previous_at
  )) order by c.appointment_at,c.created_at,c.id),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from (
    select *
    from candidates
    order by appointment_at,created_at,id
    limit v_limit offset v_offset
  ) c;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'record_code',substr(v_cur.id::text,1,12),
    'person_name',v_ref.target_person_name,
    'group_size',v_group_size,
    'current',jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'record_id',v_cur.id,
      'record_code',substr(v_cur.id::text,1,12),
      'appointment_at',v_cur.appointment_at,
      'title',v_cur.title,
      'hospital_name',v_cur.hospital_name,
      'followup_of_record_code',case
        when v_cur.followup_of_appointment_id is not null
        then substr(v_cur.followup_of_appointment_id::text,1,12)
        else null
      end
    )),
    'total_count',v_total,
    'offset',v_offset,
    'limit',v_limit,
    'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_mark_slip_attached(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_count int:=0;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,'appointment',p_record_code,'update'
  )
  limit 1;

  update public.appointment_tasks
  set status='completed',completed_at=coalesce(completed_at,now()),updated_at=now()
  where appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
    and status='pending'
    and task_type='document'
    and title='เพิ่มรูปใบนัด';
  get diagnostics v_count=row_count;

  update public.notifications
  set status='cancelled',
      last_error='appointment_slip_attached',
      updated_at=now(),
      locked_at=null,
      lock_token=null
  where related_record_id=v_ref.record_id
    and event_type='appointment_missing_slip'
    and status in ('pending','failed');

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'appointment_code',substr(v_ref.record_id::text,1,12),
    'completed_task_count',v_count
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_master_contact(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_code text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_record_code,'')));
  v_count int:=0;
  v_appt_id uuid;
  v jsonb;
begin
  if length(v_code)<8 then raise exception 'record_code_too_short'; end if;

  select * into v_line
  from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);

  select count(*)::int
  into v_count
  from public.appointments a
  left join public.family_persons fp on fp.id=a.family_person_id
  where lower(a.id::text) like v_code||'%'
    and a.deleted_at is null
    and (
      (
        fp.id is not null
        and private.user_can_access_family_person(
          v_line.user_id,fp.id,'appointments','update'
        )
      )
      or exists(
        select 1
        from private.appointment_reschedule_requests r
        where r.appointment_id=a.id
          and r.assigned_to_user_id=v_line.user_id
          and r.status in ('pending','in_progress')
      )
    );

  if v_count=0 then
    raise exception 'reschedule_contact_not_accessible';
  end if;
  if v_count>1 then
    raise exception 'appointment_code_ambiguous';
  end if;

  select a.id into v_appt_id
  from public.appointments a
  left join public.family_persons fp on fp.id=a.family_person_id
  where lower(a.id::text) like v_code||'%'
    and a.deleted_at is null
    and (
      (
        fp.id is not null
        and private.user_can_access_family_person(
          v_line.user_id,fp.id,'appointments','update'
        )
      )
      or exists(
        select 1
        from private.appointment_reschedule_requests r
        where r.appointment_id=a.id
          and r.assigned_to_user_id=v_line.user_id
          and r.status in ('pending','in_progress')
      )
    )
  order by a.id::text
  limit 1;

  select jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'hospital_name',o.name,
    'hospital_code',o.external_code,
    'department',u.name,
    'department_code',u.code,
    'phone',coalesce(u.phone,a.contact_phone),
    'email',coalesce(u.email,a.contact_email),
    'location_detail',coalesce(u.location_detail,a.location_detail),
    'contact_note',u.contact_note,
    'reschedule_contact_phone',coalesce(u.reschedule_contact_phone,u.phone,a.contact_phone),
    'reschedule_contact_email',coalesce(u.reschedule_contact_email,u.email,a.contact_email),
    'reschedule_hours_text',u.reschedule_hours_text,
    'reschedule_instructions',u.reschedule_instructions,
    'reschedule_min_notice_minutes',u.reschedule_min_notice_minutes
  ))
  into v
  from public.appointments a
  left join public.healthcare_organizations o on o.id=a.organization_id
  left join public.healthcare_service_units u on u.id=a.service_unit_id
  where a.id=v_appt_id;

  return coalesce(v,'{}'::jsonb);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_notification_workspace(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_appt public.appointments%rowtype;
  v_settings record;
  v_users jsonb;
  v_groups jsonb;
  v_templates jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(p_line_user_id,'appointment',p_record_code,'update')
  limit 1;

  if not coalesce((
    select (coalesce((a.v->>'is_primary_caregiver')::boolean,false)
         or coalesce((a.v->>'is_self_manager')::boolean,false)
         or coalesce((a.v->>'is_authorized_helper')::boolean,false))
    from (select public.phms_line_appointment_action_capabilities(p_line_user_id,p_record_code) v) a
  ),false) then
    raise exception 'appointment_notification_permission_denied';
  end if;

  select * into v_appt
  from public.appointments
  where id=v_ref.record_id and deleted_at is null;
  if not found then raise exception 'appointment_not_found'; end if;

  select
    coalesce(s.days_before,array[3]) days_before,
    coalesce(s.local_time,'09:00'::time) local_time,
    coalesce(s.timezone,'Asia/Bangkok') timezone,
    coalesce(s.recipient_mode,'default') recipient_mode
  into v_settings
  from (select 1) x
  left join public.appointment_notification_settings s on s.appointment_id=v_appt.id;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'user_code',substr(r.recipient_user_id::text,1,12),
    'user_id',r.recipient_user_id,
    'display_name',private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_ref.actor_user_id,v_appt.family_id,r.recipient_user_id),
    'selected',exists(
      select 1 from public.appointment_notification_user_targets t
      where t.appointment_id=v_appt.id and t.user_id=r.recipient_user_id and t.enabled=true
    ),
    'is_self',r.recipient_user_id=v_ref.actor_user_id
  ) order by private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_ref.actor_user_id,v_appt.family_id,r.recipient_user_id)),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_users
  from private.phms_notification_recipients(v_appt.person_id,'appointments') r;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'channel_code',substr(fc.id::text,1,12),
    'family_channel_id',fc.id,
    'channel_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(fc.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
    'selected',exists(
      select 1 from public.appointment_line_group_targets gt
      where gt.appointment_id=v_appt.id
        and gt.line_group_id=fc.external_channel_id
        and gt.status='active'
    )
  ) order by coalesce(fc.channel_name,''),fc.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_groups
  from public.family_channels fc
  where fc.channel_type='line_group'
    and fc.status='active'
    and fc.setup_completed_at is not null
    and coalesce(fc.can_receive_notifications,true)=true
    and exists(
      select 1 from public.family_channel_family_links l
      where l.family_channel_id=fc.id
        and l.family_id=v_appt.family_id
        and l.status='active'
    );

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'template_code',substr(t.id::text,1,12),
    'template_name',t.template_name,
    'days_before',t.days_before,
    'time',to_char(t.local_time,'HH24:MI'),
    'recipient_mode',t.recipient_mode
  ) order by t.template_name),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_templates
  from public.family_notification_templates t
  where t.family_id=v_appt.family_id and t.is_active=true;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'record_code',substr(v_appt.id::text,1,12),
    'appointment_id',v_appt.id,
    'title',v_appt.title,
    'appointment_at',v_appt.appointment_at,
    'family_id',v_appt.family_id,
    'settings',jsonb_build_object(
      'days_before',v_settings.days_before,
      'time',to_char(v_settings.local_time,'HH24:MI'),
      'timezone',v_settings.timezone,
      'recipient_mode',v_settings.recipient_mode,
      'is_default',not exists(select 1 from public.appointment_notification_settings s where s.appointment_id=v_appt.id)
    ),
    'users',v_users,
    'groups',v_groups,
    'templates',v_templates
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_overview(p_line_user_id text, p_upcoming_limit integer DEFAULT 6, p_history_limit integer DEFAULT 4)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ctx record;
  v_up jsonb;
  v_history jsonb;
  v_overdue jsonb;
  v_walk_in_plans jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_ctx
  from private.phms_line_crud_context(
    p_line_user_id,'appointment','view'
  )
  limit 1;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.item order by x.at asc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_up
  from (
    select a.appointment_at at,
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',a.id,
        'code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),
        'title',a.title,
        'hospital_name',a.hospital_name,
        'department',a.department,
        'doctor_name',a.doctor_name,
        'care_topic',a.care_topic,
        'appointment_type',a.appointment_type,
        'appointment_at',a.appointment_at,
        'status',a.status,
        'pending_task_count',(
          select count(*)
          from public.appointment_tasks t
          where t.appointment_id=a.id and t.status='pending'
        )
      )) item
    from public.appointments a
    where a.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and a.deleted_at is null
      and a.status in ('scheduled','confirmed','arrived')
      and a.appointment_at>=now()
    order by a.appointment_at asc
    limit greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_upcoming_limit,6),12))
  ) x;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.item order by x.at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_overdue
  from (
    select a.appointment_at at,
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',a.id,
        'code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),
        'title',a.title,
        'hospital_name',a.hospital_name,
        'department',a.department,
        'doctor_name',a.doctor_name,
        'care_topic',a.care_topic,
        'appointment_type',a.appointment_type,
        'appointment_at',a.appointment_at,
        'status',a.status,
        'pending_task_count',(
          select count(*)
          from public.appointment_tasks t
          where t.appointment_id=a.id and t.status='pending'
        )
      )) item
    from public.appointments a
    where a.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and a.deleted_at is null
      and a.status in ('scheduled','confirmed','arrived')
      and a.appointment_at<now()
    order by a.appointment_at desc
    limit 4
  ) x;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.item order by x.at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_history
  from (
    select coalesce(a.completed_at,a.cancelled_at,a.appointment_at,a.updated_at) at,
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',a.id,
        'code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),
        'title',a.title,
        'hospital_name',a.hospital_name,
        'department',a.department,
        'doctor_name',a.doctor_name,
        'care_topic',a.care_topic,
        'appointment_type',a.appointment_type,
        'appointment_at',a.appointment_at,
        'status',a.status,
        'pending_task_count',(
          select count(*)
          from public.appointment_tasks t
          where t.appointment_id=a.id and t.status='pending'
        )
      )) item
    from public.appointments a
    where a.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and a.deleted_at is null
      and a.status in ('completed','cancelled','no_show','rescheduled')
    order by coalesce(a.completed_at,a.cancelled_at,a.appointment_at,a.updated_at) desc
    limit greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_history_limit,4),10))
  ) x;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(z.item order by z.day),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_walk_in_plans
  from (
    select a.planned_visit_date as day,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id',a.id,
        'code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),
        'title',a.title,
        'appointment_type',a.appointment_type,
        'hospital_name',a.hospital_name,
        'care_topic',a.care_topic,
        'planned_visit_date',a.planned_visit_date,
        'visit_time_known',false,
        'visit_mode','walk_in',
        'status',a.status,
        'walk_in_reason',a.walk_in_reason
      ) as item
    from public.appointments a
    where a.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and a.deleted_at is null and a.visit_mode='walk_in'
      and a.visit_time_known=false and a.appointment_at is null
      and a.status='scheduled'
      and a.planned_visit_date >= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date
    order by a.planned_visit_date,a.created_at
    limit 8
  ) z;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'person_id',v_ctx.target_person_id,
    'person_name',v_ctx.target_person_name,
    'upcoming',v_up,
    'walk_in_plans',v_walk_in_plans,
    'overdue',v_overdue,
    'history',v_history,
    'upcoming_count',jsonb_array_length(v_up),
    'overdue_count',jsonb_array_length(v_overdue),
    'history_count',jsonb_array_length(v_history)
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_payer_options(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_items jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,'appointment',p_record_code,'update'
  )
  limit 1;

  with person_rows as (
    select
      0 as kind_order,
      fp.id::text as stable_id,
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'selection_kind','person',
        'selection_id',fp.id,
        'family_person_id',fp.id,
        'user_id',p.linked_user_id,
        'display_name',private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_ref.actor_user_id,fp.id),
        'relationship_label',case
          when p.linked_user_id=v_ref.actor_user_id then 'ฉัน'
          else null
        end,
        'is_self',coalesce(p.linked_user_id=v_ref.actor_user_id,false),
        'account_linked',p.linked_user_id is not null
      )) as item
    from public.family_persons fp
    join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
    where fp.family_id=v_ref.active_family_id
      and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
      and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
      and private.family_person_is_visible_to_user(v_ref.actor_user_id,fp.id)
  ),
  account_only_rows as (
    select
      1 as kind_order,
      fm.user_id::text as stable_id,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'selection_kind','user',
        'selection_id',fm.user_id,
        'user_id',fm.user_id,
        'display_name',private.family_user_label_for_viewer(
          v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_id,fm.user_id
        ),
        'relationship_label',case when fm.user_id=v_ref.actor_user_id then 'ฉัน' else null end,
        'is_self',fm.user_id=v_ref.actor_user_id,
        'account_linked',true
      ) as item
    from public.family_memberships fm
    where fm.family_id=v_ref.active_family_id
      and fm.status='active'
      and fm.user_id is not null
      and not exists(
        select 1
        from public.family_persons fp
        join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
        where fp.family_id=fm.family_id
          and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
          and p.linked_user_id=fm.user_id
      )
  ),
  all_rows as (
    select * from person_rows
    union all
    select * from account_only_rows
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(item order by
    coalesce((item->>'is_self')::boolean,false) desc,
    kind_order,
    lower(item->>'display_name'),
    stable_id
  ),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from all_rows;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'record_code',substr(v_ref.record_id::text,1,12),
    'person_name',v_ref.target_person_name,
    'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_post_visit(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text, p_outcome_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_followup_required boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_old jsonb;
  v_new jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,'appointment',p_record_code,'update'
  ) limit 1;

  select to_jsonb(a) into v_old
  from public.appointments a
  where a.id=v_ref.record_id;

  update public.appointments
  set visit_outcome_notes=case
        when nullif(btrim(p_outcome_notes),'') is not null then btrim(p_outcome_notes)
        else visit_outcome_notes
      end,
      followup_required=coalesce(p_followup_required,followup_required),
      followup_recorded_at=now(),
      updated_at=now()
  where id=v_ref.record_id;

  update public.appointment_reminders
  set status='cancelled',updated_at=now()
  where appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
    and rule_key='auto_post_visit'
    and status in ('pending','failed');

  update public.notifications
  set status='cancelled',
      last_error='post_visit_already_recorded',
      updated_at=now(),
      locked_at=null,
      lock_token=null
  where related_record_id=v_ref.record_id
    and event_type='appointment_post_visit'
    and status in ('pending','failed');

  select to_jsonb(a) into v_new
  from public.appointments a
  where a.id=v_ref.record_id;

  insert into public.audit_logs(
    family_id,actor_user_id,family_person_id,event_type,resource,record_id,
    old_data,new_data,description
  )
  values(
    v_ref.active_family_id,v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,
    'appointment_post_visit','appointment',v_ref.record_id,
    v_old,v_new,'บันทึกข้อมูลหลังนัด'
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,'record_code',substr(v_ref.record_id::text,1,12),
    'followup_required',(v_new->>'followup_required')::boolean,
    'post_visit_reminder_cancelled',true,
    'item',v_new
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_post_visit_summary_notify(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_appt public.appointments%rowtype;
  v_person_name text;
  v_summary jsonb;
  v_title text;
  v_message text;
  v_user_count integer := 0;
  v_group_count integer := 0;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,'appointment',p_record_code,'update'
  )
  limit 1;

  select a.* into v_appt
  from public.appointments a
  where a.id=v_ref.record_id
    and a.deleted_at is null;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'appointment_not_found';
  end if;

  if v_appt.followup_recorded_at is null then
    raise exception 'post_visit_summary_not_recorded';
  end if;

  select coalesce(
    nullif(btrim(p.display_name),''),
    nullif(btrim(p.nickname),''),
    nullif(btrim(concat_ws(' ',p.first_name,p.last_name)),''),
    'ผู้ป่วย'
  )
  into v_person_name
  from public.persons p
  where p.id=v_appt.person_id;

  v_summary := jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'schema','appointment_post_visit_summary_v1',
    'appointment_id',v_appt.id,
    'appointment_code',substr(v_appt.id::text,1,12),
    'person_id',v_appt.person_id,
    'person_name',coalesce(v_person_name,'ผู้ป่วย'),
    'appointment_title',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_appt.title),''),'นัดหมาย'),
    'appointment_at',v_appt.appointment_at,
    'hospital_name',nullif(btrim(v_appt.hospital_name),''),
    'department',nullif(btrim(v_appt.department),''),
    'doctor_name',nullif(btrim(v_appt.doctor_name),''),
    'diagnosis_summary',nullif(btrim(v_appt.diagnosis_summary),''),
    'treatment_summary',nullif(btrim(v_appt.treatment_summary),''),
    'next_steps',nullif(btrim(v_appt.next_steps),''),
    'medication_plan_notes',nullif(btrim(v_appt.medication_plan_notes),''),
    'test_results_summary',nullif(btrim(v_appt.test_results_summary),''),
    'followup_required',v_appt.followup_required,
    'followup_recorded_at',v_appt.followup_recorded_at,
    'updated_at',v_appt.updated_at
  ));

  v_title := '🩺 สรุปหลังนัด • '||coalesce(v_person_name,'ผู้ป่วย');

  v_message := concat(
    '📌 นัดเพื่อ: ',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_appt.title),''),'นัดหมาย'),
    case when v_appt.appointment_at is not null
      then E'\n📆 วันที่นัด: '||to_char(v_appt.appointment_at at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')
      else '' end,
    case when nullif(btrim(v_appt.hospital_name),'') is not null
      then E'\n🏥 สถานพยาบาล: '||v_appt.hospital_name else '' end,
    case when nullif(btrim(v_appt.department),'') is not null
      then E'\n🏢 แผนก/คลินิก: '||v_appt.department else '' end,
    case when nullif(btrim(v_appt.doctor_name),'') is not null
      then E'\n👨‍⚕️ แพทย์: '||v_appt.doctor_name else '' end,
    E'\n',
    case when nullif(btrim(v_appt.diagnosis_summary),'') is not null
      then E'\n🔎 วินิจฉัย/ความเห็นแพทย์\n'||v_appt.diagnosis_summary else '' end,
    case when nullif(btrim(v_appt.treatment_summary),'') is not null
      then E'\n\n🩹 การรักษาครั้งนี้\n'||v_appt.treatment_summary else '' end,
    case when nullif(btrim(v_appt.next_steps),'') is not null
      then E'\n\n➡️ ต้องทำอะไรต่อ\n'||v_appt.next_steps else '' end,
    case when nullif(btrim(v_appt.medication_plan_notes),'') is not null
      then E'\n\n💊 ยา/การเปลี่ยนยา\n'||v_appt.medication_plan_notes else '' end,
    case when nullif(btrim(v_appt.test_results_summary),'') is not null
      then E'\n\n🧪 ผลตรวจ\n'||v_appt.test_results_summary else '' end,
    E'\n\n📅 มีนัดต่อ: ',
    case when v_appt.followup_required is true then 'ใช่'
         when v_appt.followup_required is false then 'ไม่'
         else 'ยังไม่ทราบ' end
  );

  with recipients as (
    select r.recipient_user_id as user_id
    from private.phms_notification_recipients(v_appt.person_id,'appointments') r

    union

    select aa.user_id
    from public.appointment_assignees aa
    where aa.appointment_id=v_appt.id
      and aa.user_id is not null
      and aa.status in ('assigned','accepted')
      and private.person_notification_enabled(
        aa.user_id,v_appt.family_person_id,'appointments'
      )

    union

    select ar.recipient_user_id
    from public.appointment_reminders ar
    where ar.appointment_id=v_appt.id
      and ar.recipient_user_id is not null
      and private.person_notification_enabled(
        ar.recipient_user_id,v_appt.family_person_id,'appointments'
      )

    union

    select nt.target_user_id
    from public.record_notification_targets nt
    where nt.record_id=v_appt.id
      and nt.target_type='user'
      and nt.target_user_id is not null
      and nt.enabled=true
      and nt.resource in ('appointment','appointments')
      and private.person_notification_enabled(
        nt.target_user_id,v_appt.family_person_id,'appointments'
      )
  ),
  inserted as (
    insert into public.notifications(
      family_id,recipient_user_id,person_id,family_person_id,
      event_type,title,message,related_record_id,
      channel,priority,status,scheduled_for,next_attempt_at,
      payload,dedupe_key,created_at,updated_at
    )
    select
      v_appt.family_id,r.user_id,v_appt.person_id,v_appt.family_person_id,
      'appointment_post_visit_summary',v_title,left(v_message,4500),v_appt.id,
      'line','normal','pending',now(),now(),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'appointment_code',substr(v_appt.id::text,1,12),
        'appointment_status',v_appt.status,
        'post_visit_summary',v_summary,
        'summary_schema','appointment_post_visit_summary_v1',
        'line_destination_type','user'
      ),
      'appointment-post-visit-summary:'||v_appt.id::text||':user:'||r.user_id::text,
      now(),now()
    from recipients r
    where r.user_id is not null
      and r.user_id is distinct from v_ref.actor_user_id
    on conflict(dedupe_key) where dedupe_key is not null do update set
      title=excluded.title,
      message=excluded.message,
      payload=excluded.payload,
      status='pending',
      scheduled_for=now(),
      next_attempt_at=now(),
      attempt_count=0,
      sent_at=null,
      last_error=null,
      locked_at=null,
      lock_token=null,
      updated_at=now()
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*)::int into v_user_count from inserted;

  with groups as (
    select gt.line_group_id
    from public.appointment_line_group_targets gt
    where gt.appointment_id=v_appt.id
      and gt.status='active'

    union

    select nt.line_group_id
    from public.record_notification_targets nt
    where nt.record_id=v_appt.id
      and nt.target_type='line_group'
      and nt.line_group_id is not null
      and nt.enabled=true
      and nt.resource in ('appointment','appointments')
  ),
  inserted as (
    insert into public.notifications(
      family_id,recipient_user_id,person_id,family_person_id,
      event_type,title,message,related_record_id,
      channel,priority,status,scheduled_for,next_attempt_at,
      payload,dedupe_key,created_at,updated_at
    )
    select
      v_appt.family_id,null,v_appt.person_id,v_appt.family_person_id,
      'appointment_post_visit_summary',v_title,left(v_message,4500),v_appt.id,
      'line','normal','pending',now(),now(),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'appointment_code',substr(v_appt.id::text,1,12),
        'appointment_status',v_appt.status,
        'post_visit_summary',v_summary,
        'summary_schema','appointment_post_visit_summary_v1',
        'line_destination_type','group',
        'line_destination_id',g.line_group_id
      ),
      'appointment-post-visit-summary:'||v_appt.id::text||':group:'||
        substr(encode(digest(g.line_group_id,'sha256'),'hex'),1,24),
      now(),now()
    from groups g
    where nullif(btrim(g.line_group_id),'') is not null
    on conflict(dedupe_key) where dedupe_key is not null do update set
      title=excluded.title,
      message=excluded.message,
      payload=excluded.payload,
      status='pending',
      scheduled_for=now(),
      next_attempt_at=now(),
      attempt_count=0,
      sent_at=null,
      last_error=null,
      locked_at=null,
      lock_token=null,
      updated_at=now()
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*)::int into v_group_count from inserted;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'record_code',substr(v_appt.id::text,1,12),
    'summary',v_summary,
    'queued_user_notifications',v_user_count,
    'queued_group_notifications',v_group_count,
    'actor_receives_reply_card',true
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_set_document_preparation(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text, p_link_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_link public.appointment_document_links%rowtype;
  v_title text;
  v_task public.appointment_tasks%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,'appointment',p_record_code,'update'
  ) limit 1;
  if v_ref.active_family_person_id is null or not private.user_can_access_family_person(v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,'documents','update') then raise exception 'document_permission_denied';end if;


  select * into v_link
  from public.appointment_document_links
  where id=p_link_id
    and appointment_id=v_ref.record_id;
  if not found then raise exception 'appointment_document_link_not_found'; end if;

  select coalesce(
    nullif(btrim(md.title),''),
    nullif(btrim(sa.metadata->>'display_title'),''),
    nullif(btrim(sa.original_filename),''),
    'เอกสาร'
  )
  into v_title
  from (select 1) q
  left join public.medical_documents md
    on md.id=v_link.medical_document_id
  left join public.phms_storage_assets sa
    on sa.id=coalesce(v_link.storage_asset_id,md.storage_asset_id);

  insert into public.appointment_tasks(
    appointment_id,task_type,title,instruction,status,
    source_document_id,source_document_link_id,created_by,source_key
  )
  values(
    v_ref.record_id,'document',
    'เตรียมเอกสาร: '||coalesce(v_title,'เอกสาร'),
    'ตรวจว่าเอกสารพร้อมและนำไปในวันนัด',
    'pending',
    v_link.medical_document_id,v_link.id,v_ref.actor_user_id,
    'document_link:'||v_link.id::text
  )
  on conflict(appointment_id,source_document_link_id)
    where source_document_link_id is not null
  do update set
    title=excluded.title,
    instruction=coalesce(public.appointment_tasks.instruction,excluded.instruction),
    status=case
      when public.appointment_tasks.status='cancelled' then 'pending'
      else public.appointment_tasks.status
    end,
    updated_at=now()
  returning * into v_task;

  insert into public.audit_logs(
    family_id,actor_user_id,family_person_id,event_type,resource,record_id,
    new_data,description
  ) values(
    v_ref.active_family_id,v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,
    'appointment_document_preparation_added','appointment',v_ref.record_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'task_id',v_task.id,
      'document_link_id',v_link.id,
      'title',v_task.title
    ),
    'เพิ่มเอกสารเป็นรายการเตรียมก่อนนัด'
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'appointment_code',substr(v_ref.record_id::text,1,12),
    'task_code',substr(v_task.id::text,1,12),
    'document_link_id',v_link.id,
    'status',v_task.status,
    'title',v_task.title
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_set_previous_relation(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text, p_previous_record_code text, p_relation text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_current public.appointments%rowtype;
  v_prev public.appointments%rowtype;
  v_relation text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_relation,'')));
  v_count int:=0;
begin
  if v_relation not in ('follow_up','referral','rescheduled','investigation') then
    raise exception 'invalid_appointment_relation';
  end if;

  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_line_appointment_access(
    p_line_user_id,p_record_code
  ) limit 1;
  if coalesce(v_ref.can_update,false) is not true then
    raise exception 'appointment_relation_update_denied';
  end if;

  select * into v_current
  from public.appointments
  where id=v_ref.record_id and deleted_at is null
  for update;

  select count(*)::int into v_count
  from public.appointments a
  where a.person_id=v_current.person_id
    and a.id<>v_current.id
    and a.deleted_at is null
    and lower(a.id::text) like lower(btrim(p_previous_record_code))||'%';

  if v_count=0 then raise exception 'previous_appointment_not_found'; end if;
  if v_count>1 then raise exception 'previous_appointment_ambiguous'; end if;

  select * into v_prev
  from public.appointments a
  where a.person_id=v_current.person_id
    and a.id<>v_current.id
    and a.deleted_at is null
    and lower(a.id::text) like lower(btrim(p_previous_record_code))||'%'
  limit 1;

  if v_current.appointment_at is not null
     and v_prev.appointment_at is not null
     and v_prev.appointment_at>=v_current.appointment_at then
    raise exception 'previous_appointment_must_be_earlier';
  end if;

  if v_relation='follow_up' then
    update public.appointments
    set appointment_type='follow_up',
        followup_of_appointment_id=v_prev.id,
        referral_from_appointment_id=null,
        referral_source_kind=null,
        rescheduled_from_appointment_id=null,
        updated_at=now()
    where id=v_current.id;
  elsif v_relation='referral' then
    update public.appointments
    set appointment_type='referral',
        referral_from_appointment_id=v_prev.id,
        referral_source_kind='internal_appointment',
        followup_of_appointment_id=null,
        rescheduled_from_appointment_id=null,
        updated_at=now()
    where id=v_current.id;
  elsif v_relation='investigation' then
    update public.appointments
    set appointment_type='investigation',
        investigation_of_appointment_id=v_prev.id,
        updated_at=now()
    where id=v_current.id;
  else
    update public.appointments
    set appointment_type='rescheduled',
        rescheduled_from_appointment_id=v_prev.id,
        followup_of_appointment_id=null,
        referral_from_appointment_id=null,
        referral_source_kind=null,
        updated_at=now()
    where id=v_current.id;

    update public.appointments
    set status=case when status in ('scheduled','confirmed','arrived') then 'rescheduled' else status end,
        last_change_reason=coalesce(last_change_reason,'เลื่อนมาเป็นนัดใหม่'),
        updated_at=now()
    where id=v_prev.id;
  end if;

  insert into public.audit_logs(
    family_id,actor_user_id,family_person_id,
    event_type,resource,record_id,new_data,description
  )
  values(
    v_current.family_id,v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,
    'appointment_relation_set','appointment',v_current.id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'relation',v_relation,
      'previous_appointment_id',v_prev.id,
      'previous_title',v_prev.title,
      'previous_appointment_at',v_prev.appointment_at
    ),
    case
      when v_relation='follow_up' then 'เชื่อมนัดติดตามกับนัดก่อนหน้า'
      when v_relation='referral' then 'ระบุว่านัดนี้ส่งต่อมาจากนัดก่อนหน้า'
      when v_relation='investigation' then 'เชื่อมนัดตรวจเพิ่มเติมกับนัดที่สั่งตรวจ'
      else 'ระบุว่านัดนี้เลื่อนมาจากนัดก่อนหน้า'
    end
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'record_code',substr(v_current.id::text,1,12),
    'relation',v_relation,
    'previous_record_code',substr(v_prev.id::text,1,12),
    'previous_title',v_prev.title,
    'previous_appointment_at',v_prev.appointment_at
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_task_evidence_candidates(p_line_user_id text, p_task_code text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 6, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_code text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_task_code,'')));
  v_count int;
  v_task public.appointment_tasks%rowtype;
  v_ref record;
  v_appt public.appointments%rowtype;
  v_limit int:=least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,6),1),20);
  v_offset int:=greatest(coalesce(p_offset,0),0);
  v_items jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_total int:=0;
  v_selected_count int:=0;
begin
  if length(v_code)<8 then raise exception 'task_code_too_short'; end if;

  select count(*) into v_count
  from public.appointment_tasks t
  where lower(t.id::text) like v_code||'%';
  if v_count=0 then raise exception 'task_not_found'; end if;
  if v_count>1 then raise exception 'task_code_ambiguous'; end if;

  select * into v_task
  from public.appointment_tasks t
  where lower(t.id::text) like v_code||'%'
  limit 1;

  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,'appointment',substr(v_task.appointment_id::text,1,12),'update'
  )
  limit 1;
 if v_ref.active_family_person_id is null or not private.user_can_access_family_person(v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,'documents','update') then raise exception 'document_permission_denied';end if;


  select * into v_appt
  from public.appointments a
  where a.id=v_task.appointment_id and a.deleted_at is null;
  if not found then raise exception 'appointment_not_found'; end if;

  select count(*)::int into v_selected_count
  from private.appointment_task_evidence e
  where e.task_id=v_task.id;

  with available as (
    select
      a.id as asset_id,
      a.bucket_id,
      a.object_name,
      a.mime_type,
      a.original_filename,
      a.lifecycle_state,
      coalesce(a.captured_at,a.created_at) as item_date,
      a.created_by,
      coalesce(
        nullif(btrim(a.metadata->>'display_title'),''),
        nullif(btrim(md.title),''),
        nullif(btrim(a.original_filename),''),
        case
          when lower(coalesce(a.mime_type,''))='application/pdf' then 'เอกสาร PDF'
          else 'รูป/เอกสาร'
        end
      ) as title
    from public.phms_storage_assets a
    left join lateral (
      select d.title,d.storage_asset_id
      from public.medical_documents d
      where d.storage_asset_id=a.id and d.deleted_at is null
      order by d.updated_at desc nulls last,d.created_at desc
      limit 1
    ) md on true
    where a.person_id=v_appt.person_id
      and a.deleted_at is null
      and a.lifecycle_state<>'deleted'
      and lower(coalesce(a.mime_type,'')) in (
        'image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp','application/pdf'
      )
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from private.appointment_task_evidence e
        join public.appointment_document_links l
          on l.id=e.appointment_document_link_id
        left join public.medical_documents d
          on d.id=l.medical_document_id
        where e.task_id=v_task.id
          and coalesce(l.storage_asset_id,d.storage_asset_id)=a.id
      )
  )
  select count(*)::int into v_total from available;

  with available as (
    select
      a.id as asset_id,
      a.bucket_id,
      a.object_name,
      a.mime_type,
      a.original_filename,
      a.lifecycle_state,
      coalesce(a.captured_at,a.created_at) as item_date,
      a.created_by,
      coalesce(
        nullif(btrim(a.metadata->>'display_title'),''),
        nullif(btrim(md.title),''),
        nullif(btrim(a.original_filename),''),
        case
          when lower(coalesce(a.mime_type,''))='application/pdf' then 'เอกสาร PDF'
          else 'รูป/เอกสาร'
        end
      ) as title
    from public.phms_storage_assets a
    left join lateral (
      select d.title,d.storage_asset_id
      from public.medical_documents d
      where d.storage_asset_id=a.id and d.deleted_at is null
      order by d.updated_at desc nulls last,d.created_at desc
      limit 1
    ) md on true
    where a.person_id=v_appt.person_id
      and a.deleted_at is null
      and a.lifecycle_state<>'deleted'
      and lower(coalesce(a.mime_type,'')) in (
        'image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp','application/pdf'
      )
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from private.appointment_task_evidence e
        join public.appointment_document_links l
          on l.id=e.appointment_document_link_id
        left join public.medical_documents d
          on d.id=l.medical_document_id
        where e.task_id=v_task.id
          and coalesce(l.storage_asset_id,d.storage_asset_id)=a.id
      )
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'asset_id',x.asset_id,
    'bucket_id',x.bucket_id,
    'object_name',x.object_name,
    'mime_type',x.mime_type,
    'title',x.title,
    'item_date',x.item_date,
    'lifecycle_state',x.lifecycle_state,
    'created_by',x.created_by,
    'created_by_name',case
      when x.created_by is null then null
      when v_ref.active_family_id is not null
        then private.family_user_label_for_viewer(
          v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_id,x.created_by
        )
      else coalesce(
        (select nullif(btrim(p.display_name),'') from public.profiles p where p.id=x.created_by),
        'ผู้ใช้'
      )
    end
  )) order by x.item_date desc,x.asset_id desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from (
    select *
    from available
    order by item_date desc,asset_id desc
    limit v_limit offset v_offset
  ) x;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'appointment_code',substr(v_task.appointment_id::text,1,12),
    'task_code',substr(v_task.id::text,1,12),
    'task_title',v_task.title,
    'task_status',v_task.status,
    'selected_count',v_selected_count,
    'available_count',v_total,
    'offset',v_offset,
    'limit',v_limit,
    'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_task_evidence_list(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_items jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,'appointment',p_record_code,'view'
  ) limit 1;
 if v_ref.active_family_person_id is null or not private.user_can_access_family_person(v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,'documents','view') then raise exception 'document_permission_denied';end if;


  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'evidence_id',e.id,
    'task_code',substr(t.id::text,1,12),
    'task_title',t.title,
    'link_id',l.id,
    'storage_asset_id',coalesce(l.storage_asset_id,md.storage_asset_id),
    'medical_document_id',l.medical_document_id,
    'title',coalesce(
      nullif(btrim(md.title),''),
      nullif(btrim(sa.metadata->>'display_title'),''),
      nullif(btrim(sa.original_filename),''),
      'รูปหลักฐาน: '||t.title
    ),
    'mime_type',coalesce(sa.mime_type,md.mime_type),
    'bucket_id',coalesce(sa.bucket_id,md.storage_bucket),
    'object_name',coalesce(sa.object_name,md.storage_path),
    'link_kind',l.link_kind,
    'usage_relation',l.usage_relation,
    'origin_appointment_code',case
      when l.origin_appointment_id is not null then substr(l.origin_appointment_id::text,1,12)
      else null
    end,
    'origin_title',oa.title,
    'origin_appointment_at',oa.appointment_at,
    'evidence_type',e.evidence_type,
    'note',e.note,
    'created_at',e.created_at
  )) order by e.created_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from private.appointment_task_evidence e
  join public.appointment_tasks t on t.id=e.task_id
  join public.appointment_document_links l on l.id=e.appointment_document_link_id
  left join public.medical_documents md on md.id=l.medical_document_id
  left join public.phms_storage_assets sa on sa.id=coalesce(l.storage_asset_id,md.storage_asset_id)
  left join public.appointments oa on oa.id=l.origin_appointment_id
  where t.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
    and (coalesce(l.link_kind,'') not in ('receipt','payment_slip','payment_qr','payment_other')
      or private.user_can_access_family_person(v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,'expenses','view'));

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'appointment_code',substr(v_ref.record_id::text,1,12),
    'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_unlinked_assets(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_items jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_total int:=0;
  v_limit int:=least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,10),1),20);
  v_offset int:=greatest(coalesce(p_offset,0),0);
  v_followup_of uuid;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,'appointment',p_record_code,'update'
  )
  limit 1;
 if v_ref.active_family_person_id is null or not private.user_can_access_family_person(v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,'documents','update') then raise exception 'document_permission_denied';end if;


  select a.followup_of_appointment_id
  into v_followup_of
  from public.appointments a
  where a.id=v_ref.record_id;

  with eligible as (
    select
      a.*,
      coalesce(
        nullif(btrim(a.metadata->>'display_title'),''),
        nullif(btrim(md.title),''),
        nullif(btrim(a.original_filename),''),
        'รูป/เอกสาร'
      ) display_title,
      md.document_type,
      origin.origin_appointment_id,
      origin.origin_title,
      origin.origin_hospital_name,
      origin.origin_appointment_at,
      origin.origin_care_topic,
      origin.used_in_appointment_count,
      exists(
        select 1
        from public.appointment_document_links lp
        where lp.storage_asset_id=a.id
          and v_followup_of is not null
          and lp.appointment_id=v_followup_of
      ) as from_followup_source
    from public.phms_storage_assets a
    left join lateral (
      select d.title,d.document_type
      from public.medical_documents d
      where d.storage_asset_id=a.id
        and d.deleted_at is null
      order by d.created_at desc
      limit 1
    ) md on true
    left join lateral (
      select
        coalesce(l.origin_appointment_id,l.appointment_id) as origin_appointment_id,
        oa.title as origin_title,
        oa.hospital_name as origin_hospital_name,
        oa.appointment_at as origin_appointment_at,
        oa.care_topic as origin_care_topic,
        (
          select count(distinct lx.appointment_id)::int
          from public.appointment_document_links lx
          where lx.storage_asset_id=a.id
        ) as used_in_appointment_count
