      from public.appointment_document_links l
      left join public.appointments oa
        on oa.id=coalesce(l.origin_appointment_id,l.appointment_id)
      where l.storage_asset_id=a.id
      order by
        case when l.appointment_id=v_followup_of then 0 else 1 end,
        case when l.usage_relation='origin' then 0 else 1 end,
        l.created_at,
        l.id
      limit 1
    ) origin on true
    where a.person_id=v_ref.target_person_id
      and a.deleted_at is null
      and a.lifecycle_state<>'deleted'
      and (
        a.lifecycle_state<>'temporary'
        or coalesce((a.metadata->>'retain_for_provenance')::boolean,false)=true
        or exists(
          select 1
          from public.appointment_document_links lkeep
          where lkeep.storage_asset_id=a.id
        )
        or exists(
          select 1
          from public.medical_documents dkeep
          where dkeep.storage_asset_id=a.id
            and dkeep.deleted_at is null
        )
      )
      and not exists(
        select 1
        from public.appointment_document_links l
        where l.storage_asset_id=a.id
          and l.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
      )
      and private.phms_user_can_access_person_explicit(
        v_ref.actor_user_id,
        a.person_id,
        case a.permission_resource
          when 'medication' then 'medications'
          when 'medications' then 'medications'
          when 'appointment' then 'appointments'
          when 'appointments' then 'appointments'
          else 'health_data'
        end,
        'view'
      )
  )
  select count(*)::int
  into v_total
  from eligible;

  with eligible as (
    select
      a.*,
      coalesce(
        nullif(btrim(a.metadata->>'display_title'),''),
        nullif(btrim(md.title),''),
        nullif(btrim(a.original_filename),''),
        'รูป/เอกสาร'
      ) display_title,
      md.document_type,
      origin.origin_appointment_id,
      origin.origin_title,
      origin.origin_hospital_name,
      origin.origin_appointment_at,
      origin.origin_care_topic,
      origin.used_in_appointment_count,
      exists(
        select 1
        from public.appointment_document_links lp
        where lp.storage_asset_id=a.id
          and v_followup_of is not null
          and lp.appointment_id=v_followup_of
      ) as from_followup_source
    from public.phms_storage_assets a
    left join lateral (
      select d.title,d.document_type
      from public.medical_documents d
      where d.storage_asset_id=a.id
        and d.deleted_at is null
      order by d.created_at desc
      limit 1
    ) md on true
    left join lateral (
      select
        coalesce(l.origin_appointment_id,l.appointment_id) as origin_appointment_id,
        oa.title as origin_title,
        oa.hospital_name as origin_hospital_name,
        oa.appointment_at as origin_appointment_at,
        oa.care_topic as origin_care_topic,
        (
          select count(distinct lx.appointment_id)::int
          from public.appointment_document_links lx
          where lx.storage_asset_id=a.id
        ) as used_in_appointment_count
      from public.appointment_document_links l
      left join public.appointments oa
        on oa.id=coalesce(l.origin_appointment_id,l.appointment_id)
      where l.storage_asset_id=a.id
      order by
        case when l.appointment_id=v_followup_of then 0 else 1 end,
        case when l.usage_relation='origin' then 0 else 1 end,
        l.created_at,
        l.id
      limit 1
    ) origin on true
    where a.person_id=v_ref.target_person_id
      and a.deleted_at is null
      and a.lifecycle_state<>'deleted'
      and (
        a.lifecycle_state<>'temporary'
        or coalesce((a.metadata->>'retain_for_provenance')::boolean,false)=true
        or exists(
          select 1
          from public.appointment_document_links lkeep
          where lkeep.storage_asset_id=a.id
        )
        or exists(
          select 1
          from public.medical_documents dkeep
          where dkeep.storage_asset_id=a.id
            and dkeep.deleted_at is null
        )
      )
      and not exists(
        select 1
        from public.appointment_document_links l
        where l.storage_asset_id=a.id
          and l.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
      )
      and private.phms_user_can_access_person_explicit(
        v_ref.actor_user_id,
        a.person_id,
        case a.permission_resource
          when 'medication' then 'medications'
          when 'medications' then 'medications'
          when 'appointment' then 'appointments'
          when 'appointments' then 'appointments'
          else 'health_data'
        end,
        'view'
      )
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'asset_id',e.id,
      'title',e.display_title,
      'document_type',e.document_type,
      'mime_type',e.mime_type,
      'bucket_id',e.bucket_id,
      'object_name',e.object_name,
      'item_date',coalesce(e.captured_at,e.created_at),
      'origin_appointment_code',case
        when e.origin_appointment_id is not null
        then substr(e.origin_appointment_id::text,1,12)
        else null
      end,
      'origin_title',e.origin_title,
      'origin_hospital_name',e.origin_hospital_name,
      'origin_appointment_at',e.origin_appointment_at,
      'origin_care_topic',e.origin_care_topic,
      'used_in_appointment_count',coalesce(e.used_in_appointment_count,0),
      'from_followup_source',e.from_followup_source,
      'created_by_name',case
        when e.created_by is null then 'ระบบ'
        else private.family_user_label_for_viewer(
          v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_id,e.created_by
        )
      end
    ))
    order by
      case when e.from_followup_source then 0 else 1 end,
      coalesce(e.origin_appointment_at,e.captured_at,e.created_at) desc
  ),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from (
    select *
    from eligible
    order by
      case when from_followup_source then 0 else 1 end,
      coalesce(origin_appointment_at,captured_at,created_at) desc,
      id desc
    limit v_limit offset v_offset
  ) e;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'total_count',v_total,
    'offset',v_offset,
    'limit',v_limit,
    'followup_of_appointment_code',case
      when v_followup_of is not null then substr(v_followup_of::text,1,12)
      else null
    end,
    'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_update_v2(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text, p_patch jsonb, p_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_old jsonb;
  v_new jsonb;
  v_audit_id uuid;
  v_time_changed boolean;
  v_other_changed boolean;
  v_reason text:=coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_reason),''),'แก้ไขรายละเอียดนัด');
  v_rec record;
  v_ack_id uuid;
  v_arrival int;
begin
  if p_patch is null or jsonb_typeof(p_patch)<>'object' then
    raise exception 'appointment_patch_required';
  end if;

  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,'appointment',p_record_code,'update'
  ) limit 1;

  select to_jsonb(a) into v_old from public.appointments a where a.id=v_ref.record_id;

  if p_patch?'appointment_at'
     and private.phms_try_timestamptz(p_patch->>'appointment_at') is null then
    raise exception 'invalid_appointment_at';
  end if;

  if p_patch?'arrival_lead_minutes' then
    if coalesce(p_patch->>'arrival_lead_minutes','') !~ '^[0-9]+$' then
      raise exception 'invalid_arrival_lead_minutes';
    end if;
    v_arrival:=greatest(0,least((p_patch->>'arrival_lead_minutes')::int,720));
  end if;

  update public.appointments
  set title=case when p_patch?'title' then nullif(btrim(p_patch->>'title'),'') else title end,
      hospital_name=case when p_patch?'hospital_name' then nullif(btrim(p_patch->>'hospital_name'),'') else hospital_name end,
      department=case when p_patch?'department' then nullif(btrim(p_patch->>'department'),'') else department end,
      doctor_name=case when p_patch?'doctor_name' then nullif(btrim(p_patch->>'doctor_name'),'') else doctor_name end,
      appointment_at=case when p_patch?'appointment_at' then private.phms_try_timestamptz(p_patch->>'appointment_at') else appointment_at end,
      note=case when p_patch?'note' then nullif(btrim(p_patch->>'note'),'') else note end,
      appointment_type=case when p_patch?'appointment_type' then nullif(btrim(p_patch->>'appointment_type'),'') else appointment_type end,
      location_detail=case when p_patch?'location_detail' then nullif(btrim(p_patch->>'location_detail'),'') else location_detail end,
      contact_phone=case when p_patch?'contact_phone' then nullif(btrim(p_patch->>'contact_phone'),'') else contact_phone end,
      contact_email=case when p_patch?'contact_email' then nullif(lower(btrim(p_patch->>'contact_email')),'') else contact_email end,
      coverage_type=case when p_patch?'coverage_type' then nullif(btrim(p_patch->>'coverage_type'),'') else coverage_type end,
      preparation_notes=case when p_patch?'preparation_notes' then nullif(btrim(p_patch->>'preparation_notes'),'') else preparation_notes end,
      organization_id=case when p_patch?'organization_id' then private.phms_try_uuid(p_patch->>'organization_id') else organization_id end,
      service_unit_id=case when p_patch?'service_unit_id' then private.phms_try_uuid(p_patch->>'service_unit_id') else service_unit_id end,
      clinician_id=case when p_patch?'clinician_id' then private.phms_try_uuid(p_patch->>'clinician_id') else clinician_id end,
      hospital_hn=case
        when p_patch?'hospital_hn' then nullif(btrim(p_patch->>'hospital_hn'),'')
        when p_patch?'hospital_name'
          and coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_patch->>'hospital_name'),''),'') is distinct from coalesce(hospital_name,'')
          then null
        else hospital_hn end,
      arrival_lead_minutes=case when p_patch?'arrival_lead_minutes' then v_arrival else arrival_lead_minutes end,
      care_topic=case when p_patch?'care_topic' then nullif(btrim(p_patch->>'care_topic'),'') else care_topic end,
      followup_of_appointment_id=case when p_patch?'followup_of_appointment_id' then private.phms_try_uuid(p_patch->>'followup_of_appointment_id') else followup_of_appointment_id end,
      last_change_reason=v_reason,
      updated_at=now()
  where id=v_ref.record_id;

  select to_jsonb(a) into v_new from public.appointments a where a.id=v_ref.record_id;

  if nullif(v_new->>'hospital_hn','') is not null then
    perform private.phms_sync_person_hospital_hn(
      v_ref.target_person_id,
      private.phms_try_uuid(v_new->>'organization_id'),
      v_new->>'hospital_name',
      v_new->>'hospital_hn',
      v_ref.actor_user_id
    );
  end if;

  v_time_changed := (v_old->>'appointment_at') is distinct from (v_new->>'appointment_at');
  v_other_changed :=
    (v_old->>'hospital_name') is distinct from (v_new->>'hospital_name')
    or (v_old->>'department') is distinct from (v_new->>'department')
    or (v_old->>'doctor_name') is distinct from (v_new->>'doctor_name')
    or (v_old->>'location_detail') is distinct from (v_new->>'location_detail')
    or (v_old->>'preparation_notes') is distinct from (v_new->>'preparation_notes')
    or (v_old->>'title') is distinct from (v_new->>'title')
    or (v_old->>'note') is distinct from (v_new->>'note')
    or (v_old->>'contact_phone') is distinct from (v_new->>'contact_phone')
    or (v_old->>'contact_email') is distinct from (v_new->>'contact_email')
    or (v_old->>'coverage_type') is distinct from (v_new->>'coverage_type')
    or (v_old->>'hospital_hn') is distinct from (v_new->>'hospital_hn')
    or (v_old->>'arrival_lead_minutes') is distinct from (v_new->>'arrival_lead_minutes')
    or (v_old->>'care_topic') is distinct from (v_new->>'care_topic');

  insert into public.audit_logs(
    family_id,actor_user_id,family_person_id,event_type,resource,record_id,
    old_data,new_data,description
  )
  values(
    v_ref.active_family_id,v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,
    case when v_time_changed then 'appointment_rescheduled' else 'appointment_update' end,
    'appointment',v_ref.record_id,v_old,v_new,v_reason
  )
  returning id into v_audit_id;

  if v_time_changed or v_other_changed then
    for v_rec in
      select distinct r.recipient_user_id
      from (
        select aa.user_id recipient_user_id
        from public.appointment_assignees aa
        where aa.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
          and aa.status in ('assigned','accepted')
        union
        select nr.recipient_user_id
        from private.phms_notification_recipients(v_ref.target_person_id,'appointments') nr
      ) r
      where r.recipient_user_id is not null
        and r.recipient_user_id is distinct from v_ref.actor_user_id
    loop
      v_ack_id:=null;
      if v_time_changed then
        insert into public.appointment_acknowledgements(
          appointment_id,user_id,ack_type,status,requested_by,change_snapshot
        )
        values(
          v_ref.record_id,v_rec.recipient_user_id,'schedule_change','pending',
          v_ref.actor_user_id,
          jsonb_build_object(
            'audit_id',v_audit_id,
            'old_appointment_at',v_old->>'appointment_at',
            'new_appointment_at',v_new->>'appointment_at',
            'reason',v_reason
          )
        )
        returning id into v_ack_id;
      end if;

      insert into public.notifications(
        family_id,recipient_user_id,person_id,family_person_id,
        event_type,title,message,related_record_id,
        channel,priority,status,scheduled_for,next_attempt_at,
        payload,dedupe_key,updated_at
      )
      values(
        v_ref.active_family_id,v_rec.recipient_user_id,
        v_ref.target_person_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,
        'appointment_changed',
        case when v_time_changed then '📅 วันเวลานัดมีการเปลี่ยนแปลง' else '📅 รายละเอียดนัดมีการเปลี่ยนแปลง' end,
        concat(
          '👤 ',v_ref.target_person_name,
          E'\nนัด: ',coalesce(nullif(v_new->>'title',''),'นัดหมาย'),
          E'\nวันเวลา: ',to_char(private.phms_try_timestamptz(v_new->>'appointment_at') at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'),
          case when coalesce((v_new->>'arrival_lead_minutes')::int,0)>0
            then E'\nควรมาถึงก่อน: '||(v_new->>'arrival_lead_minutes')||' นาที' else '' end,
          E'\nเหตุผล: ',v_reason,
          case when v_time_changed then E'\nกรุณากดรับทราบวันเวลาใหม่' else '' end
        ),
        v_ref.record_id,'line',
        case when v_time_changed then 'high' else 'normal' end,
        'pending',now(),now(),
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'appointment_id',v_ref.record_id,
          'appointment_code',substr(v_ref.record_id::text,1,12),
          'audit_id',v_audit_id,
          'require_ack',v_time_changed,
          'ack_id',v_ack_id,
          'ack_code',case when v_ack_id is not null then substr(v_ack_id::text,1,12) end,
          'ack_type',case when v_time_changed then 'schedule_change' end
        )),
        'appointment_change:'||v_audit_id::text||':'||v_rec.recipient_user_id::text,
        now()
      );
    end loop;
  end if;

  perform private.phms_sync_auto_appointment_reminders(now());

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'record_id',v_ref.record_id,
    'record_code',substr(v_ref.record_id::text,1,12),
    'schedule_changed',v_time_changed,
    'updated',true,
    'item',v_new
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_value_suggestions(p_line_user_id text, p_field text, p_hospital_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_department text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 8)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_ctx private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype;
  v_person_id uuid;
  v_field text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_field,'')));
  v_hnorm text:=lower(regexp_replace(
    regexp_replace(coalesce(p_hospital_name,''),'^(โรงพยาบาล|รพ[.]?)[[:space:]]*','','i'),
    '[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g'
  ));
  v_dnorm text:=lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_department,''),'[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g'));
  v_limit integer:=greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,8),8));
  v_items jsonb;
begin
  if v_field not in ('hospital_name','department','doctor_name','care_topic') then
    return jsonb_build_object('field',v_field,'items','[]'::jsonb);
  end if;

  select * into v_line
  from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);

  perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.line_identity_id,v_line.user_id);

  select * into v_ctx
  from private.line_identity_contexts
  where line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;

  if v_ctx.active_family_id is null or v_ctx.active_family_person_id is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('field',v_field,'items','[]'::jsonb,'reason','active_person_required');
  end if;

  if not private.user_can_access_family_person(
    v_line.user_id,v_ctx.active_family_person_id,'appointments','view'
  ) then
    raise exception 'appointment_view_required';
  end if;

  select fp.person_id into v_person_id
  from public.family_persons fp
  where fp.id=v_ctx.active_family_person_id
  limit 1;

  -- Hospital choices come from the central organization directory first,
  -- then fall back to appointment history. This makes master aliases/codes
  -- available even when the active person has never used that hospital.
  if v_field='hospital_name' then
    with directory as (
      select
        o.name||
          case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(o.branch_name,'')),'') is not null
            then ' '||btrim(o.branch_name) else '' end||
          case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(o.external_code,'')),'') is not null
            then ' ('||btrim(o.external_code)||')' else '' end as value,
        nullif(btrim(o.external_code),'') as short_label,
        0 as source_rank,
        0 as person_rank,
        0::bigint as use_count,
        o.updated_at as last_used_at,
        'hospital_master'::text as source
      from public.healthcare_organizations o
      where o.deleted_at is null
        and coalesce(o.organization_type,'hospital')='hospital'
        and nullif(btrim(o.name),'') is not null
    ),
    hist as (
      select
        btrim(a.hospital_name) as value,
        null::text as short_label,
        1 as source_rank,
        case when a.person_id=v_person_id then 0 else 1 end as person_rank,
        count(*)::bigint as use_count,
        max(coalesce(a.updated_at,a.appointment_at)) as last_used_at,
        case when a.person_id=v_person_id then 'person_history' else 'family_history' end::text as source
      from public.appointments a
      join public.family_persons fp
        on fp.id=a.family_person_id
       and fp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
       and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
      where a.deleted_at is null
        and nullif(btrim(a.hospital_name),'') is not null
        and private.user_can_access_family_person(
          v_line.user_id,fp.id,'appointments','view'
        )
      group by btrim(a.hospital_name),case when a.person_id=v_person_id then 0 else 1 end,
               case when a.person_id=v_person_id then 'person_history' else 'family_history' end
    ),
    all_candidates as (
      select * from directory
      union all
      select * from hist
    ),
    grouped as (
      select
        value,
        max(short_label) filter (where source_rank=0) as short_label,
        min(source_rank) as source_rank,
        min(person_rank) as person_rank,
        sum(use_count) as use_count,
        max(last_used_at) as last_used_at,
        case
          when min(source_rank)=0 then 'hospital_master'
          when min(person_rank)=0 then 'person_history'
          else 'family_history'
        end as source
      from all_candidates
      group by value
    ),
    ranked as (
      select *
      from grouped
      order by
        source_rank,
        person_rank,
        use_count desc,
        last_used_at desc nulls last,
        value
      limit v_limit
    )
    select coalesce(
      jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'value',value,
          'short_label',short_label,
          'source',source,
          'use_count',use_count
        ))
        order by source_rank,person_rank,use_count desc,last_used_at desc nulls last,value
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
    into v_items
    from ranked;

    return jsonb_build_object('field',v_field,'items',v_items);
  end if;

  with src as (
    select
      a.id,
      a.person_id,
      a.family_person_id,
      a.hospital_name,
      a.department,
      a.doctor_name,
      a.care_topic,
      a.appointment_at,
      a.updated_at,
      case v_field
        when 'department' then nullif(btrim(a.department),'')
        when 'doctor_name' then nullif(btrim(a.doctor_name),'')
        when 'care_topic' then nullif(btrim(a.care_topic),'')
      end as value,
      lower(regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(coalesce(a.hospital_name,''),'^(โรงพยาบาล|รพ[.]?)[[:space:]]*','','i'),
        '[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g'
      )) as hnorm,
      lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(a.department,''),'[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g')) as dnorm
    from public.appointments a
    join public.family_persons fp
      on fp.id=a.family_person_id
     and fp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
     and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    where a.deleted_at is null
      and private.user_can_access_family_person(
        v_line.user_id,fp.id,'appointments','view'
      )
      and (
        v_field<>'care_topic'
        or a.person_id=v_person_id
      )
  ),
  eligible as (
    select *,
      case when person_id=v_person_id then 0 else 1 end as person_rank,
      case
        when v_hnorm='' then 0
        when hnorm=v_hnorm then 0
        when hnorm like v_hnorm||'%' or v_hnorm like hnorm||'%' then 1
        else 2
      end as hospital_rank,
      case
        when v_dnorm='' then 0
        when dnorm=v_dnorm then 0
        when dnorm like v_dnorm||'%' or v_dnorm like dnorm||'%' then 1
        else 2
      end as department_rank
    from src
    where value is not null
      and (
        v_field='care_topic'
        or (
          v_field in ('department','doctor_name')
          and (
            v_hnorm=''
            or hnorm=v_hnorm
            or hnorm like v_hnorm||'%'
            or v_hnorm like hnorm||'%'
          )
        )
      )
  ),
  grouped as (
    select
      value,
      min(person_rank) person_rank,
      min(hospital_rank) hospital_rank,
      min(department_rank) department_rank,
      count(*) use_count,
      max(coalesce(updated_at,appointment_at)) last_used_at
    from eligible
    group by value
  ),
  ranked as (
    select *
    from grouped
    order by
      case when v_field='doctor_name' then department_rank else 0 end,
      person_rank,
      hospital_rank,
      use_count desc,
      last_used_at desc nulls last,
      value
    limit v_limit
  )
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'value',value,
        'source',case when person_rank=0 then 'person_history' else 'family_hospital_master' end,
        'use_count',use_count
      )
      order by
        case when v_field='doctor_name' then department_rank else 0 end,
        person_rank,
        hospital_rank,
        use_count desc,
        last_used_at desc nulls last,
        value
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_items
  from ranked;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'field',v_field,
    'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_appointment_workspace(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_item jsonb;
  v_assignees jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_reminders jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_acks jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_docs jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_tasks jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_resources jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_can_sensitive boolean:=false;
  v_can_ops boolean:=false;
  v_can_health boolean:=false;
  v_can_documents boolean:=false;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_line_appointment_access(
    p_line_user_id,p_record_code
  )
  limit 1;

  v_can_health:=coalesce(v_ref.active_family_person_id is not null,false)
    and private.user_can_access_family_person(
      v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,'health_data','view'
    );
  v_can_documents:=v_ref.active_family_person_id is not null
    and private.user_can_access_family_person(v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,'documents','view');
  begin
    select coalesce(x.can_view_sensitive,false), coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false) into v_can_sensitive,v_can_ops
    from private.phms_line_appointment_sensitive_access(
      p_line_user_id,p_record_code
    ) x limit 1;
  exception when others then
    v_can_sensitive:=false;
    v_can_ops:=coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false);
  end;
  v_can_ops:=coalesce(v_can_ops,false) or coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false);

  if coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false) then
    select jsonb_strip_nulls(
      to_jsonb(a)
      - 'contact_phone'
      - 'contact_email'
      - ARRAY['visit_outcome_notes','diagnosis_summary','treatment_summary','next_steps','medication_plan_notes','test_results_summary','followup_required','followup_recorded_at']
      || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),
        'resource','appointment',
        'visit_outcome_notes',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.visit_outcome_notes end,
        'diagnosis_summary',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.diagnosis_summary end,
        'treatment_summary',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.treatment_summary end,
        'next_steps',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.next_steps end,
        'medication_plan_notes',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.medication_plan_notes end,
        'test_results_summary',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.test_results_summary end,
        'followup_required',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.followup_required end,
        'followup_recorded_at',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.followup_recorded_at end
      ))
    )
    into v_item
    from public.appointments a
    where a.id=v_ref.record_id;
  else
    select jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',a.id,
      'code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),
      'resource','appointment',
      'title',a.title,
      'appointment_type',a.appointment_type,
      'visit_mode',a.visit_mode,
      'walk_in_reason',a.walk_in_reason,
      'walk_in_doctor_status',a.walk_in_doctor_status,
      'visit_time_known',a.visit_time_known,
      'planned_visit_date',a.planned_visit_date,
      'followup_kind',a.followup_kind,
      'early_visit_of_appointment_id',a.early_visit_of_appointment_id,
      'followup_interval_months',a.followup_interval_months,
      'appointment_at',a.appointment_at,
      'hospital_name',a.hospital_name,
      'hospital_hn',case when v_can_ops then a.hospital_hn end,
      'hospital_vn',case when v_can_ops then a.hospital_vn end,
      'care_topic',a.care_topic,
      'department',a.department,
      'doctor_name',a.doctor_name,
      'location_detail',case when v_can_ops then a.location_detail end,
      'coverage_type',case when v_can_ops then a.coverage_type end,
      'arrival_lead_minutes',case when v_can_ops then a.arrival_lead_minutes end,
      'reminder_offsets_minutes',a.reminder_offsets_minutes,
      'post_visit_followup_minutes',a.post_visit_followup_minutes,
      'post_visit_followup_time_local',a.post_visit_followup_time_local,
      'status',a.status,
      'cancel_reason',a.cancel_reason,
      'last_change_reason',a.last_change_reason,
      'note',case when v_can_ops then a.note end,
      'preparation_notes',a.preparation_notes,
      'visit_outcome_notes',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.visit_outcome_notes end,
      'diagnosis_summary',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.diagnosis_summary end,
      'treatment_summary',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.treatment_summary end,
      'next_steps',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.next_steps end,
      'medication_plan_notes',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.medication_plan_notes end,
      'test_results_summary',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.test_results_summary end,
      'followup_required',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.followup_required end,
      'followup_recorded_at',case when v_can_health and a.status='completed' then a.followup_recorded_at end
    ))
    into v_item
    from public.appointments a
    where a.id=v_ref.record_id;
  end if;

  if coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false) then
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',aa.id,
        'code',substr(aa.id::text,1,12),
        'user_id',aa.user_id,
        'family_person_id',aa.family_person_id,
        'display_name',case
          when aa.family_person_id is not null then
            private.family_person_label_for_viewer(
              v_ref.actor_user_id,aa.family_person_id
            )
          when aa.user_id is not null then
            private.family_user_label_for_viewer(
              v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_id,aa.user_id
            )
          else 'สมาชิก'
        end,
        'line_linked',aa.user_id is not null,
        'role',aa.assignment_role,
        'status',aa.status,
        'requires_ack',aa.requires_ack,
        'assigned_at',aa.assigned_at,
        'acknowledged_at',aa.acknowledged_at,
        'note',aa.note
      )) order by aa.created_at
    ),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_assignees
    from public.appointment_assignees aa
    where aa.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
      and aa.status<>'removed';

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',ar.id,
        'rule_key',ar.rule_key,
        'remind_at',ar.remind_at,
        'recipient_user_id',ar.recipient_user_id,
        'status',ar.status,
        'sent_at',ar.sent_at
      )) order by ar.remind_at
    ),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_reminders
    from public.appointment_reminders ar
    where ar.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
      and ar.status<>'cancelled';

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',ak.id,
        'code',substr(ak.id::text,1,12),
        'user_id',ak.user_id,
        'display_name',private.family_user_label_for_viewer(
          v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_id,ak.user_id
        ),
        'ack_type',ak.ack_type,
        'status',ak.status,
        'requested_at',ak.requested_at,
        'responded_at',ak.responded_at,
        'note',ak.note
      )) order by ak.requested_at desc
    ),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_acks
    from public.appointment_acknowledgements ak
    where ak.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id;
  else
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'display_name',case
          when aa.family_person_id is not null then
            private.family_person_label_for_viewer(
              v_ref.actor_user_id,aa.family_person_id
            )
          when aa.user_id is not null then
            private.family_user_label_for_viewer(
              v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_id,aa.user_id
            )
          else 'สมาชิก'
        end,
        'role',aa.assignment_role,
        'status',aa.status,
        'acknowledged_at',aa.acknowledged_at,
        'note',aa.note
      )) order by aa.created_at
    ),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_assignees
    from public.appointment_assignees aa
    where aa.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
      and aa.status<>'removed';

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'display_name',private.family_user_label_for_viewer(
          v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_id,ak.user_id
        ),
        'ack_type',ak.ack_type,
        'status',ak.status,
        'responded_at',ak.responded_at,
        'note',ak.note
      )) order by ak.requested_at desc
    ),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_acks
    from public.appointment_acknowledgements ak
    where ak.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id;
  end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',adl.id,
      'link_kind',adl.link_kind,
      'document_id',adl.medical_document_id,
      'document_code',case
        when adl.medical_document_id is not null
        then substr(adl.medical_document_id::text,1,12)
      end,
      'title',md.title,
      'document_type',md.document_type,
      'document_date',md.document_date,
      'storage_asset_id',adl.storage_asset_id,
      'note',adl.note
    )) order by adl.created_at desc
  ),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_docs
  from public.appointment_document_links adl
  left join public.medical_documents md
    on md.id=adl.medical_document_id
  where adl.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
    and v_can_ops
    and v_can_documents
    and (
      adl.link_kind in ('source','preparation')
      or (v_can_health and adl.link_kind in ('result','certificate','referral','other'))
      or (v_can_sensitive and adl.link_kind in ('receipt','payment_slip','payment_qr','payment_other'))
    );

  if coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false) then
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.item order by x.created_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_resources
    from (
      select l.created_at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'link_id',l.id,
          'resource_type','person_medications',
          'record_id',l.record_id,
          'record_code',substr(l.record_id::text,1,12),
          'relationship',l.relationship,
          'label',coalesce(mm.brand_name,mm.generic_name,'ยา')
        )) item
      from public.appointment_resource_links l
      left join public.person_medications pm
        on l.resource_type='person_medications' and pm.id=l.record_id
      left join public.medication_master mm on mm.id=pm.medication_id
      where l.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
        and l.resource_type='person_medications'
        and v_ref.active_family_person_id is not null
        and private.user_can_access_family_person(
          v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,
          'medications','view'
        )

      union all

      select l.created_at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'link_id',l.id,
          'resource_type','health_measurements',
          'record_id',l.record_id,
          'record_code',substr(l.record_id::text,1,12),
          'relationship',l.relationship,
          'label',coalesce(h.measurement_type,'ข้อมูลสุขภาพ'),
          'measured_at',h.measured_at,
          'value_numeric',h.value_numeric,
          'value_text',h.value_text,
          'unit',h.unit,
          'systolic',h.systolic,
          'diastolic',h.diastolic
        )) item
      from public.appointment_resource_links l
      left join public.health_measurements h
        on l.resource_type='health_measurements' and h.id=l.record_id
      where l.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
        and l.resource_type='health_measurements'
        and v_ref.active_family_person_id is not null
        and private.user_can_access_family_person(
          v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,
          'health_data','view'
        )
    ) x;
  end if;

  if coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false) then
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',t.id,
        'code',substr(t.id::text,1,12),
        'task_type',t.task_type,
        'title',t.title,
        'instruction',t.instruction,
        'due_at',t.due_at,
        'status',t.status,
        'completed_at',t.completed_at,
        'note',t.note,
        'source_document_id',t.source_document_id,
        'related_health_measurement_id',t.related_health_measurement_id
      ))
      order by
        case t.status when 'pending' then 0 when 'completed' then 1 else 2 end,
        t.due_at nulls last,t.created_at
    ),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_tasks
    from public.appointment_tasks t
    where t.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
      and t.status<>'cancelled';
  else
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'title',t.title,
        'instruction',t.instruction,
        'due_at',t.due_at,
        'status',t.status,
        'completed_at',t.completed_at
      ))
      order by
        case t.status when 'pending' then 0 when 'completed' then 1 else 2 end,
        t.due_at nulls last,t.created_at
    ),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_tasks
    from public.appointment_tasks t
    where t.appointment_id=v_ref.record_id
      and t.status<>'cancelled';
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'record_id',v_ref.record_id,
    'record_code',substr(v_ref.record_id::text,1,12),
    'person_id',v_ref.target_person_id,
    'person_name',v_ref.target_person_name,
    'access',jsonb_build_object(
      'has_person_view',coalesce(v_ref.has_person_view,false),
      'can_update',coalesce(v_ref.can_update,false),
      'is_assignee',coalesce(v_ref.is_assignee,false),
      'full_access',coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false),
      'detail_access',case
        when coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false) then 'full'
        else 'limited'
      end
    ),
    'item',v_item,
    'assignees',case when v_can_ops then v_assignees else '[]'::jsonb end,
    'reminders',v_reminders,
    'acknowledgements',case when v_can_ops then v_acks else '[]'::jsonb end,
    'documents',v_docs,
    'tasks',v_tasks,
    'linked_resources',v_resources
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_bug_report_active(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth'
AS $function$
declare v_line record;
begin
 select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
 return jsonb_build_object('active',exists(select 1 from public.phms_bug_report_sessions where line_user_id=p_line_user_id and expires_at>now()));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_crud_detail(p_line_user_id text, p_resource text, p_record_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_key text:=private.phms_crud_resource_key(p_resource);
  v_ref record;
  v_item jsonb;
  v_created_by uuid;
  v_created_by_name text;
begin
  if v_key='appointment' then
    select * into v_ref
    from private.phms_line_appointment_access(
      p_line_user_id,p_record_code
    )
    limit 1;

    if coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false) then
      select
        jsonb_strip_nulls(
          (to_jsonb(a)-'contact_phone'-'contact_email')||jsonb_build_object(
            'code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),
            'resource','appointment'
          )
        ),
        a.created_by
      into v_item,v_created_by
      from public.appointments a
      where a.id=v_ref.record_id;
    else
      select
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'id',a.id,
          'code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),
          'resource','appointment',
          'title',a.title,
          'appointment_at',a.appointment_at,
          'hospital_name',a.hospital_name,
          'care_topic',a.care_topic,
          'department',a.department,
          'doctor_name',a.doctor_name,
          'location_detail',a.location_detail,
          'arrival_lead_minutes',a.arrival_lead_minutes,
          'status',a.status,
          'note',a.note,
          'preparation_notes',a.preparation_notes,
          'visit_outcome_notes',a.visit_outcome_notes,
          'diagnosis_summary',a.diagnosis_summary,
          'treatment_summary',a.treatment_summary,
          'next_steps',a.next_steps,
          'medication_plan_notes',a.medication_plan_notes,
          'test_results_summary',a.test_results_summary,
          'followup_required',a.followup_required,
          'followup_recorded_at',a.followup_recorded_at
        )),
        null::uuid
      into v_item,v_created_by
      from public.appointments a
      where a.id=v_ref.record_id;
    end if;

    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok',true,
      'resource','appointment',
      'person_id',v_ref.target_person_id,
      'person_name',v_ref.target_person_name,
      'access',jsonb_build_object(
        'has_person_view',coalesce(v_ref.has_person_view,false),
        'can_update',coalesce(v_ref.can_update,false),
        'is_assignee',coalesce(v_ref.is_assignee,false),
        'full_access',coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false),
        'detail_access',case when coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false) then 'full' else 'limited' end
      ),
      'item',v_item
    );
  end if;

  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,p_resource,p_record_code,'view'
  )
  limit 1;

  if v_ref.resource_key='medication' then
    select
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',pm.id,'code',substr(pm.id::text,1,12),'resource','medication',
        'person_id',pm.person_id,
        'name',coalesce(mm.brand_name,mm.generic_name),
        'generic_name',mm.generic_name,'brand_name',mm.brand_name,
        'strength_value',mm.strength_value,'strength_unit',mm.strength_unit,
        'dosage_form',mm.dosage_form,
        'status',pm.status,'indication',pm.indication,
        'start_date',pm.start_date,'end_date',pm.end_date,'notes',pm.notes,
        'regimen_id',mr.id,'dose_value',mr.dose_value,'dose_unit',mr.dose_unit,
        'dose_text',mr.dose_text,'frequency_type',mr.frequency_type,
        'frequency_value',mr.frequency_value,'frequency_unit',mr.frequency_unit,
        'route',mr.route,'meal_relation',mr.meal_relation,
        'time_of_day',mr.time_of_day,'exact_times',mr.exact_times,
        'instructions',mr.instructions,
        'created_at',pm.created_at,'updated_at',pm.updated_at
      )),
      pm.created_by
    into v_item,v_created_by
    from public.person_medications pm
    join public.medication_master mm on mm.id=pm.medication_id
    left join lateral (
      select r.* from public.medication_regimens r
      where r.person_medication_id=pm.id
        and r.deleted_at is null and r.is_current=true
      order by r.effective_from desc,r.created_at desc limit 1
    ) mr on true
    where pm.id=v_ref.record_id;

  elsif v_ref.resource_key='health' then
    select
      jsonb_strip_nulls(to_jsonb(h)||jsonb_build_object(
        'code',substr(h.id::text,1,12),'resource','health'
      )),
      h.created_by
    into v_item,v_created_by
    from public.health_measurements h
    where h.id=v_ref.record_id;

  else
    select
      jsonb_strip_nulls(to_jsonb(d)||jsonb_build_object(
        'code',substr(d.id::text,1,12),'resource','document'
      )),
      d.created_by
    into v_item,v_created_by
    from public.medical_documents d
    where d.id=v_ref.record_id;
  end if;

  if v_created_by is not null and v_ref.active_family_id is not null then
    v_created_by_name:=private.family_user_label_for_viewer(
      v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_id,v_created_by
    );
  elsif v_created_by is not null then
    select coalesce(
      nullif(btrim(p.display_name),''),
      nullif(btrim(li.display_name),''),
      'สมาชิก'
    )
    into v_created_by_name
    from public.profiles p
    left join lateral (
      select x.display_name
      from public.line_identities x
      where x.user_id=v_created_by and x.is_active=true
      order by x.updated_at desc nulls last
      limit 1
    ) li on true
    where p.id=v_created_by;
  end if;

  if v_created_by_name is not null then
    v_item:=v_item||jsonb_build_object(
      'created_by_name',v_created_by_name
    );
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'resource',v_ref.resource_key,
    'person_id',v_ref.target_person_id,
    'person_name',v_ref.target_person_name,
    'item',v_item
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_crud_history(p_line_user_id text, p_resource text, p_record_code text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 12)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_events jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_created_at timestamptz;
  v_limit integer:=greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,12),30));
begin
  if private.phms_crud_resource_key(p_resource)='appointment' then
    select * into v_ref
    from private.phms_line_appointment_access(
      p_line_user_id,p_record_code
    )
    limit 1;


    select a.created_at into v_created_at
    from public.appointments a
    where a.id=v_ref.record_id;

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.event order by x.at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_events
    from (
      select al.created_at at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'at',al.created_at,'event_type',al.event_type,
          'description',al.description,
          'old_data',private.phms_appointment_audit_visible_json(al.old_data,coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false)),
          'new_data',private.phms_appointment_audit_visible_json(al.new_data,coalesce(v_ref.full_access,false)),'source','audit_logs'
        )) event
      from public.audit_logs al
      where al.record_id=v_ref.record_id
        and al.resource='appointment'

      union all

      select rp.created_at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'at',rp.created_at,'event_type','created_from_intake',
          'extraction_method',rp.extraction_method,
          'source_record_id',rp.source_record_id,
          'source_storage_asset_id',rp.source_storage_asset_id,
          'source','record_provenance'
        ))
      from public.record_provenance rp
      where rp.resource_type='appointments'
        and rp.record_id=v_ref.record_id
      order by at desc
      limit v_limit
    ) x;

    if jsonb_array_length(v_events)=0 then
      v_events:=jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
        'at',v_created_at,'event_type','created','source','record'
      ));
    end if;

    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok',true,'resource','appointment',
      'record_id',v_ref.record_id,
      'record_code',substr(v_ref.record_id::text,1,12),
      'person_id',v_ref.target_person_id,
      'person_name',v_ref.target_person_name,
      'events',v_events
    );
  end if;

  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,p_resource,p_record_code,'view'
  )
  limit 1;

  if v_ref.resource_key='medication' then
    select pm.created_at into v_created_at
    from public.person_medications pm where pm.id=v_ref.record_id;

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.event order by x.at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_events
    from (
      select mch.created_at at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'at',mch.created_at,'event_type',mch.change_type,
          'reason',mch.reason,'old_data',mch.old_data,'new_data',mch.new_data,
          'source','medication_change_history'
        )) event
      from public.medication_change_history mch
      where mch.person_medication_id=v_ref.record_id

      union all

      select al.created_at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'at',al.created_at,'event_type',al.event_type,
          'description',al.description,'old_data',al.old_data,'new_data',al.new_data,
          'source','audit_logs'
        ))
      from public.audit_logs al
      where al.record_id=v_ref.record_id
        and al.resource='medication'
        and al.event_type in ('crud_update','crud_stop')

      union all

      select rp.created_at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'at',rp.created_at,'event_type','created_from_intake',
          'extraction_method',rp.extraction_method,
          'source_record_id',rp.source_record_id,
          'source_storage_asset_id',rp.source_storage_asset_id,
          'source','record_provenance'
        ))
      from public.record_provenance rp
      where rp.resource_type='person_medications'
        and rp.record_id=v_ref.record_id

      order by at desc
      limit v_limit
    ) x;

  elsif v_ref.resource_key='appointment' then
    select a.created_at into v_created_at from public.appointments a where a.id=v_ref.record_id;
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.event order by x.at desc),'[]'::jsonb) into v_events
    from (
      select al.created_at at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'at',al.created_at,'event_type',al.event_type,
          'description',al.description,'old_data',al.old_data,'new_data',al.new_data,
          'source','audit_logs'
        )) event
      from public.audit_logs al
      where al.record_id=v_ref.record_id and al.resource='appointment'
      union all
      select rp.created_at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'at',rp.created_at,'event_type','created_from_intake',
          'extraction_method',rp.extraction_method,
          'source_record_id',rp.source_record_id,
          'source_storage_asset_id',rp.source_storage_asset_id,
          'source','record_provenance'
        ))
      from public.record_provenance rp
      where rp.resource_type='appointments' and rp.record_id=v_ref.record_id
      order by at desc limit v_limit
    ) x;

  elsif v_ref.resource_key='health' then
    select h.created_at into v_created_at from public.health_measurements h where h.id=v_ref.record_id;
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.event order by x.at desc),'[]'::jsonb) into v_events
    from (
      select al.created_at at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'at',al.created_at,'event_type',al.event_type,
          'description',al.description,'old_data',al.old_data,'new_data',al.new_data,
          'source','audit_logs'
        )) event
      from public.audit_logs al
      where al.record_id=v_ref.record_id and al.resource='health'
      union all
      select rp.created_at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'at',rp.created_at,'event_type','created_from_intake',
          'extraction_method',rp.extraction_method,
          'source_record_id',rp.source_record_id,
          'source_storage_asset_id',rp.source_storage_asset_id,
          'source','record_provenance'
        ))
      from public.record_provenance rp
      where rp.resource_type='health_measurements' and rp.record_id=v_ref.record_id
      order by at desc limit v_limit
    ) x;

  else
    select d.created_at into v_created_at from public.medical_documents d where d.id=v_ref.record_id;
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.event order by x.at desc),'[]'::jsonb) into v_events
    from (
      select al.created_at at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'at',al.created_at,'event_type',al.event_type,
          'description',al.description,'old_data',al.old_data,'new_data',al.new_data,
          'source','audit_logs'
        )) event
      from public.audit_logs al
      where al.record_id=v_ref.record_id and al.resource='document'
      union all
      select rp.created_at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'at',rp.created_at,'event_type','created_from_intake',
          'extraction_method',rp.extraction_method,
          'source_record_id',rp.source_record_id,
          'source_storage_asset_id',rp.source_storage_asset_id,
          'source','record_provenance'
        ))
      from public.record_provenance rp
      where rp.resource_type='medical_documents' and rp.record_id=v_ref.record_id
      order by at desc limit v_limit
    ) x;
  end if;

  if jsonb_array_length(v_events)=0 then
    v_events:=jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'at',v_created_at,'event_type','created','source','record'
    ));
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,'resource',v_ref.resource_key,
    'record_id',v_ref.record_id,'record_code',substr(v_ref.record_id::text,1,12),
    'person_id',v_ref.target_person_id,'person_name',v_ref.target_person_name,
    'events',v_events
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_crud_list(p_line_user_id text, p_resource text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 8)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_key text:=private.phms_crud_resource_key(p_resource);
  v_ctx record;
  v_items jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_limit integer:=greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,8),20));
begin
  if v_key is null then raise exception 'invalid_crud_resource'; end if;

  select * into v_ctx
  from private.phms_line_crud_context(p_line_user_id,v_key,'view')
  limit 1;

  if v_key='medication' then
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.item order by x.sort_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_items
    from (
      select pm.created_at sort_at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'id',pm.id,'code',substr(pm.id::text,1,12),
          'resource','medication',
          'name',coalesce(mm.brand_name,mm.generic_name),
          'generic_name',mm.generic_name,
          'brand_name',mm.brand_name,
          'strength_value',mm.strength_value,
          'strength_unit',mm.strength_unit,
          'status',pm.status,
          'indication',pm.indication,
          'notes',pm.notes,
          'dose_text',mr.dose_text,
          'frequency_type',mr.frequency_type,
          'frequency_value',mr.frequency_value,
          'frequency_unit',mr.frequency_unit,
          'route',mr.route,
          'meal_relation',mr.meal_relation,
          'instructions',mr.instructions,
          'created_at',pm.created_at,
          'updated_at',pm.updated_at
        )) item
      from public.person_medications pm
      join public.medication_master mm on mm.id=pm.medication_id
      left join lateral (
        select r.*
        from public.medication_regimens r
        where r.person_medication_id=pm.id
          and r.deleted_at is null
          and r.is_current=true
        order by r.effective_from desc,r.created_at desc
        limit 1
      ) mr on true
      where pm.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
        and pm.deleted_at is null
      order by pm.updated_at desc nulls last,pm.created_at desc
      limit v_limit
    ) x;

  elsif v_key='appointment' then
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.item order by x.sort_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_items
    from (
      select coalesce(a.appointment_at,a.created_at) sort_at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'id',a.id,'code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),
          'resource','appointment',
          'title',a.title,'hospital_name',a.hospital_name,
          'department',a.department,'doctor_name',a.doctor_name,
          'appointment_at',a.appointment_at,'note',a.note,
          'status',a.status,'appointment_type',a.appointment_type,
          'created_at',a.created_at,'updated_at',a.updated_at
        )) item
      from public.appointments a
      where a.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
        and a.deleted_at is null
      order by a.appointment_at desc nulls last,a.created_at desc
      limit v_limit
    ) x;

  elsif v_key='health' then
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.item order by x.sort_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_items
    from (
      select h.measured_at sort_at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'id',h.id,'code',substr(h.id::text,1,12),
          'resource','health',
          'measurement_type',h.measurement_type,
          'measured_at',h.measured_at,
          'value_numeric',h.value_numeric,'value_text',h.value_text,
          'unit',h.unit,'systolic',h.systolic,'diastolic',h.diastolic,
          'context',h.context,'notes',h.notes,'source_type',h.source_type,
          'created_at',h.created_at
        )) item
      from public.health_measurements h
      where h.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
        and h.deleted_at is null
      order by h.measured_at desc,h.created_at desc
      limit v_limit
    ) x;

  else
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.item order by x.sort_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_items
    from (
      select coalesce(d.document_date::timestamptz,d.created_at) sort_at,
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'id',d.id,'code',substr(d.id::text,1,12),
          'resource','document',
          'document_type',d.document_type,
          'document_date',d.document_date,
          'title',d.title,
          'original_filename',d.original_filename,
          'mime_type',d.mime_type,
          'extraction_status',d.extraction_status,
          'storage_asset_id',d.storage_asset_id,
          'created_at',d.created_at,'updated_at',d.updated_at
        )) item
      from public.medical_documents d
      where d.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
        and d.deleted_at is null
      order by d.document_date desc nulls last,d.created_at desc
      limit v_limit
    ) x;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'resource',v_key,
    'person_id',v_ctx.target_person_id,
    'person_name',v_ctx.target_person_name,
    'count',jsonb_array_length(v_items),
    'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_family_group_workspace(p_line_user_id text, p_family_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid;
  v_family public.families%rowtype;
  v_code text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_family_code,'')));
  v_count integer;
  v_groups jsonb;
begin
  select li.user_id into v_actor
  from public.line_identities li
  where li.line_user_id=p_line_user_id
    and li.is_active=true
    and li.onboarding_status='ready'
  order by li.updated_at desc nulls last,li.created_at desc
  limit 1;
  if v_actor is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_ready'; end if;

  select count(*) into v_count
  from public.families f
  where coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
    and (lower(f.id::text) like v_code||'%' or lower(coalesce(f.family_code,''))=v_code)
    and exists(
      select 1 from public.family_memberships fm
      where fm.family_id=f.id and fm.user_id=v_actor and fm.status='active'
    )
    and private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,f.id,array['owner','admin']);

  if v_count=0 then raise exception 'family_not_found_or_permission_denied'; end if;
  if v_count>1 then raise exception 'family_code_ambiguous'; end if;

  select * into v_family
  from public.families f
  where coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
    and (lower(f.id::text) like v_code||'%' or lower(coalesce(f.family_code,''))=v_code)
    and exists(
      select 1 from public.family_memberships fm
      where fm.family_id=f.id and fm.user_id=v_actor and fm.status='active'
    )
    and private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,f.id,array['owner','admin'])
  limit 1;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'channel_code',substr(fc.id::text,1,12),
    'line_group_id',fc.external_channel_id,
    'channel_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(fc.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
    'status',fc.status,
    'can_query_bot',coalesce(fc.can_query_bot,false),
    'can_receive_notifications',coalesce(fc.can_receive_notifications,true),
    'setup_completed',fc.setup_completed_at is not null,
    'scope_count',(
      select count(*)::int
      from public.family_channel_query_scopes s
      join public.family_persons fp on fp.id=s.family_person_id
      where s.family_channel_id=fc.id
        and fp.family_id=v_family.id
        and s.enabled=true
    ),
    'appointment_people',(
      select count(distinct s.family_person_id)::int
      from public.family_channel_query_scopes s
      join public.family_persons fp on fp.id=s.family_person_id
      where s.family_channel_id=fc.id
        and fp.family_id=v_family.id
        and s.resource='appointments'
        and s.enabled=true
    ),
    'medication_people',(
      select count(distinct s.family_person_id)::int
      from public.family_channel_query_scopes s
      join public.family_persons fp on fp.id=s.family_person_id
      where s.family_channel_id=fc.id
        and fp.family_id=v_family.id
        and s.resource='medications'
        and s.enabled=true
    ),
    'health_people',(
      select count(distinct s.family_person_id)::int
      from public.family_channel_query_scopes s
      join public.family_persons fp on fp.id=s.family_person_id
      where s.family_channel_id=fc.id
        and fp.family_id=v_family.id
        and s.resource='health_data'
        and s.enabled=true
    )
  ) order by lower(coalesce(fc.channel_name,'')),fc.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_groups
  from public.family_channel_family_links l
  join public.family_channels fc on fc.id=l.family_channel_id
  where l.family_id=v_family.id
    and l.status='active'
    and fc.channel_type='line_group'
    and fc.status in ('pending_link','active');

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'family_code',substr(v_family.id::text,1,12),
    'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_family.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),
    'groups',coalesce(v_groups,'[]'::jsonb)
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_gallery_asset_appointment_context(p_line_user_id text, p_asset_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_asset public.phms_storage_assets%rowtype;
  v_link record;
  v_can_update boolean:=false;
begin
  select * into v_line
  from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);

  select * into v_asset
  from public.phms_storage_assets a
  where a.id=p_asset_id
    and a.deleted_at is null
    and a.lifecycle_state<>'deleted';

  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object('linked',false,'reason','asset_not_found');
  end if;

  select
    l.id link_id,
    l.link_kind,
    a.id appointment_id,
    substr(a.id::text,1,12) appointment_code,
    a.family_id,
    a.family_person_id,
    a.person_id,
    a.title,
    a.appointment_at,
    a.status,
    a.hospital_name,
    a.department
  into v_link
  from public.appointment_document_links l
  join public.appointments a on a.id=l.appointment_id
  where l.storage_asset_id=p_asset_id
    and a.deleted_at is null
  order by l.created_at desc
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object('linked',false);
  end if;

  if v_link.family_person_id is not null then
    v_can_update:=private.user_can_access_family_person(
      v_line.user_id,v_link.family_person_id,'appointments','update'
    );
  else
    v_can_update:=exists(
      select 1
      from public.persons p
      where p.id=v_link.person_id
        and p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id
        and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
    );
  end if;

  return jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'linked',true,
    'link_id',v_link.link_id,
    'link_kind',v_link.link_kind,
    'appointment_code',v_link.appointment_code,
    'title',v_link.title,
    'appointment_at',v_link.appointment_at,
    'status',v_link.status,
    'hospital_name',v_link.hospital_name,
    'department',v_link.department,
    'can_update_link',v_can_update,
    'can_reassign_linked',v_can_update
  ));
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_begin_setup(p_line_user_id text, p_line_group_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid;
  v_fc public.family_channels%rowtype;
  v_when timestamptz;
begin
  select li.user_id into v_actor
  from public.line_identities li
  where li.line_user_id=p_line_user_id
    and li.is_active=true
    and li.onboarding_status='ready'
  order by li.updated_at desc nulls last,li.created_at desc
  limit 1;
  if v_actor is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_ready'; end if;

  select * into v_fc
  from public.family_channels
  where channel_type='line_group'
    and external_channel_id=btrim(p_line_group_id)
    and status='active'
  limit 1;
  if v_fc.id is null then raise exception 'group_not_linked'; end if;

  if not exists(
    select 1
    from public.family_channel_family_links l
    where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
      and l.status='active'
      and private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,l.family_id,array['owner','admin'])
  ) then raise exception 'group_settings_permission_denied'; end if;

  update public.family_channels
  set setup_started_at=coalesce(setup_started_at,now()),
      setup_completed_at=null,
      setup_completed_by=null,
      ready_sent_at=null,
      can_query_bot=false,
      updated_at=now()
  where id=v_fc.id;

  v_when:=private.phms_schedule_line_group_setup_reminder(v_fc.id,v_actor);

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'group_code',substr(v_fc.id::text,1,12),
    'line_group_id',v_fc.external_channel_id,
    'reminder_at',v_when,
    'timezone','Asia/Bangkok'
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_complete_setup(p_line_user_id text, p_line_group_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid;
  v_fc public.family_channels%rowtype;
  v_scope_count integer;
  v_audit_family uuid;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  select li.user_id into v_actor
  from public.line_identities li
  where li.line_user_id=p_line_user_id
    and li.is_active=true
    and li.onboarding_status='ready'
  order by li.updated_at desc nulls last,li.created_at desc
  limit 1;
  if v_actor is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_ready'; end if;

  select * into v_fc
  from public.family_channels
  where channel_type='line_group'
    and external_channel_id=btrim(p_line_group_id)
    and status='active'
  limit 1;
  if v_fc.id is null then raise exception 'group_not_linked'; end if;

  select l.family_id into v_audit_family
  from public.family_channel_family_links l
  where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
    and l.status='active'
    and private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,l.family_id,array['owner','admin'])
  order by l.linked_at
  limit 1;

  if v_audit_family is null then raise exception 'group_settings_permission_denied'; end if;

  select count(*)::int into v_scope_count
  from public.family_channel_query_scopes s
  where s.family_channel_id=v_fc.id and s.enabled=true;

  if v_scope_count<1 then raise exception 'group_setup_requires_scope'; end if;

  update public.family_channels
  set setup_started_at=coalesce(setup_started_at,now()),
      setup_completed_at=now(),
      setup_completed_by=v_actor,
      can_query_bot=true,
      updated_at=now()
  where id=v_fc.id;

  update public.notifications
  set status='cancelled',
      last_error='group_setup_completed',
      updated_at=now()
  where event_type='line_group_setup_reminder'
    and related_record_id=v_fc.id
    and status in ('pending','failed');


  insert into public.notifications(
    family_id,recipient_user_id,event_type,title,message,related_record_id,
    channel,priority,status,scheduled_for,next_attempt_at,payload,dedupe_key,
    created_at,updated_at
  )
  select
    r.family_id,r.requested_by,'line_group_link_request_ready',
    '💙 LINE กลุ่มพร้อมใช้งานแล้ว',
    concat('LINE กลุ่ม “',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_fc.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
      '” ตั้งค่าเรียบร้อยแล้ว'),
    r.id,'line','normal','pending',now(),now(),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'request_code',substr(r.id::text,1,12),
      'group_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_fc.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
      'line_group_id',v_fc.external_channel_id,
      'setup_completed_at',now()
    ),
    'line-group-link-ready:'||r.id::text,
    now(),now()
  from public.line_group_link_requests r
  where r.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
    and r.status='approved'
    and r.requested_by<>v_actor
  on conflict(dedupe_key) where dedupe_key is not null do nothing;

  v_result:=public.phms_line_group_settings(p_line_user_id,p_line_group_id);


  insert into public.audit_logs(
    family_id,actor_user_id,event_type,resource,record_id,new_data,description
  ) values(
    v_audit_family,v_actor,'line_group_setup_completed','family_channel',v_fc.id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'enabled_scope_count',v_scope_count,
      'timezone','Asia/Bangkok',
      'group_access_mode','view_and_notifications_only'
    ),
    'ตั้งค่าขอบเขต LINE กลุ่มเสร็จและเปิดดู/ถามข้อมูล'
  );

  return v_result || jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'should_send_ready',v_fc.ready_sent_at is null
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_consume_question_window(p_line_group_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_fc uuid;
  v_ok boolean:=false;
begin
  select id into v_fc from public.family_channels
  where channel_type='line_group'
    and external_channel_id=btrim(p_line_group_id)
    and status='active'
  limit 1;
  if v_fc is null then return false; end if;

  select coalesce(awaiting_question_until>now(),false) into v_ok
  from public.family_channel_conversation_state
  where family_channel_id=v_fc;

  if v_ok then
    update public.family_channel_conversation_state
    set awaiting_question_until=null,updated_at=now()
    where family_channel_id=v_fc;
  end if;
  return coalesce(v_ok,false);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_conversation_get(p_line_group_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v public.line_group_conversation_sessions%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v
  from public.line_group_conversation_sessions
  where line_group_id=btrim(coalesce(p_line_group_id,''))
  limit 1;

  if v.line_group_id is null or v.is_active is not true or v.expires_at is null or v.expires_at <= now() then
    return jsonb_build_object('active',false);
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'active',true,
    'phase',v.phase,
    'last_question',v.last_question,
    'last_line_user_id',v.last_line_user_id,
    'last_webhook_event_id',v.last_webhook_event_id,
    'last_person_code',case when v.last_family_person_id is not null then substr(v.last_family_person_id::text,1,12) end,
    'last_resource',v.last_resource,
    'expires_at',v.expires_at
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_conversation_set_target(p_line_group_id text, p_person_code text, p_resource text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_fc public.family_channels%rowtype;
  v_fp_id uuid;
  v_count int;
  v_resource text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_resource,'')));
begin
  if v_resource not in ('appointments','medications','health_data') then
    raise exception 'invalid_group_query_resource';
  end if;

  select * into v_fc
  from public.family_channels
  where channel_type='line_group'
    and external_channel_id=btrim(p_line_group_id)
    and status='active'
    and setup_completed_at is not null
  limit 1;
  if v_fc.id is null then raise exception 'group_query_not_available'; end if;

  select count(*),min(fp.id::text)::uuid
  into v_count,v_fp_id
  from public.family_persons fp
  where lower(fp.id::text) like lower(btrim(p_person_code))||'%'
    and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    and exists(
      select 1 from public.family_channel_family_links l
      where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
        and l.family_id=fp.family_id
        and l.status='active'
    )
    and exists(
      select 1 from public.family_channel_query_scopes s
      where s.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
        and s.family_person_id=fp.id
        and s.resource=v_resource
        and s.enabled=true
    );

  if v_count=0 then raise exception 'group_query_scope_denied'; end if;
  if v_count>1 then raise exception 'group_person_code_ambiguous'; end if;

  insert into public.line_group_conversation_sessions(
    line_group_id,is_active,phase,last_family_person_id,last_resource,
    opened_at,last_activity_at,expires_at,updated_at
  )
  values(
    btrim(p_line_group_id),true,'waiting_followup',v_fp_id,v_resource,
    now(),now(),now()+interval '3 minutes',now()
  )
  on conflict(line_group_id) do update set
    is_active=true,
    phase='waiting_followup',
    last_family_person_id=excluded.last_family_person_id,
    last_resource=excluded.last_resource,
    last_activity_at=now(),
    expires_at=greatest(
      coalesce(public.line_group_conversation_sessions.expires_at,now()),
      now()+interval '3 minutes'
    ),
    updated_at=now();

  return public.phms_line_group_conversation_get(p_line_group_id);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_conversation_touch(p_line_group_id text, p_phase text, p_line_user_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_webhook_event_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_last_question text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_ttl_seconds integer DEFAULT 180)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_phase text:=coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_phase),''),'waiting_question');
begin
  if v_phase not in ('waiting_question','waiting_followup') then
    raise exception 'invalid_group_conversation_phase';
  end if;

  insert into public.line_group_conversation_sessions(
    line_group_id,is_active,phase,last_question,last_line_user_id,last_webhook_event_id,
    last_family_person_id,last_resource,
    opened_at,last_activity_at,expires_at,updated_at
  )
  values(
    btrim(p_line_group_id),true,v_phase,
    case when v_phase='waiting_question' then null else nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_last_question,'')),'') end,
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_line_user_id,'')),''),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_webhook_event_id,'')),''),
    null,null,
    now(),now(),now()+make_interval(secs=>greatest(30,least(coalesce(p_ttl_seconds,180),600))),now()
  )
  on conflict(line_group_id) do update set
    is_active=true,
    phase=excluded.phase,
    last_question=case
      when v_phase='waiting_question' then null
      else coalesce(excluded.last_question,public.line_group_conversation_sessions.last_question)
    end,
    last_line_user_id=excluded.last_line_user_id,
    last_webhook_event_id=excluded.last_webhook_event_id,
    last_family_person_id=case
      when v_phase='waiting_question' then null
      else public.line_group_conversation_sessions.last_family_person_id
    end,
    last_resource=case
      when v_phase='waiting_question' then null
      else public.line_group_conversation_sessions.last_resource
    end,
    opened_at=case when public.line_group_conversation_sessions.is_active
                      and public.line_group_conversation_sessions.expires_at>now()
                   then public.line_group_conversation_sessions.opened_at else now() end,
    last_activity_at=now(),
    expires_at=excluded.expires_at,
    updated_at=now();

  return public.phms_line_group_conversation_get(p_line_group_id);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_link_options(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid;
  v_options jsonb;
begin
  select li.user_id into v_actor
  from public.line_identities li
  where li.line_user_id=p_line_user_id
    and li.is_active=true and li.onboarding_status='ready'
  order by li.updated_at desc nulls last,li.created_at desc
  limit 1;
  if v_actor is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_ready'; end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'family_code',substr(f.id::text,1,12),
    'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),

  ) order by coalesce(f.family_name,''),f.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)

  where fm.user_id=v_actor
    and fm.status='active'
    and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'

  return jsonb_build_object('actor_user_id',v_actor,'options',v_options);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_link_request_status(p_line_user_id text, p_request_code text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid;
  v_rows jsonb;
  v_code text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_request_code,'')));
begin
  select li.user_id into v_actor
  from public.line_identities li
  where li.line_user_id=p_line_user_id
    and li.is_active=true
    and li.onboarding_status='ready'
  order by li.updated_at desc nulls last,li.created_at desc
  limit 1;
  if v_actor is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_ready'; end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.obj order by x.sort_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_rows
  from (
    select
      r.requested_at as sort_at,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'request_code',substr(r.id::text,1,12),
        'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),
        'group_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(fc.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
        'line_group_id',fc.external_channel_id,
        'status',
          case
            when r.status='pending' then 'pending_review'
            when r.status='approved' and fc.setup_completed_at is null then 'approved_setup_pending'
            when r.status='approved' and fc.setup_completed_at is not null then 'ready'
            when r.status='rejected' then 'rejected'
            else r.status
          end,
        'requested_at',r.requested_at,
        'reviewed_at',r.reviewed_at,
        'setup_completed_at',fc.setup_completed_at,
        'review_note',r.review_note,
        'last_reminded_at',r.last_reminded_at,
        'reminder_count',r.reminder_count,
        'waiting_days',
          greatest(0,floor(extract(epoch from (
            now() - case
              when r.status='approved' and fc.setup_completed_at is null
                then coalesce(r.reviewed_at,r.requested_at)
              else r.requested_at
            end
          ))/86400))::int,
        'next_reminder_at',
          case
            when r.status='pending'
              then coalesce(r.last_reminded_at,r.requested_at)+interval '3 days'
            when r.status='approved' and fc.setup_completed_at is null
              then coalesce(r.last_reminded_at,r.reviewed_at,r.requested_at)+interval '3 days'
            else null
          end,
        'can_remind',
          case
            when r.status='pending'
              then now() >= coalesce(r.last_reminded_at,r.requested_at)+interval '3 days'
            when r.status='approved' and fc.setup_completed_at is null
              then now() >= coalesce(r.last_reminded_at,r.reviewed_at,r.requested_at)+interval '3 days'
            else false
          end
      ) obj
    from public.line_group_link_requests r
    join public.families f on f.id=r.family_id
    join public.family_channels fc on fc.id=r.family_channel_id
    where r.requested_by=v_actor
      and (v_code='' or lower(r.id::text) like v_code||'%')
  ) x;

  return jsonb_build_object('requests',coalesce(v_rows,'[]'::jsonb));
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_private_write_options(p_line_user_id text, p_line_group_id text, p_resource text, p_action text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line public.line_identities%rowtype;
  v_fc public.family_channels%rowtype;
  v_resource text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_resource,'')));
