  v_action text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_action,'')));
  v_people jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_families jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_linked_family_count integer:=0;
  v_member_family_count integer:=0;
begin
  if v_resource not in ('appointments','medications','health_data') then
    raise exception 'unsupported_group_write_resource';
  end if;
  if v_action not in ('create','update','delete') then
    raise exception 'unsupported_group_write_action';
  end if;

  select * into v_line
  from public.line_identities li
  where li.line_user_id=p_line_user_id
    and li.is_active=true
  order by li.updated_at desc nulls last,li.created_at desc
  limit 1;
  if not found then raise exception 'line_identity_not_found'; end if;
  if v_line.user_id is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_linked'; end if;

  select * into v_fc
  from public.family_channels fc
  where fc.channel_type='line_group'
    and fc.external_channel_id=btrim(p_line_group_id)
    and fc.status in ('active','pending_link')
  limit 1;
  if v_fc.id is null then raise exception 'group_not_linked'; end if;

  select count(*)::int into v_linked_family_count
  from public.family_channel_family_links l
  where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
    and l.status='active';

  select count(*)::int into v_member_family_count
  from public.family_memberships fm
  where fm.user_id=v_line.user_id
    and fm.status='active'
    and (
      v_linked_family_count=0
      or exists (
        select 1 from public.family_channel_family_links l
        where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
          and l.family_id=fm.family_id
          and l.status='active'
      )
    );

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'family_code',substr(f.id::text,1,12),
    'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว')
  ) order by coalesce(f.family_name,'')),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_families
  from public.families f
  join public.family_memberships fm
    on fm.family_id=f.id
   and fm.user_id=v_line.user_id
   and fm.status='active'
  where coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
    and (
      v_linked_family_count=0
      or exists (
        select 1 from public.family_channel_family_links l
        where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
          and l.family_id=f.id
          and l.status='active'
      )
    );

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'person_code',substr(fp.id::text,1,12),
    'family_code',substr(f.id::text,1,12),
    'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),
    'display_name',case
      when private.user_can_see_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id)
        then private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.id)
      else private.family_person_central_label(fp.id)
    end,
    'can_view',private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,v_resource,'view'),
    'can_action',private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,v_resource,v_action),
    'group_scope_enabled',exists(
      select 1 from public.family_channel_query_scopes qs
      where qs.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
        and qs.family_person_id=fp.id
        and qs.resource=v_resource
        and qs.enabled=true
    )
  ) order by coalesce(f.family_name,''),private.family_person_central_label(fp.id)),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_people
  from public.families f
  join public.family_memberships fm
    on fm.family_id=f.id
   and fm.user_id=v_line.user_id
   and fm.status='active'
  join public.family_persons fp
    on fp.family_id=f.id
   and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
   and fp.setup_status='ready'
  join public.persons p
    on p.id=fp.person_id
   and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
  where (
      v_linked_family_count=0
      or exists (
        select 1 from public.family_channel_family_links l
        where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id and l.family_id=f.id and l.status='active'
      )
    )
    and (
      private.user_can_see_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id)
      or exists(
        select 1 from public.family_channel_query_scopes qs
        where qs.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
          and qs.family_person_id=fp.id
          and qs.resource=v_resource
          and qs.enabled=true
      )
    );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'line_group_id',v_fc.external_channel_id,
    'channel_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_fc.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
    'resource',v_resource,
    'action',v_action,
    'linked_family_count',v_linked_family_count,
    'member_family_count',v_member_family_count,
    'private_family_fallback',v_linked_family_count=0,
    'group_setup_complete',v_fc.setup_completed_at is not null,
    'families',v_families,
    'people',v_people
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_query_context(p_line_group_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_fc public.family_channels%rowtype;
  v_people jsonb;
  v_families jsonb;
  v_family_name text;
begin
  select fc.* into v_fc
  from public.family_channels fc
  where fc.channel_type='line_group'
    and fc.external_channel_id=btrim(p_line_group_id)
    and fc.status='active'
    and fc.setup_completed_at is not null
  limit 1;

  if v_fc.id is null or not exists(
    select 1 from public.family_channel_family_links l
    where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id and l.status='active'
  ) then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'linked',false,'can_query_bot',false,
      'people','[]'::jsonb,'families','[]'::jsonb
    );
  end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'family_id',f.id,
    'family_code',substr(f.id::text,1,12),
    'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว')
  ) order by coalesce(f.family_name,'')),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_families
  from public.family_channel_family_links l
  join public.families f on f.id=l.family_id and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
  where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id and l.status='active';

  if jsonb_array_length(v_families)=1 then
    v_family_name:=v_families->0->>'family_name';
  else
    v_family_name:='หลายครอบครัว';
  end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'person_code',substr(fp.id::text,1,12),
    'family_id',fp.family_id,
    'family_code',substr(fp.family_id::text,1,12),
    'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),
    'nickname',coalesce(
      private.family_person_label_for_viewer((
        select coalesce(s.updated_by,s.created_by)
        from public.family_channel_query_scopes s
        where s.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
          and s.family_person_id=fp.id
          and s.enabled=true
          and coalesce(s.updated_by,s.created_by) is not null
        order by s.updated_at desc
        limit 1
      ),fp.id),
      private.family_person_central_label(fp.id),
      'ไม่ระบุชื่อ'
    ),
    'aliases',to_jsonb(array_remove(array[
      nullif(btrim(private.family_person_central_label(fp.id)),''),
      nullif(btrim(p.nickname),''),
      nullif(btrim(fp.relationship_label),''),
      nullif(btrim(p.display_name),'')
    ]::text[],null)),
    'resources',(
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(s.resource order by s.resource),'[]'::jsonb)
      from public.family_channel_query_scopes s
      where s.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
        and s.family_person_id=fp.id
        and s.enabled=true
    )
  ) order by coalesce(f.family_name,''),private.family_person_central_label(fp.id)),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_people
  from public.family_channel_family_links l
  join public.families f on f.id=l.family_id
  join public.family_persons fp on fp.family_id=f.id
  join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
  where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
    and l.status='active'
    and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    and fp.setup_status='ready'
    and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
    and exists(
      select 1 from public.family_channel_query_scopes s
      where s.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
        and s.family_person_id=fp.id
        and s.enabled=true
    );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'linked',true,
    'family_name',v_family_name,
    'families',coalesce(v_families,'[]'::jsonb),
    'channel_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_fc.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
    'can_query_bot',coalesce(v_fc.can_query_bot,false),
    'people',coalesce(v_people,'[]'::jsonb),
    'timezone','Asia/Bangkok',
    'group_capabilities',jsonb_build_object(
      'view',true,
      'receive_notifications',true,
      'create',false,
      'update',false,
      'delete',false
    )
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_query_safe(p_line_group_id text, p_person_code text, p_resource text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_fc public.family_channels%rowtype;
  v_fp_id uuid;
  v_fp public.family_persons%rowtype;
  v_p public.persons%rowtype;
  v_family_name text;
  v_label_user uuid;
  v_resource text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_resource,'')));
  v_count integer;
  v_items jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
begin
  if v_resource not in ('appointments','medications','health_data')
    then raise exception 'invalid_group_query_resource'; end if;

  select * into v_fc
  from public.family_channels
  where channel_type='line_group'
    and external_channel_id=btrim(p_line_group_id)
    and status='active'
    and setup_completed_at is not null
    and coalesce(can_query_bot,false)=true
  limit 1;
  if v_fc.id is null then raise exception 'group_query_not_available'; end if;

  select count(*),min(fp.id::text)::uuid
  into v_count,v_fp_id
  from public.family_persons fp
  join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
  where coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    and fp.setup_status='ready'
    and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
    and lower(fp.id::text) like lower(btrim(p_person_code))||'%'
    and exists(
      select 1
      from public.family_channel_family_links l
      where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
        and l.family_id=fp.family_id
        and l.status='active'
    )
    and exists(
      select 1 from public.family_channel_query_scopes s
      where s.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
        and s.family_person_id=fp.id
        and s.resource=v_resource
        and s.enabled=true
    );
  if v_count=0 then raise exception 'group_query_scope_denied'; end if;
  if v_count>1 then raise exception 'group_person_code_ambiguous'; end if;

  select * into v_fp from public.family_persons where id=v_fp_id;
  select * into v_p from public.persons where id=v_fp.person_id;
  select coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว') into v_family_name
  from public.families f where f.id=v_fp.family_id;

  select coalesce(s.updated_by,s.created_by) into v_label_user
  from public.family_channel_query_scopes s
  where s.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
    and s.family_person_id=v_fp.id
    and s.enabled=true
    and coalesce(s.updated_by,s.created_by) is not null
  order by s.updated_at desc
  limit 1;

  if v_resource='appointments' then
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'record_code',substr(x.id::text,1,12),
      'title',coalesce(nullif(btrim(x.title),''),'นัดหมาย'),
      'appointment_at',x.appointment_at,
      'hospital_name',nullif(btrim(x.hospital_name),''),
      'department',nullif(btrim(x.department),''),
      'doctor_name',nullif(btrim(x.doctor_name),''),'care_topic',nullif(btrim(x.care_topic),''),
      'location_detail',nullif(btrim(x.location_detail),''),
      'preparation_notes',nullif(btrim(x.preparation_notes),''),
      'status',x.status
    ) order by x.appointment_at),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_items
    from (
      select a.*
      from public.appointments a
      where a.family_id=v_fp.family_id
        and a.family_person_id=v_fp.id
        and a.deleted_at is null
        and a.appointment_at>=now()-interval '6 hours'
        and a.status in ('scheduled','confirmed','arrived')
      order by a.appointment_at
      limit 50
    ) x;
  elsif v_resource='medications' then
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(mm.brand_name),''),nullif(btrim(mm.generic_name),''),'ยา'),
      'generic_name',nullif(btrim(mm.generic_name),''),
      'dose',coalesce(nullif(btrim(r.dose_text),''),
        case when r.dose_value is not null then r.dose_value::text||coalesce(' '||nullif(btrim(r.dose_unit),''),'') else null end),
      'times',r.exact_times,
      'instructions',nullif(btrim(r.instructions),'')
    ) order by coalesce(mm.brand_name,mm.generic_name)),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_items
    from public.person_medications pm
    join public.medication_master mm on mm.id=pm.medication_id and mm.deleted_at is null
    left join lateral (
      select mr.*
      from public.medication_regimens mr
      where mr.person_medication_id=pm.id
        and mr.deleted_at is null
        and mr.is_current=true
      order by mr.effective_from desc nulls last,mr.created_at desc
      limit 1
    ) r on true
    where pm.person_id=v_fp.person_id
      and pm.deleted_at is null
      and pm.status='regular'
      and (pm.end_date is null or pm.end_date>=current_date)
    limit 8;
  else
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'measurement_type',x.measurement_type,
      'measured_at',x.measured_at,
      'value_numeric',x.value_numeric,
      'value_text',x.value_text,
      'unit',x.unit
    ) order by x.measured_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_items
    from (
      select h.*
      from public.health_measurements h
      where h.person_id=v_fp.person_id and h.deleted_at is null
      order by h.measured_at desc
      limit 5
    ) x;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'resource',v_resource,
    'person_code',substr(v_fp.id::text,1,12),
    'family_code',substr(v_fp.family_id::text,1,12),
    'family_name',v_family_name,
    'person_name',coalesce(
      private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_label_user,v_fp.id),
      private.family_person_central_label(v_fp.id),
      'ไม่ระบุชื่อ'
    ),
    'timezone','Asia/Bangkok',
    'read_only',true,
    'items',coalesce(v_items,'[]'::jsonb)
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_resolve_person_reference(p_line_group_id text, p_line_user_id text, p_question text, p_resource text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_fc public.family_channels%rowtype;
  v_viewer_user_id uuid;
  v_q text:=regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(p_question,'')),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g');
  v_resource text:=nullif(lower(btrim(coalesce(p_resource,''))),'');
  v_self_requested boolean:=false;
  v_rows jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_top_score int:=0;
  v_top_count int:=0;
  v_match jsonb;
begin
  if v_resource is not null and v_resource not in ('appointments','medications','health_data') then
    raise exception 'invalid_group_query_resource';
  end if;

  select fc.* into v_fc
  from public.family_channels fc
  where fc.channel_type='line_group'
    and fc.external_channel_id=btrim(p_line_group_id)
    and fc.status='active'
    and fc.setup_completed_at is not null
    and coalesce(fc.can_query_bot,false)=true
  limit 1;

  if v_fc.id is null then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok',false,'available',false,'reason','group_query_not_available',
      'matched',false,'ambiguous',false,'matches','[]'::jsonb
    );
  end if;

  select li.user_id into v_viewer_user_id
  from public.line_identities li
  where li.line_user_id=btrim(coalesce(p_line_user_id,''))
    and li.is_active=true
  order by li.updated_at desc nulls last
  limit 1;

  v_self_requested :=
    v_q like '%ของฉัน%' or v_q like '%ฉันเอง%' or v_q like '%ฉัน%'
    or v_q like '%ของผม%' or v_q like '%ผมเอง%' or v_q like '%ผม%'
    or v_q like '%ของหนู%' or v_q like '%หนูเอง%' or v_q like '%หนู%'
    or v_q like '%ของตัวเอง%' or v_q like '%ตัวเอง%'
    or v_q='เรา' or v_q like 'เรา%' or v_q like '%ของเรา%';

  with candidates as (
    select
      fp.id family_person_id,
      fp.family_id,
      fp.person_id,
      p.linked_user_id,
      f.family_name,
      p.nickname,
      p.display_name,
      p.first_name,
      p.last_name,
      fp.relationship_label family_relationship_label,
      vl.display_label viewer_display_label,
      vl.relationship_label viewer_relationship_label,
      private.family_person_central_label(fp.id) central_label,
      case
        when v_resource is null then exists(
          select 1 from public.family_channel_query_scopes s
          where s.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
            and s.family_person_id=fp.id
            and s.enabled=true
        )
        else exists(
          select 1 from public.family_channel_query_scopes s
          where s.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
            and s.family_person_id=fp.id
            and s.resource=v_resource
            and s.enabled=true
        )
      end resource_allowed
    from public.family_channel_family_links l
    join public.families f
      on f.id=l.family_id and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
    join public.family_persons fp
      on fp.family_id=f.id
     and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
     and fp.setup_status='ready'
    join public.persons p
      on p.id=fp.person_id
     and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
    left join public.family_person_view_labels vl
      on vl.viewer_user_id=v_viewer_user_id
     and vl.family_person_id=fp.id
    where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
      and l.status='active'
  ),
  aliases as (
    select c.*,'self'::text alias_type,'ฉัน'::text alias_text,200 score
    from candidates c
    where v_self_requested
      and v_viewer_user_id is not null
      and c.linked_user_id=v_viewer_user_id

    union all
    select c.*,'viewer_display',c.viewer_display_label,case when c.linked_user_id=v_viewer_user_id and regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(c.viewer_display_label,'')),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') in ('ฉัน','ผม','หนู','เรา','ตัวเอง') then 200 + least(length(coalesce(c.viewer_display_label,'')),99) else 1100 + least(length(coalesce(c.viewer_display_label,'')),99) end
    from candidates c
    where nullif(btrim(c.viewer_display_label),'') is not null
      and position(regexp_replace(lower(c.viewer_display_label),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') in v_q)>0

    union all
    select c.*,'viewer_relationship',c.viewer_relationship_label,case when c.linked_user_id=v_viewer_user_id and regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(c.viewer_relationship_label,'')),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') in ('ฉัน','ผม','หนู','เรา','ตัวเอง') then 200 + least(length(coalesce(c.viewer_relationship_label,'')),99) else 1050 + least(length(coalesce(c.viewer_relationship_label,'')),99) end
    from candidates c
    where nullif(btrim(c.viewer_relationship_label),'') is not null
      and position(regexp_replace(lower(c.viewer_relationship_label),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') in v_q)>0

    union all
    select c.*,'nickname',c.nickname,950 + least(length(coalesce(c.nickname,'')),99)
    from candidates c
    where nullif(btrim(c.nickname),'') is not null
      and position(regexp_replace(lower(c.nickname),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') in v_q)>0

    union all
    select c.*,'central_label',c.central_label,925 + least(length(coalesce(c.central_label,'')),99)
    from candidates c
    where nullif(btrim(c.central_label),'') is not null
      and position(regexp_replace(lower(c.central_label),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') in v_q)>0

    union all
    select c.*,'family_relationship',c.family_relationship_label,900 + least(length(coalesce(c.family_relationship_label,'')),99)
    from candidates c
    where nullif(btrim(c.family_relationship_label),'') is not null
      and position(regexp_replace(lower(c.family_relationship_label),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') in v_q)>0

    union all
    select c.*,'person_display',c.display_name,875 + least(length(coalesce(c.display_name,'')),99)
    from candidates c
    where nullif(btrim(c.display_name),'') is not null
      and position(regexp_replace(lower(c.display_name),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') in v_q)>0

    union all
    select c.*,'full_name',concat_ws(' ',c.first_name,c.last_name),850 + least(length(concat_ws(' ',c.first_name,c.last_name)),99)
    from candidates c
    where nullif(btrim(concat_ws(' ',c.first_name,c.last_name)),'') is not null
      and position(regexp_replace(lower(concat_ws(' ',c.first_name,c.last_name)),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') in v_q)>0

    union all
    select c.*,'first_name',c.first_name,825 + least(length(coalesce(c.first_name,'')),99)
    from candidates c
    where nullif(btrim(c.first_name),'') is not null
      and length(btrim(c.first_name))>=2
      and position(regexp_replace(lower(c.first_name),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') in v_q)>0

    union all
    select c.*,'last_name',c.last_name,700 + least(length(coalesce(c.last_name,'')),99)
    from candidates c
    where nullif(btrim(c.last_name),'') is not null
      and length(btrim(c.last_name))>=3
      and position(regexp_replace(lower(c.last_name),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') in v_q)>0

    union all
    select c.*,'kinship_prefix',k.prefix,300 + length(k.prefix)
    from candidates c
    cross join (values
      ('ทวด'),('ยาย'),('ย่า'),('ตา'),('ปู่'),('แม่'),('พ่อ'),
      ('ป้า'),('น้า'),('อา'),('ลุง'),('พี่'),('น้อง')
    ) k(prefix)
    where position(k.prefix in v_q)>0
      and (
        regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(c.viewer_display_label,'')),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') like k.prefix||'%'
        or regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(c.viewer_relationship_label,'')),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') like k.prefix||'%'
        or regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(c.nickname,'')),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') like k.prefix||'%'
        or regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(c.central_label,'')),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') like k.prefix||'%'
        or regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(c.family_relationship_label,'')),'[[:space:][:punct:]]+','','g') like k.prefix||'%'
      )
  ),
  best_per_person as (
    select distinct on (family_person_id)
      family_person_id,family_id,person_id,family_name,linked_user_id,
      viewer_display_label,viewer_relationship_label,nickname,display_name,
      first_name,last_name,central_label,resource_allowed,
      alias_type,alias_text,score
    from aliases
    order by family_person_id,score desc,length(coalesce(alias_text,'')) desc
  ),
  ranked as (
    select *,max(score) over() top_score
    from best_per_person
  ),
  top_rows as (
    select * from ranked where score=top_score
  )
  select
    coalesce(max(top_score),0),
    count(*)::int,
    coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'person_code',substr(family_person_id::text,1,12),
      'family_code',substr(family_id::text,1,12),
      'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),
      'person_name',coalesce(
        nullif(btrim(viewer_display_label),''),
        nullif(btrim(nickname),''),
        nullif(btrim(central_label),''),
        nullif(btrim(concat_ws(' ',first_name,last_name)),''),
        'ไม่ระบุชื่อ'
      ),
      'matched_alias',alias_text,
      'match_type',alias_type,
      'score',score,
      'is_self',v_viewer_user_id is not null and linked_user_id=v_viewer_user_id,
      'resource_allowed',resource_allowed
    )) order by
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(viewer_display_label),''),nullif(btrim(nickname),''),central_label)
    ),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_top_score,v_top_count,v_rows
  from top_rows;

  if v_top_count=1 then v_match:=v_rows->0; end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'available',true,
    'asker_ready',v_viewer_user_id is not null,
    'self_requested',v_self_requested,
    'resource',v_resource,
    'matched',v_top_count=1,
    'ambiguous',v_top_count>1,
    'match_count',v_top_count,
    'top_score',v_top_score,
    'match',v_match,
    'matches',v_rows
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_runtime_state(p_line_group_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_fc public.family_channels%rowtype;
  v_links integer:=0;
  v_scopes integer:=0;
begin
  select * into v_fc
  from public.family_channels
  where channel_type='line_group'
    and external_channel_id=btrim(coalesce(p_line_group_id,''))
  limit 1;

  if v_fc.id is null then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'exists',false,'ready',false,'status','not_found',
      'setup_completed',false,'can_query_bot',false,
      'active_links',0,'enabled_scopes',0,'previously_ready',false
    );
  end if;

  select count(*) into v_links
  from public.family_channel_family_links
  where family_channel_id=v_fc.id and status='active';

  select count(*) into v_scopes
  from public.family_channel_query_scopes
  where family_channel_id=v_fc.id and enabled=true;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'exists',true,
    'status',v_fc.status,
    'setup_completed',v_fc.setup_completed_at is not null,
    'previously_ready',v_fc.last_completed_at is not null,
    'can_query_bot',v_fc.can_query_bot,
    'can_receive_notifications',v_fc.can_receive_notifications,
    'active_links',v_links,
    'enabled_scopes',v_scopes,
    'ready',
      v_fc.status='active'
      and v_fc.setup_completed_at is not null
      and v_links>0
      and v_scopes>0
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_set_query_enabled(p_line_user_id text, p_line_group_id text, p_enabled boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid;
  v_fc public.family_channels%rowtype;
  v_audit_family uuid;
begin
  select li.user_id into v_actor
  from public.line_identities li
  where li.line_user_id=p_line_user_id and li.is_active=true and li.onboarding_status='ready'
  order by li.updated_at desc nulls last,li.created_at desc limit 1;
  if v_actor is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_ready'; end if;

  select * into v_fc from public.family_channels
  where channel_type='line_group'
    and external_channel_id=btrim(p_line_group_id)
    and status='active'
  limit 1;
  if v_fc.id is null then raise exception 'group_not_linked'; end if;

  select l.family_id into v_audit_family
  from public.family_channel_family_links l
  where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
    and l.status='active'
    and private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,l.family_id,array['owner','admin'])
  order by l.linked_at
  limit 1;
  if v_audit_family is null then raise exception 'group_settings_permission_denied'; end if;

  update public.family_channels
  set can_query_bot=coalesce(p_enabled,false),updated_at=now()
  where id=v_fc.id;

  insert into public.audit_logs(
    family_id,actor_user_id,event_type,resource,record_id,new_data,description
  )
  values(
    v_audit_family,v_actor,'line_group_query_setting','family_channel',v_fc.id,
    jsonb_build_object('can_query_bot',coalesce(p_enabled,false),'access_mode','read_only'),
    case when coalesce(p_enabled,false)
      then 'เปิดดู/ถามข้อมูลใน LINE กลุ่ม'
      else 'ปิดดู/ถามข้อมูลใน LINE กลุ่ม'
    end
  );

  return public.phms_line_group_settings(p_line_user_id,p_line_group_id);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_settings(p_line_user_id text, p_line_group_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid;
  v_fc public.family_channels%rowtype;
  v_can_manage boolean:=false;
  v_accessible_count integer:=0;
  v_people jsonb;
  v_families jsonb;
  v_enabled_scope_count integer:=0;
  v_family_name text;
begin
  select li.user_id into v_actor
  from public.line_identities li
  where li.line_user_id=p_line_user_id
    and li.is_active=true
    and li.onboarding_status='ready'
  order by li.updated_at desc nulls last,li.created_at desc
  limit 1;
  if v_actor is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_ready'; end if;

  select fc.* into v_fc
  from public.family_channels fc
  where fc.channel_type='line_group'
    and fc.external_channel_id=btrim(p_line_group_id)
    and fc.status='active'
  limit 1;
  if v_fc.id is null then raise exception 'group_not_linked'; end if;

  select count(*)::int,
         coalesce(bool_or(private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,l.family_id,array['owner','admin'])),false)
  into v_accessible_count,v_can_manage
  from public.family_channel_family_links l
  join public.family_memberships fm
    on fm.family_id=l.family_id
   and fm.user_id=v_actor
   and fm.status='active'
  where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
    and l.status='active';

  if v_accessible_count=0 then raise exception 'family_access_denied'; end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'family_id',f.id,
    'family_code',substr(f.id::text,1,12),
    'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),
    'can_manage',private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,f.id,array['owner','admin'])
  ) order by coalesce(f.family_name,''),f.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_families
  from public.family_channel_family_links l
  join public.families f on f.id=l.family_id and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
  join public.family_memberships fm
    on fm.family_id=f.id and fm.user_id=v_actor and fm.status='active'
  where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id and l.status='active';

  if jsonb_array_length(v_families)=1 then
    v_family_name:=v_families->0->>'family_name';
  else
    v_family_name:='หลายครอบครัว';
  end if;

  select count(*)::int into v_enabled_scope_count
  from public.family_channel_query_scopes s
  where s.family_channel_id=v_fc.id and s.enabled=true;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'person_code',substr(fp.id::text,1,12),
    'family_id',fp.family_id,
    'family_code',substr(fp.family_id::text,1,12),
    'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),
    'nickname',private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_actor,fp.id),
    'display_name',private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_actor,fp.id),
    'can_manage_scope',private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,fp.family_id,array['owner','admin']),
    'can_manage_family',private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,fp.family_id,array['owner','admin']),
    'appointments',coalesce((select s.enabled from public.family_channel_query_scopes s where s.family_channel_id=v_fc.id and s.family_person_id=fp.id and s.resource='appointments'),false),
    'medications',coalesce((select s.enabled from public.family_channel_query_scopes s where s.family_channel_id=v_fc.id and s.family_person_id=fp.id and s.resource='medications'),false),
    'health_data',coalesce((select s.enabled from public.family_channel_query_scopes s where s.family_channel_id=v_fc.id and s.family_person_id=fp.id and s.resource='health_data'),false)
  ) order by coalesce(f.family_name,''),private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_actor,fp.id)),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_people
  from public.family_channel_family_links l
  join public.families f on f.id=l.family_id and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
  join public.family_memberships fm
    on fm.family_id=f.id and fm.user_id=v_actor and fm.status='active'
  join public.family_persons fp on fp.family_id=f.id
  join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
  where l.family_channel_id=v_fc.id
    and l.status='active'
    and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    and fp.setup_status='ready'
    and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active';

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'linked',true,
    'family_id',v_fc.family_id,
    'family_name',v_family_name,
    'families',coalesce(v_families,'[]'::jsonb),
    'linked_families',coalesce(v_families,'[]'::jsonb),
    'channel_code',substr(v_fc.id::text,1,12),
    'channel_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_fc.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
    'line_group_id',v_fc.external_channel_id,
    'can_query_bot',coalesce(v_fc.can_query_bot,false),
    'can_manage',v_can_manage,
    'people',coalesce(v_people,'[]'::jsonb),
    'timezone','Asia/Bangkok',
    'enabled_scope_count',v_enabled_scope_count,
    'setup_started_at',v_fc.setup_started_at,
    'setup_completed_at',v_fc.setup_completed_at,
    'setup_completed',v_fc.setup_completed_at is not null,
    'ready_sent_at',v_fc.ready_sent_at,
    'group_capabilities',jsonb_build_object(
      'view',true,
      'receive_notifications',true,
      'create',false,
      'update',false,
      'delete',false
    )
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_group_setup_options(p_line_user_id text, p_line_group_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid;
  v_channel public.family_channels%rowtype;
  v_direct jsonb;
  v_request jsonb;
  v_pending jsonb;
  v_linked_families jsonb;
  v_has_any_link boolean:=false;
  v_can_manage boolean:=false;
  v_is_family_member boolean:=false;
  v_visible_link_count integer:=0;
  v_family_name text;
  v_family_code text;
begin
  select li.user_id into v_actor
  from public.line_identities li
  where li.line_user_id=p_line_user_id
    and li.is_active=true
    and li.onboarding_status='ready'
  order by li.updated_at desc nulls last,li.created_at desc
  limit 1;
  if v_actor is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_ready'; end if;

  select * into v_channel
  from public.family_channels
  where channel_type='line_group'
    and external_channel_id=btrim(p_line_group_id)
    and status in ('pending_link','active')
  limit 1;
  if v_channel.id is null then raise exception 'line_group_not_seen'; end if;

  select exists(
    select 1 from public.family_channel_family_links l
    where l.family_channel_id=v_channel.id and l.status='active'
  ) into v_has_any_link;

  select
    coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'family_code',substr(f.id::text,1,12),
      'family_id',f.id,
      'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),
      'can_manage',private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,f.id,array['owner','admin'])
    ) order by coalesce(f.family_name,''),f.created_at),'[]'::jsonb),
    count(*)::int,
    coalesce(bool_or(private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,f.id,array['owner','admin'])),false)
  into v_linked_families,v_visible_link_count,v_can_manage
  from public.family_channel_family_links l
  join public.families f on f.id=l.family_id and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
  join public.family_memberships fm
    on fm.family_id=f.id and fm.user_id=v_actor and fm.status='active'
  where l.family_channel_id=v_channel.id
    and l.status='active';

  v_is_family_member:=v_visible_link_count>0;

  if v_visible_link_count=1 then
    select
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),
      substr(f.id::text,1,12)
    into v_family_name,v_family_code
    from public.family_channel_family_links l
    join public.families f on f.id=l.family_id
    join public.family_memberships fm
      on fm.family_id=f.id and fm.user_id=v_actor and fm.status='active'
    where l.family_channel_id=v_channel.id and l.status='active'
    limit 1;
  elsif v_visible_link_count>1 then
    v_family_name:='หลายครอบครัว';
    v_family_code:=null;
  end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'family_code',substr(f.id::text,1,12),
    'family_id',f.id,
    'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),
    'mode','direct'
  ) order by coalesce(f.family_name,''),f.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_direct
  from public.families f
  join public.family_memberships fm on fm.family_id=f.id
  where fm.user_id=v_actor
    and fm.status='active'
    and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
    and private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,f.id,array['owner','admin'])
    and not exists(
      select 1 from public.family_channel_family_links l
      where l.family_channel_id=v_channel.id
        and l.family_id=f.id
        and l.status='active'
    );

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'family_code',substr(f.id::text,1,12),
    'family_id',f.id,
    'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),
    'can_request',true,
    'mode','request'
  ) order by coalesce(f.family_name,''),f.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_request
  from public.families f
  join public.family_memberships fm on fm.family_id=f.id
  where fm.user_id=v_actor
    and fm.status='active'
    and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
    and not private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,f.id,array['owner','admin'])
    and coalesce((
      select p.can_request_link
      from public.family_line_group_request_permissions p
      where p.family_id=f.id and p.user_id=v_actor
    ),false)=true
    and not exists(
      select 1 from public.family_channel_family_links l
      where l.family_channel_id=v_channel.id
        and l.family_id=f.id
        and l.status='active'
    )
    and not exists(
      select 1 from public.line_group_link_requests r
      where r.family_channel_id=v_channel.id
        and r.family_id=f.id
        and r.requested_by=v_actor
        and r.status='pending'
    );

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'family_code',substr(f.id::text,1,12),
    'family_id',f.id,
    'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),
    'request_code',substr(r.id::text,1,12),
    'status','pending',
    'requested_at',r.requested_at,
    'last_reminded_at',r.last_reminded_at,
    'reminder_count',r.reminder_count,
    'waiting_days',greatest(0,floor(extract(epoch from (now()-r.requested_at))/86400))::int,
    'next_reminder_at',coalesce(r.last_reminded_at,r.requested_at)+interval '3 days',
    'can_remind',now()>=coalesce(r.last_reminded_at,r.requested_at)+interval '3 days'
  ) order by r.requested_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_pending
  from public.line_group_link_requests r
  join public.families f on f.id=r.family_id
  where r.family_channel_id=v_channel.id
    and r.requested_by=v_actor
    and r.status='pending';

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'group_status',v_channel.status,
    'setup_completed',v_channel.status='active' and v_channel.setup_completed_at is not null,
    'requires_reconfirmation',v_channel.status='pending_link' and v_channel.last_completed_at is not null and v_has_any_link and v_can_manage,
    'actor_user_id',v_actor,
    'group_code',substr(v_channel.id::text,1,12),
    'group_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_channel.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
    'linked',v_has_any_link,
    'family_code',v_family_code,
    'family_name',v_family_name,
    'linked_families',coalesce(v_linked_families,'[]'::jsonb),
    'pending_requests',coalesce(v_pending,'[]'::jsonb),
    'can_manage',v_can_manage,
    'is_family_member',v_is_family_member,
    'direct_options',coalesce(v_direct,'[]'::jsonb),
    'request_options',coalesce(v_request,'[]'::jsonb)
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_health_tasks(p_line_user_id text, p_scope text DEFAULT 'mine'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare v_line record;v_items jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;v_scope text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_scope,'mine')));
begin
 select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'task_code',substr(replace(t.id::text,'-',''),1,12),
   'title',t.title,'instructions',t.instructions,'resource',t.resource,'task_type',t.task_type,
   'status',case t.status
      when 'pending' then 'รอรับงาน' when 'accepted' then 'รับงานแล้ว'
      when 'in_progress' then 'กำลังทำ' when 'completed' then 'ทำเสร็จแล้ว'
      when 'declined' then 'ทำไม่ได้' when 'cancelled' then 'ยกเลิก'
      when 'expired' then 'หมดเวลา' else t.status end,
   'due_at',t.due_at,'expires_at',t.expires_at,'created_at',t.created_at,
   'assigned_to_me',t.assigned_to_user_id=v_line.user_id,
   'assigned_by_me',t.assigned_by_user_id=v_line.user_id,
   'person_name',private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,t.family_person_id)
 ) order by t.created_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
 into v_items
 from (
  select x.* from public.health_care_tasks x
  where (
    (v_scope='mine' and (x.assigned_to_user_id=v_line.user_id or x.assigned_by_user_id=v_line.user_id))
    or (v_scope='assigned_to_me' and x.assigned_to_user_id=v_line.user_id)
    or (v_scope='assigned_by_me' and x.assigned_by_user_id=v_line.user_id)
  )
  order by x.created_at desc
  limit greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,30),100))
 ) t;
 return jsonb_build_object('items',v_items,'count',jsonb_array_length(v_items));
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_healthcare_directory_choices(p_line_user_id text, p_field text, p_hospital_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 8)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare v_line record;v_items jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;v_limit integer:=least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,8),1),12);v_field text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_field,'')));
begin
 select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
 if v_line.user_id is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_linked';end if;
 if v_field='hospital_name' then
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('value',x.value,'short_label',x.short_label,'source','central')),'[]'::jsonb) into v_items
  from (select o.name as value,coalesce(nullif(o.external_code,''),left(o.name,14)) as short_label
        from public.healthcare_organizations o where o.deleted_at is null
        and nullif(btrim(o.name),'') is not null
        order by o.name limit v_limit) x;
 elsif v_field='department' then
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('value',x.value,'short_label',x.short_label,'source','central')),'[]'::jsonb) into v_items
  from (select distinct on (su.name) su.name as value, left(su.name,14) as short_label
        from public.healthcare_service_units su join public.healthcare_organizations o on o.id=su.organization_id
        where su.deleted_at is null and o.deleted_at is null
          and (nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_hospital_name,'')),'') is null
             or lower(o.name)=lower(btrim(p_hospital_name))
             or (o.external_code is not null and lower(o.external_code)=lower(btrim(p_hospital_name))))
        order by su.name limit v_limit) x;
 end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('field',v_field,'items',v_items);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_healthcare_master_overview(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_can_edit boolean;
  v_hospitals jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_line
  from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
  if v_line.user_id is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_linked'; end if;

  v_can_edit:=private.phms_line_can_manage_healthcare_master(p_line_user_id);

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(h order by h->>'hospital_name'),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_hospitals
  from (
    select jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'record_code',substr(o.id::text,1,12),
      'organization_id',o.id,
      'hospital_name',o.name,
      'branch_name',o.branch_name,
      'external_code',o.external_code,
      'phone',o.phone,
      'email',o.email,
      'address_text',o.address_text,
      'website_url',o.website_url,
      'is_verified',o.is_verified,
      'source',o.source,
      'units',coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'record_code',substr(u.id::text,1,12),
          'service_unit_id',u.id,
          'name',u.name,
          'code',u.code,
          'location_detail',u.location_detail,
          'building_name',u.building_name,
          'floor_label',u.floor_label,
          'contact_point',u.contact_point,
          'phone',u.phone,
          'email',u.email,
          'contact_note',u.contact_note,
          'reschedule_contact_phone',u.reschedule_contact_phone,
          'reschedule_contact_email',u.reschedule_contact_email,
          'reschedule_hours_text',u.reschedule_hours_text,
          'reschedule_instructions',u.reschedule_instructions,
          'reschedule_min_notice_minutes',u.reschedule_min_notice_minutes,
          'is_verified',u.is_verified,
          'source',u.source
        )) order by coalesce(u.code,u.name),u.name)
        from public.healthcare_service_units u
        where u.organization_id=o.id and u.deleted_at is null
      ),'[]'::jsonb)
    )) h
    from public.healthcare_organizations o
    where o.deleted_at is null
  ) q;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'can_edit',v_can_edit,
    'hospitals',v_hospitals
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_home_medication_alerts_v1(p_line_user_id text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_family_id uuid;
  v_items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
  if v_line.user_id is null then return jsonb_build_object('items',v_items); end if;
  select c.active_family_id into v_family_id
  from private.line_identity_contexts c
  where c.line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;
  if v_family_id is null then
    select fm.family_id into v_family_id
    from public.family_memberships fm join public.families f on f.id=fm.family_id
    where fm.user_id=v_line.user_id and fm.status='active' and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
    order by fm.created_at limit 1;
  end if;
  if v_family_id is null then return jsonb_build_object('items',v_items); end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.item order by x.sort_at desc),'[]'::jsonb) into v_items
  from (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'kind','medication',
      'person_name',private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.id),
      'person_code',substr(encode(digest(fp.id::text||':'||v_line.line_identity_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
      'record_code',substr(pm.id::text,1,12),
      'name',coalesce(nullif(mm.brand_name,''),nullif(mm.generic_name,''),'รายการยา'),
      'schedule_kind','recorded_time_of_day'
    ) as item,
    coalesce(pm.updated_at,pm.created_at) as sort_at
    from public.family_persons fp
    join public.persons pe on pe.id=fp.person_id
    join public.family_memberships fm on fm.family_id=fp.family_id
      and fm.user_id=v_line.user_id and fm.status='active'
    join public.person_medications pm on pm.person_id=fp.person_id
      and pm.deleted_at is null and pm.status='regular'
    join public.medication_master mm on mm.id=pm.medication_id
    join lateral (
      select mr.* from public.medication_regimens mr
      where mr.person_medication_id=pm.id and mr.deleted_at is null and mr.is_current=true
      order by mr.effective_from desc,mr.created_at desc limit 1
    ) mr on true
    where fp.family_id=v_family_id
      and fp.setup_status='ready'
      and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
      and coalesce(pe.status,'active')='active'
      and private.family_person_is_visible_to_user(v_line.user_id,fp.id)
      and private.user_can_see_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id)
      and private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'medications','view')
      and (pm.start_date is null or pm.start_date <= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date)
      and (pm.end_date is null or pm.end_date >= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date)
      and (mr.effective_from is null or mr.effective_from <= now())
      and (mr.effective_to is null or mr.effective_to > now())
      and (coalesce(cardinality(mr.exact_times),0)>0 or coalesce(cardinality(mr.time_of_day),0)>0)
    order by coalesce(pm.updated_at,pm.created_at) desc,pm.id
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,10),1),20)
  ) x;
  return jsonb_build_object('items',v_items);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_household_pending_requests(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare a record;v_rows jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
begin
 select * into a from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.data order by x.at desc),'[]'::jsonb) into v_rows
 from (
  select r.created_at at,jsonb_build_object('kind','owner_transfer',
   'request_code',substr(r.id::text,1,12),'family_id',r.family_id,
   'from_name',private.family_user_label_for_viewer(a.user_id,r.family_id,r.current_owner_user_id),
   'to_name',private.family_user_label_for_viewer(a.user_id,r.family_id,r.proposed_owner_user_id),
   'can_decide',r.proposed_owner_user_id=a.user_id,'status',r.status) data
  from private.household_owner_transfer_requests r where r.status='pending'
   and (r.current_owner_user_id=a.user_id or r.proposed_owner_user_id=a.user_id)
  union all
  select r.created_at,jsonb_build_object('kind','admin_resignation',
   'request_code',substr(r.id::text,1,12),'family_id',r.family_id,
   'from_name',private.family_user_label_for_viewer(a.user_id,r.family_id,r.admin_user_id),
   'can_decide',private.user_has_family_role(a.user_id,r.family_id,array['owner']),'status',r.status)
  from private.household_admin_resignation_requests r where r.status='pending'
    and (r.admin_user_id=a.user_id or private.user_has_family_role(a.user_id,r.family_id,array['owner']))
 ) x;
 return jsonb_build_object('items',v_rows,'count',jsonb_array_length(v_rows));
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_link_group_family(p_line_user_id text, p_line_group_id text, p_family_code text, p_channel_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_picture_url text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid;
  v_family public.families%rowtype;
  v_count integer;
  v_channel public.family_channels%rowtype;
  v_code text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_family_code,'')));
  v_had_active_link boolean:=false;
  v_linked_families jsonb;
begin
  select li.user_id into v_actor
  from public.line_identities li
  where li.line_user_id=p_line_user_id
    and li.is_active=true and li.onboarding_status='ready'
  order by li.updated_at desc nulls last,li.created_at desc
  limit 1;
  if v_actor is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_ready'; end if;
  if length(btrim(coalesce(p_line_group_id,'')))<8 then raise exception 'invalid_line_group_id'; end if;
  if length(v_code)<4 then raise exception 'family_code_too_short'; end if;

  select count(*) into v_count
  from public.families f
  join public.family_memberships fm on fm.family_id=f.id
  where fm.user_id=v_actor and fm.status='active'
    and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
    and (lower(f.id::text) like v_code||'%' or lower(coalesce(f.family_code,''))=v_code)
    and private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,f.id,array['owner','admin']);
  if v_count=0 then raise exception 'family_not_found_or_permission_denied'; end if;
  if v_count>1 then raise exception 'family_code_ambiguous'; end if;

  select f.* into v_family
  from public.families f
  join public.family_memberships fm on fm.family_id=f.id
  where fm.user_id=v_actor and fm.status='active'
    and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
    and (lower(f.id::text) like v_code||'%' or lower(coalesce(f.family_code,''))=v_code)
    and private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,f.id,array['owner','admin'])
  limit 1;

  select * into v_channel
  from public.family_channels
  where channel_type='line_group'
    and external_channel_id=btrim(p_line_group_id)
  limit 1
  for update;

  if v_channel.id is null then
    insert into public.family_channels(
      family_id,channel_type,external_channel_id,channel_name,channel_picture_url,
      status,can_receive_notifications,can_query_bot,privacy_level,
      linked_by,linked_at,created_at,updated_at,last_seen_at
    ) values(
      v_family.id,'line_group',btrim(p_line_group_id),
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_channel_name,'')),''),
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_picture_url,'')),''),
      'active',true,false,'summary',
      v_actor,now(),now(),now(),now()
    ) returning * into v_channel;
  else
    if v_channel.status not in ('pending_link','active') then raise exception 'line_group_not_present'; end if;
    if v_channel.status='pending_link' and v_channel.last_completed_at is not null
       and exists(select 1 from public.family_channel_family_links l where l.family_channel_id=v_channel.id and l.status='active')
      then raise exception 'group_reconfirmation_required'; end if;
    select exists(
      select 1 from public.family_channel_family_links l
      where l.family_channel_id=v_channel.id and l.status='active'
    ) into v_had_active_link;

    update public.family_channels
    set family_id=coalesce(family_id,v_family.id),
        channel_name=coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_channel_name,'')),''),channel_name),
        channel_picture_url=coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_picture_url,'')),''),channel_picture_url),
        status='active',
        can_receive_notifications=true,
        can_query_bot=case when v_had_active_link then can_query_bot else false end,
        privacy_level='summary',
        linked_by=coalesce(linked_by,v_actor),
        linked_at=coalesce(linked_at,now()),
        last_seen_at=now(),
        updated_at=now()
    where id=v_channel.id
    returning * into v_channel;
  end if;

  insert into public.family_channel_family_links(
    family_channel_id,family_id,status,linked_by,linked_at,created_at,updated_at
  ) values(
    v_channel.id,v_family.id,'active',v_actor,now(),now(),now()
  )
  on conflict(family_channel_id,family_id)
  do update set
    status='active',
    linked_by=v_actor,
    linked_at=now(),
    updated_at=now();

  update public.line_group_link_requests
  set status='cancelled',
      reviewed_by=v_actor,
      reviewed_at=now(),
      review_note='linked_directly_by_manager',
      updated_at=now()
  where family_channel_id=v_channel.id
    and family_id=v_family.id
    and status='pending';

  update public.notifications n
  set status='cancelled',
      last_error='group_family_linked_directly_by_manager',
      updated_at=now()
  where n.event_type='line_group_link_request'
    and n.status in ('pending','failed')
    and exists(
      select 1 from public.line_group_link_requests r
      where r.id=n.related_record_id
        and r.family_channel_id=v_channel.id
        and r.family_id=v_family.id
        and r.status='cancelled'
    );

  insert into public.audit_logs(
    family_id,actor_user_id,event_type,resource,record_id,new_data,description
  ) values(
    v_family.id,v_actor,'line_group_family_linked','family_channel',v_channel.id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'line_group_id',v_channel.external_channel_id,
      'channel_name',v_channel.channel_name,
      'linked_via','private_admin_setup',
      'multi_family',true
    ),
    'เชื่อม LINE กลุ่มเข้ากับครอบครัว'
  );

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'family_id',f.id,
    'family_code',substr(f.id::text,1,12),
    'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว')
  ) order by coalesce(f.family_name,'')),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_linked_families
  from public.family_channel_family_links l
  join public.families f on f.id=l.family_id
  where l.family_channel_id=v_channel.id and l.status='active';

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'family_id',v_family.id,
    'family_code',substr(v_family.id::text,1,12),
    'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_family.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),
    'family_channel_id',v_channel.id,
    'channel_code',substr(v_channel.id::text,1,12),
    'channel_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_channel.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
    'line_group_id',v_channel.external_channel_id,
    'linked_families',v_linked_families
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_list_recycle_bin(p_line_user_id text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_ctx private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype;
  v_items jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
  perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.line_identity_id,v_line.user_id);
  select * into v_ctx from private.line_identity_contexts where line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;
  if v_ctx.active_scope<>'family' or v_ctx.active_family_id is null then raise exception 'family_context_required'; end if;
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',v_line.user_id::text,true);

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.item order by x.trashed_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from (
    select rb.trashed_at,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'trash_code',substr(encode(digest(rb.id::text||':'||v_line.line_identity_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
        'resource',rb.resource,
        'record_code',substr(rb.record_id::text,1,12),
        'action',rb.action,
        'person_name',case when rb.family_person_id is null then null else private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,rb.family_person_id) end,
        'title',
          case rb.resource
            when 'medication' then coalesce(
              nullif(rb.snapshot->>'indication',''),
              (select coalesce(mm.brand_name,mm.generic_name) from public.person_medications pm join public.medication_master mm on mm.id=pm.medication_id where pm.id=rb.record_id),
              'ยา'
            )
            when 'appointment' then coalesce(nullif(rb.snapshot->>'title',''),'นัดหมาย')
            when 'health' then coalesce(nullif(rb.snapshot->>'measurement_type',''),'ข้อมูลสุขภาพ')
            when 'document' then coalesce(nullif(rb.snapshot->>'title',''),nullif(rb.snapshot->>'document_type',''),'เอกสาร')
            when 'storage_asset' then coalesce(nullif(rb.snapshot->>'original_filename',''),nullif(rb.snapshot->>'object_name',''),'รูป/ไฟล์')
            when 'appointment_document_link' then 'เอกสารที่เอาออกจากนัด'
            else rb.resource
          end,
        'detail',
          case rb.resource
            when 'medication' then case when rb.action='stop' then 'หยุดยา' else 'ย้ายเข้าถังขยะ' end
            when 'appointment' then case when rb.action='cancel' then 'ยกเลิกนัด' else concat_ws(' • ',nullif(rb.snapshot->>'hospital_name',''),nullif(rb.snapshot->>'department','')) end
            when 'health' then coalesce(rb.snapshot->>'value_text',rb.snapshot->>'value_numeric','')
            when 'document' then coalesce(rb.snapshot->>'document_type','')
            when 'storage_asset' then coalesce(rb.snapshot->>'mime_type','')
            else ''
          end,
        'trashed_at',rb.trashed_at,
        'can_restore',
          case
            when rb.family_person_id is null then private.is_family_owner(rb.family_id)
            when rb.resource='medication' then private.can_access_family_person(rb.family_person_id,'medications','update')
            when rb.resource in ('appointment','appointment_document_link') then private.can_access_family_person(rb.family_person_id,'appointments','update')
            when rb.resource='health' then private.can_access_family_person(rb.family_person_id,'health_data','update')
            when rb.resource='document' then private.can_access_family_person(rb.family_person_id,'health_data','update')
            when rb.resource='storage_asset' and coalesce(rb.snapshot->>'permission_resource','health')='appointments'
              then private.can_access_family_person(rb.family_person_id,'appointments','update')
            when rb.resource='storage_asset' and coalesce(rb.snapshot->>'permission_resource','health')='medications'
              then private.can_access_family_person(rb.family_person_id,'medications','update')
            else private.can_access_family_person(rb.family_person_id,'health_data','update')
          end
      ) item
    from private.phms_recycle_bin rb
    where rb.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
      and rb.restored_at is null
      and (
        rb.family_person_id is null
        or private.user_can_see_family_person(v_line.user_id,rb.family_person_id)
        or private.can_manage_permissions(rb.family_id)
      )
    order by rb.trashed_at desc
    limit greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,30),100))
  ) x;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'family_id',v_ctx.active_family_id,
    'active_family_person_id',v_ctx.active_family_person_id,
    'count',jsonb_array_length(v_items),
    'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_medical_my_jobs(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare v_line record;v_items jsonb;
begin
 select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'job_code',substr(aa.id::text,1,12),
 'appointment_code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),
 'person_name',private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,a.family_person_id),
 'appointment_at',a.appointment_at,'hospital',coalesce(nullif(a.hospital_name,''),'สถานพยาบาล'),
 'location',a.location_detail,
 'job_role',aa.assignment_role,'job_note',aa.note,
 'status',aa.status,'expires_at',a.appointment_at+interval '1 day')
 order by a.appointment_at),'[]'::jsonb) into v_items
 from public.appointment_assignees aa
 join public.appointments a on a.id=aa.appointment_id and a.deleted_at is null
 where aa.user_id=v_line.user_id
   and aa.status in ('assigned','accepted')
   and aa.assignment_role in ('driver','companion','booker','responsible','other','documents')
   and a.status in ('scheduled','confirmed')
   and a.appointment_at > now()-interval '1 day'
   and exists (select 1 from public.family_memberships fm where fm.family_id=a.family_id and fm.user_id=v_line.user_id and fm.status='active')
   and not exists(select 1 from private.medical_oneoff_job_completions c where c.assignment_id=aa.id);
 return jsonb_build_object('items',v_items,'count',jsonb_array_length(v_items));
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_medical_primary_requests(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare v_line record; v_items jsonb;
begin
 select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'request_code',substr(x.id::text,1,12),
   'person_name',coalesce(nullif(p.display_name,''),nullif(p.nickname,''),'คนในบ้าน'),
   'requester_name',private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,x.family_id,x.requested_by),
   'reason',x.request_note,'status',x.status,'created_at',x.created_at,
   'incoming',x.proposed_user_id=v_line.user_id
 ) order by x.created_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
 into v_items
 from private.medical_primary_transfer_requests x
 join public.family_persons fp on fp.id=x.family_person_id
 join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
 where x.status='pending'
   and (x.proposed_user_id=v_line.user_id or x.requested_by=v_line.user_id)
   and exists(select 1 from public.family_memberships fm where fm.family_id=x.family_id and fm.user_id=v_line.user_id and fm.status='active');
 return jsonb_build_object('items',v_items,'count',jsonb_array_length(v_items));
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_medical_record_request_set_fee(p_line_user_id text, p_request_code text, p_paid_amount numeric, p_payment_method_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_payer text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_expense_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_req public.medical_record_requests%rowtype;
  v_exp public.healthcare_expenses%rowtype;
  v_amount numeric:=coalesce(p_paid_amount,0);
begin
  if v_amount<0 then raise exception 'record_request_fee_negative'; end if;

  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_record_request_for_line(p_line_user_id,p_request_code,'update')
  limit 1;

  select * into v_req
  from public.medical_record_requests
  where id=v_ref.request_id;

  select * into v_exp
  from public.healthcare_expenses
  where medical_record_request_id=v_req.id and deleted_at is null
  limit 1;

  if v_exp.id is null then
    insert into public.healthcare_expenses(
      person_id,encounter_id,organization_id,document_id,expense_date,currency,
      medication_amount,service_amount,other_amount,total_amount,paid_amount,
      payer,payment_method,notes,created_by,
      coverage_used,covered_amount,payment_status,payment_method_code,
      treatment_episode_id,medical_record_request_id,payment_recorded_at
    ) values(
      v_ref.person_id,null,v_req.organization_id,null,
      coalesce(p_expense_date,v_req.requested_at::date,current_date),'THB',
      0,v_amount,0,v_amount,v_amount,
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_payer,'')),''),
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_payment_method_code,'')),''),
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_note,'')),''),'ค่าขอ/คัดสำเนาเวชระเบียน'),
      v_ref.actor_user_id,
      false,0,case when v_amount=0 then 'no_charge' else 'self_pay' end,
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_payment_method_code,'')),''),
      v_req.treatment_episode_id,v_req.id,now()
    )
    returning * into v_exp;
  else
    update public.healthcare_expenses
    set expense_date=coalesce(p_expense_date,expense_date),
        service_amount=v_amount,
        total_amount=v_amount,
        paid_amount=v_amount,
        payer=coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_payer,'')),''),payer),
        payment_method=coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_payment_method_code,'')),''),payment_method),
        payment_method_code=coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_payment_method_code,'')),''),payment_method_code),
        payment_status=case when v_amount=0 then 'no_charge' else 'self_pay' end,
        notes=coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_note,'')),''),notes,'ค่าขอ/คัดสำเนาเวชระเบียน'),
        payment_recorded_at=now(),
        updated_at=now()
    where id=v_exp.id
    returning * into v_exp;

    update public.healthcare_expense_items
    set deleted_at=now(),updated_at=now()
    where expense_id=v_exp.id and deleted_at is null;
  end if;

  insert into public.healthcare_expense_items(
    expense_id,category,label,amount,note,sort_order,created_by
  ) values(
    v_exp.id,'other','ค่าขอ/คัดสำเนาเวชระเบียน',v_amount,
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_note,'')),''),1,v_ref.actor_user_id
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'request_code',substr(v_req.id::text,1,12),
    'expense_code',substr(v_exp.id::text,1,12),
    'paid_amount',v_exp.paid_amount
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_medical_record_request_workspace(p_line_user_id text, p_request_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_req public.medical_record_requests%rowtype;
  v_items jsonb;
  v_fee jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_record_request_for_line(p_line_user_id,p_request_code,'view')
  limit 1;

  select * into v_req
  from public.medical_record_requests
  where id=v_ref.request_id;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',i.id,
    'code',substr(i.id::text,1,12),
    'document_type',i.requested_document_type,
    'title',i.title,
    'service_period_start',i.service_period_start,
    'service_period_end',i.service_period_end,
    'status',i.status,
    'received_at',i.received_at,
    'note',i.note,
    'document_code',case when d.id is not null then substr(d.id::text,1,12) end,
    'document_date',d.document_date,
    'document_received_at',d.received_at,
    'storage_asset_id',d.storage_asset_id
  )) order by i.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from public.medical_record_request_items i
  left join public.medical_documents d on d.id=i.medical_document_id
  where i.request_id=v_req.id;

  select jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'expense_code',substr(h.id::text,1,12),
    'paid_amount',h.paid_amount,
    'total_amount',h.total_amount,
    'expense_date',h.expense_date,
    'payment_method_code',h.payment_method_code,
    'payer',h.payer,
    'notes',h.notes
  ))
  into v_fee
  from public.healthcare_expenses h
  where h.medical_record_request_id=v_req.id and h.deleted_at is null
  order by h.created_at desc
  limit 1;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'request',jsonb_strip_nulls(to_jsonb(v_req)||jsonb_build_object(
      'code',substr(v_req.id::text,1,12),
      'episode_code',case when v_req.treatment_episode_id is not null then substr(v_req.treatment_episode_id::text,1,12) end,
      'person_name',v_ref.person_name,
      'organization_name',(
        select o.name||
          case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(o.branch_name,'')),'') is not null then ' '||btrim(o.branch_name) else '' end||
          case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(o.external_code,'')),'') is not null then ' ('||btrim(o.external_code)||')' else '' end
        from public.healthcare_organizations o
        where o.id=v_req.organization_id
      )
    )),
    'items',v_items,
    'fee',v_fee
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_notification_target_options(p_line_user_id text, p_batch_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
 v_line record;
 v_batch public.data_intake_commit_batches%rowtype;
 v_ds public.data_intake_sessions%rowtype;
 v_users jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
 v_groups jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
begin
 select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
 select * into v_batch
 from public.data_intake_commit_batches b
 where b.id=p_batch_id and b.requested_by=v_line.user_id;
 if not found then raise exception 'commit_batch_not_found'; end if;

 select * into v_ds
 from public.data_intake_sessions s
 where s.id=v_batch.session_id;
 if not found then raise exception 'intake_session_not_found'; end if;

 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'code',substr(encode(digest(fm.user_id::text||':'||v_line.line_identity_id::text||':'||v_ds.family_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
   'display_name',coalesce(pr.display_name,(select li.display_name from public.line_identities li where li.user_id=fm.user_id and li.is_active=true order by li.updated_at desc nulls last limit 1),'สมาชิก PHMS'),
   'is_self',fm.user_id=v_line.user_id,
   'line_ready',exists(select 1 from public.line_identities li where li.user_id=fm.user_id and li.is_active=true and li.onboarding_status='ready'),
   'selected',exists(
     select 1 from public.record_notification_targets nt
     where nt.intake_batch_id=p_batch_id
       and nt.target_type='user'
       and nt.target_user_id=fm.user_id
       and nt.enabled=true
   )
 ) order by fm.user_id=v_line.user_id desc,lower(coalesce(pr.display_name,''))),'[]'::jsonb)
 into v_users
 from public.family_memberships fm
 left join public.profiles pr on pr.id=fm.user_id
 where fm.family_id=v_ds.family_id and fm.status='active';

 if private.user_has_family_role(v_line.user_id,v_ds.family_id,array['owner','admin']) then
   select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
     'code',substr(encode(digest(fc.external_channel_id||':'||v_line.line_identity_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
     'line_group_id',fc.external_channel_id,
     'label',coalesce(nullif(btrim(fc.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
     'selected',exists(
       select 1 from public.record_notification_targets nt
       where nt.intake_batch_id=p_batch_id
         and nt.target_type='line_group'
         and nt.line_group_id=fc.external_channel_id
         and nt.enabled=true
     )
   ) order by coalesce(fc.channel_name,''),fc.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)
   into v_groups
   from public.family_channel_family_links l
   join public.family_channels fc on fc.id=l.family_channel_id
   where l.family_id=v_ds.family_id
     and l.status='active'
     and fc.channel_type='line_group'
     and fc.status='active'
     and coalesce(fc.can_receive_notifications,true)=true;
 end if;

 return jsonb_build_object(
   'batch_id',p_batch_id,
   'family_id',v_ds.family_id,
   'person_id',v_ds.person_id,
   'users',v_users,
   'groups',v_groups,
   'group_access_mode','notifications_and_view_only'
 );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_person_extra_summaries(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 v_line record; v_ctx private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype;
 v_person uuid; v_docs boolean := false; v_exp boolean := false; v_appts boolean := false;
 v_d jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; v_e jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
 v_dc integer := 0; v_ec integer := 0; v_total numeric; v_month numeric; v_prev numeric; v_prev_count integer; v_known boolean;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO v_line FROM private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
 PERFORM private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.line_identity_id,v_line.user_id);
 SELECT * INTO v_ctx FROM private.line_identity_contexts WHERE line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;
 IF v_ctx.active_scope <> 'family' OR v_ctx.active_family_person_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'family_person_context_required'; END IF;
 IF NOT private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,v_ctx.active_family_person_id,'persons','view') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'person_view_denied'; END IF;
 SELECT person_id INTO v_person FROM public.family_persons WHERE id=v_ctx.active_family_person_id;
 v_docs := private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,v_ctx.active_family_person_id,'documents','view');
 v_exp := private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,v_ctx.active_family_person_id,'expenses','view');
 v_appts := private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,v_ctx.active_family_person_id,'appointments','view');
 IF v_docs THEN
   WITH available AS (
     SELECT md.id::text id,coalesce(nullif(md.title,''),'เอกสาร') title,
       md.document_date d,md.created_at created,md.document_type kind,
       md.storage_bucket bucket,md.storage_path path,md.mime_type mime,
       CASE WHEN v_appts THEN (SELECT ap.title FROM public.appointment_document_links dl JOIN public.appointments ap ON ap.id=dl.appointment_id AND ap.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE dl.medical_document_id=md.id ORDER BY dl.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) END appointment_title,
       CASE WHEN v_appts THEN (SELECT ap.appointment_at::date FROM public.appointment_document_links dl JOIN public.appointments ap ON ap.id=dl.appointment_id AND ap.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE dl.medical_document_id=md.id ORDER BY dl.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) END appointment_date,
       (md.document_type ~* '(receipt|invoice|payment|expense|bill|ใบเสร็จ|การเงิน|ค่าใช้จ่าย)' OR EXISTS
       (SELECT 1 FROM public.healthcare_expenses e WHERE e.document_id=md.id AND e.deleted_at IS NULL)) finance
     FROM public.medical_documents md WHERE md.person_id=v_person AND md.deleted_at IS NULL
     UNION ALL
     SELECT a.id::text,
       coalesce(nullif(a.original_filename,''),CASE l.link_kind WHEN 'preparation' THEN 'เอกสารเตรียมก่อนนัด' WHEN 'result' THEN 'ผลตรวจจากนัด' WHEN 'receipt' THEN 'ใบเสร็จ' WHEN 'payment_qr' THEN 'หลักฐานชำระเงิน' ELSE 'เอกสารนัด' END),
       a.captured_at::date,a.created_at,l.link_kind,
       a.bucket_id,a.object_name,a.mime_type,
       CASE WHEN v_appts THEN ap.title END,CASE WHEN v_appts THEN ap.appointment_at::date END,
       l.link_kind IN ('receipt','payment_qr')
     FROM public.appointment_document_links l
     JOIN public.appointments ap ON ap.id=l.appointment_id AND ap.deleted_at IS NULL
     JOIN public.phms_storage_assets a ON a.id=l.storage_asset_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
     WHERE ap.person_id=v_person AND v_appts
       AND a.permission_resource IN ('appointments','documents')
       AND a.lifecycle_state IN ('active','confirmed','temporary')
   ), eligible AS (
     SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) * FROM available WHERE v_exp OR NOT finance ORDER BY id,created DESC
   ), ordered AS (
     SELECT * FROM eligible ORDER BY d DESC NULLS LAST,created DESC,id DESC
   )
   SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ordered),
     (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('title',title,'date',d,'type',kind,
       'preview_bucket',CASE WHEN mime LIKE 'image/%' THEN bucket END,
       'preview_path',CASE WHEN mime LIKE 'image/%' THEN path END,
       'is_image',mime LIKE 'image/%',
       'appointment_title',appointment_title,'appointment_date',appointment_date)
       ORDER BY d DESC NULLS LAST,created DESC,id DESC),'[]'::jsonb)
       FROM (SELECT * FROM ordered LIMIT 5) first_five)
   INTO v_dc,v_d;
 END IF;
 IF v_exp THEN
   SELECT count(*)::integer, coalesce(jsonb_agg(z.j ORDER BY z.expense_date DESC NULLS LAST), '[]'::jsonb)
   INTO v_ec,v_e
   FROM (SELECT e.expense_date,jsonb_build_object('date',e.expense_date,'amount',e.paid_amount,'currency',e.currency,
           'appointment_title', CASE WHEN v_appts THEN nullif(btrim(a.title),'') ELSE NULL END) j
         FROM public.healthcare_expenses e LEFT JOIN public.appointments a ON a.id=e.appointment_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
         WHERE e.person_id=v_person AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
         ORDER BY e.expense_date DESC NULLS LAST,e.created_at DESC LIMIT 5) z;
   SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_amount IS NULL)=0,
      sum(paid_amount),
      sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE expense_date>=date_trunc('month',now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date
       AND expense_date<(date_trunc('month',now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')+interval '1 month')::date)
   INTO v_known,v_total,v_month
   FROM public.healthcare_expenses WHERE person_id=v_person AND deleted_at IS NULL;
   SELECT count(*)::integer, sum(paid_amount) INTO v_prev_count,v_prev
   FROM public.healthcare_expenses WHERE person_id=v_person AND deleted_at IS NULL
     AND expense_date >= (date_trunc('month',now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')-interval '1 month')::date
     AND expense_date < date_trunc('month',now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date;
   SELECT count(*) INTO v_ec FROM public.healthcare_expenses WHERE person_id=v_person AND deleted_at IS NULL;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object(
   'documents',jsonb_build_object('view',v_docs,'count',v_dc,'items',v_d),
   'expenses',jsonb_build_object('view',v_exp,'count',v_ec,'items',v_e,'updated_at',CASE WHEN v_exp THEN (SELECT max(coalesce(e.updated_at,e.created_at)) FROM public.healthcare_expenses e WHERE e.person_id=v_person AND e.deleted_at IS NULL) END,
    'total_paid',CASE WHEN v_known THEN coalesce(v_total,0) END,
    'month_paid',CASE WHEN v_known THEN coalesce(v_month,0) END,
    'previous_month_paid',CASE WHEN v_known AND v_prev_count>0 THEN v_prev END,
    'previous_month_count',coalesce(v_prev_count,0),
    'amounts_verified',coalesce(v_known,false)));
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_preventive_plan_overview(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare v_line record;v_items jsonb;
begin
 select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
