 if v_line.user_id is null then return jsonb_build_object('items','[]'::jsonb);end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('plan_type',x.plan_type,'care_item',x.care_item,'next_due_on',x.next_due_on,'interval_value',x.interval_value,'interval_unit',x.interval_unit,'due_source',x.due_source,'status',x.status,'can_edit',x.can_edit) order by x.next_due_on nulls last),'[]'::jsonb)
 into v_items from (
 select pc.plan_type,pc.care_item,pc.next_due_on,pc.interval_value,pc.interval_unit,pc.due_source,pc.status,
 private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'appointments','update') as can_edit
 from public.preventive_care_plans pc join public.family_persons fp on fp.person_id=pc.person_id and fp.family_id=pc.family_id and fp.status='active'
 where pc.deleted_at is null and pc.status in ('active','draft')
 and private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'appointments','view')
 order by pc.next_due_on nulls last limit 30
 ) x;
 return jsonb_build_object('items',v_items);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_select_own_dashboard_context_v1(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
 v_line record;
 v_existing private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype;
 v_target record;
begin
 select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
 if v_line.user_id is null then raise exception 'line_account_not_linked'; end if;
 perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.line_identity_id,v_line.user_id);
 select * into v_existing from private.line_identity_contexts
 where line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;
 select fp.id as family_person_id,fp.family_id into v_target
 from public.persons pe
 join public.family_persons fp on fp.person_id=pe.id
 join public.families f on f.id=fp.family_id
 join public.family_memberships fm on fm.family_id=fp.family_id
  and fm.user_id=v_line.user_id and fm.status='active'
 where pe.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id
   and coalesce(pe.status,'active')='active'
   and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
   and fp.setup_status='ready'
   and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
   and private.user_can_see_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id)
   and private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'persons','view')
 order by (fp.family_id=v_existing.active_family_id) desc nulls last,
          (fp.id=v_existing.active_family_person_id) desc nulls last,
          fp.created_at asc
 limit 1;
 if not found then raise exception 'self_dashboard_not_accessible'; end if;
 update private.line_identity_contexts
 set active_scope='family',active_family_id=v_target.family_id,
     active_family_person_id=v_target.family_person_id,
     context_changed_at=now(),updated_at=now()
 where line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id and user_id=v_line.user_id;
 if not found then raise exception 'line_identity_context_missing'; end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('ok',true);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_treatment_episode_overview(p_line_user_id text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ctx record;
  v_items jsonb;
  v_limit int:=least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,20),1),50);
begin
  select * into v_ctx
  from private.phms_line_active_treatment_context(p_line_user_id,'view')
  limit 1;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(item order by sort_at desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from (
    select
      coalesce(e.updated_at,e.created_at) sort_at,
      jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',e.id,
        'code',substr(e.id::text,1,12),
        'title',e.title,
        'care_topic',e.care_topic,
        'status',e.status,
        'started_at',e.started_at,
        'ended_at',e.ended_at,
        'summary',e.summary,
        'organization_name',
          case when o.id is not null then
            o.name||
            case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(o.branch_name,'')),'') is not null then ' '||btrim(o.branch_name) else '' end||
            case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(o.external_code,'')),'') is not null then ' ('||btrim(o.external_code)||')' else '' end
          end,
        'encounter_count',(select count(*)::int from public.encounters x where x.treatment_episode_id=e.id and x.deleted_at is null),
        'appointment_count',(select count(*)::int from public.appointments a where a.treatment_episode_id=e.id and a.deleted_at is null),
        'document_count',(select count(*)::int from public.medical_documents d where d.treatment_episode_id=e.id and d.deleted_at is null),
        'record_request_count',(select count(*)::int from public.medical_record_requests r where r.treatment_episode_id=e.id and r.deleted_at is null),
        'expense_total',coalesce((select sum(coalesce(h.paid_amount,h.total_amount,0)) from public.healthcare_expenses h where h.treatment_episode_id=e.id and h.deleted_at is null),0),
        'next_appointment',(
          select jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
            'code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),
            'title',a.title,
            'appointment_at',a.appointment_at,
            'hospital_name',a.hospital_name,
            'status',a.status
          ))
          from public.appointments a
          where a.treatment_episode_id=e.id
            and a.deleted_at is null
            and a.status not in ('cancelled','no_show','completed')
            and a.appointment_at>=now()
          order by a.appointment_at
          limit 1
        )
      )) item
    from public.treatment_episodes e
    left join public.healthcare_organizations o on o.id=e.primary_organization_id
    where e.person_id=v_ctx.person_id
      and e.deleted_at is null
    order by coalesce(e.updated_at,e.created_at) desc
    limit v_limit
  ) q;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'person_name',v_ctx.person_name,
    'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_treatment_episode_workspace(p_line_user_id text, p_episode_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_episode public.treatment_episodes%rowtype;
  v_item jsonb;
  v_events jsonb;
  v_appointments jsonb;
  v_documents jsonb;
  v_requests jsonb;
  v_expenses jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_treatment_episode_for_line(p_line_user_id,p_episode_code,'view')
  limit 1;

  select * into v_episode
  from public.treatment_episodes
  where id=v_ref.episode_id;

  select jsonb_strip_nulls(to_jsonb(v_episode)||jsonb_build_object(
    'code',substr(v_episode.id::text,1,12),
    'person_name',v_ref.person_name,
    'organization_name',(
      select o.name||
        case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(o.branch_name,'')),'') is not null then ' '||btrim(o.branch_name) else '' end||
        case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(o.external_code,'')),'') is not null then ' ('||btrim(o.external_code)||')' else '' end
      from public.healthcare_organizations o
      where o.id=v_episode.primary_organization_id
    )
  )) into v_item;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',e.id,
    'code',substr(e.id::text,1,12),
    'encounter_type',e.encounter_type,
    'started_at',e.started_at,
    'ended_at',e.ended_at,
    'reason',e.reason,
    'summary',e.summary,
    'status',e.status,
    'organization_name',
      case when o.id is not null then
        o.name||
        case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(o.branch_name,'')),'') is not null then ' '||btrim(o.branch_name) else '' end||
        case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(o.external_code,'')),'') is not null then ' ('||btrim(o.external_code)||')' else '' end
      end,
    'appointment_code',case when a.id is not null then substr(a.id::text,1,12) end,
    'appointment_title',a.title
  )) order by e.started_at nulls last,e.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_events
  from public.encounters e
  left join public.healthcare_organizations o on o.id=e.organization_id
  left join public.appointments a on a.encounter_id=e.id and a.deleted_at is null
  where e.treatment_episode_id=v_episode.id
    and e.deleted_at is null;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',a.id,
    'code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),
    'title',a.title,
    'appointment_at',a.appointment_at,
    'status',a.status,
    'hospital_name',a.hospital_name,
    'department',a.department,
    'doctor_name',a.doctor_name,
    'diagnosis_summary',a.diagnosis_summary,
    'treatment_summary',a.treatment_summary,
    'next_steps',a.next_steps
  )) order by a.appointment_at,a.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_appointments
  from public.appointments a
  where a.treatment_episode_id=v_episode.id
    and a.deleted_at is null;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',d.id,
    'code',substr(d.id::text,1,12),
    'document_type',d.document_type,
    'title',d.title,
    'document_date',d.document_date,
    'service_period_start',d.service_period_start,
    'service_period_end',d.service_period_end,
    'received_at',d.received_at,
    'request_code',case when r.id is not null then substr(r.id::text,1,12) end,
    'organization_name',
      case when o.id is not null then
        o.name||
        case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(o.branch_name,'')),'') is not null then ' '||btrim(o.branch_name) else '' end||
        case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(o.external_code,'')),'') is not null then ' ('||btrim(o.external_code)||')' else '' end
      end,
    'storage_asset_id',d.storage_asset_id,
    'mime_type',coalesce(sa.mime_type,d.mime_type),
    'bucket_id',coalesce(sa.bucket_id,d.storage_bucket),
    'object_name',coalesce(sa.object_name,d.storage_path)
  )) order by coalesce(d.document_date,d.service_period_start,d.created_at::date),d.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_documents
  from public.medical_documents d
  left join public.medical_record_requests r on r.id=d.medical_record_request_id
  left join public.healthcare_organizations o on o.id=d.organization_id
  left join public.phms_storage_assets sa on sa.id=d.storage_asset_id
  where d.treatment_episode_id=v_episode.id
    and d.deleted_at is null;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',r.id,
    'code',substr(r.id::text,1,12),
    'requested_at',r.requested_at,
    'received_at',r.received_at,
    'request_channel',r.request_channel,
    'status',r.status,
    'notes',r.notes,
    'organization_name',
      case when o.id is not null then
        o.name||
        case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(o.branch_name,'')),'') is not null then ' '||btrim(o.branch_name) else '' end||
        case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(o.external_code,'')),'') is not null then ' ('||btrim(o.external_code)||')' else '' end
      end,
    'items',(
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',i.id,
        'code',substr(i.id::text,1,12),
        'document_type',i.requested_document_type,
        'title',i.title,
        'service_period_start',i.service_period_start,
        'service_period_end',i.service_period_end,
        'status',i.status,
        'received_at',i.received_at,
        'document_code',case when md.id is not null then substr(md.id::text,1,12) end
      )) order by i.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)
      from public.medical_record_request_items i
      left join public.medical_documents md on md.id=i.medical_document_id
      where i.request_id=r.id
    ),
    'fee',(
      select jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'expense_code',substr(h.id::text,1,12),
        'paid_amount',h.paid_amount,
        'payment_method_code',h.payment_method_code,
        'expense_date',h.expense_date,
        'notes',h.notes
      ))
      from public.healthcare_expenses h
      where h.medical_record_request_id=r.id and h.deleted_at is null
      order by h.created_at desc
      limit 1
    )
  )) order by coalesce(r.requested_at,r.created_at) desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_requests
  from public.medical_record_requests r
  left join public.healthcare_organizations o on o.id=r.organization_id
  where r.treatment_episode_id=v_episode.id
    and r.deleted_at is null;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'code',substr(h.id::text,1,12),
    'expense_date',h.expense_date,
    'paid_amount',h.paid_amount,
    'total_amount',h.total_amount,
    'payment_method_code',h.payment_method_code,
    'notes',h.notes,
    'record_request_code',case when r.id is not null then substr(r.id::text,1,12) end,
    'appointment_code',case when a.id is not null then substr(a.id::text,1,12) end
  )) order by h.expense_date nulls last,h.created_at),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_expenses
  from public.healthcare_expenses h
  left join public.medical_record_requests r on r.id=h.medical_record_request_id
  left join public.appointments a on a.id=h.appointment_id
  where h.treatment_episode_id=v_episode.id
    and h.deleted_at is null;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'episode',v_item,
    'events',v_events,
    'appointments',v_appointments,
    'documents',v_documents,
    'record_requests',v_requests,
    'expenses',v_expenses
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_line_visit_history(p_line_user_id text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_ctx private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype;
  v_fp public.family_persons%rowtype;
  v_person_name text;
  v_items jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_limit int:=least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,20),1),50);
begin
  select * into v_line
  from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);

  perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.line_identity_id,v_line.user_id);

  select * into v_ctx
  from private.line_identity_contexts
  where line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;

  if v_ctx.active_scope<>'family'
     or v_ctx.active_family_id is null
     or v_ctx.active_family_person_id is null then
    raise exception 'active_family_person_required';
  end if;

  select * into v_fp
  from public.family_persons
  where id=v_ctx.active_family_person_id
    and family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
    and status='active';

  if not found then
    raise exception 'active_family_person_not_found';
  end if;

  if not (
    private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,v_fp.id,'appointments','view')
    or private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,v_fp.id,'health_data','view')
  ) then
    raise exception 'visit_history_view_required';
  end if;

  select coalesce(
    p.nickname,
    p.display_name,
    concat_ws(' ',p.first_name,p.last_name),
    'บุคคล'
  )
  into v_person_name
  from public.persons p
  where p.id=v_fp.person_id;

  with rows as (
    select
      e.id as encounter_id,
      a.id as appointment_id,
      coalesce(a.title,e.reason,'พบแพทย์') as title,
      a.hospital_name,
      a.department,
      a.doctor_name,
      e.started_at,
      e.ended_at,
      coalesce(e.summary,a.visit_outcome_notes) as summary,
      e.status,
      e.created_at,
      case when a.id is null then 0 else (
        select count(*) from public.appointment_document_links l where l.appointment_id=a.id
      ) end as document_count
    from public.encounters e
    left join public.appointments a on a.encounter_id=e.id and a.deleted_at is null
    where e.person_id=v_fp.person_id
      and e.deleted_at is null
      and e.status='completed'
    order by e.started_at desc,e.created_at desc
    limit v_limit
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'encounter_id',r.encounter_id,
      'appointment_code',case when r.appointment_id is not null then substr(r.appointment_id::text,1,12) else null end,
      'title',r.title,
      'hospital_name',r.hospital_name,
      'department',r.department,
      'doctor_name',r.doctor_name,
      'started_at',r.started_at,
      'ended_at',r.ended_at,
      'summary',r.summary,
      'status',r.status,
      'document_count',r.document_count
    ))
    order by r.started_at desc,r.created_at desc
  ),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from rows r;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'person_name',v_person_name,
    'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_list_existing_person_candidates_for_line(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(candidate_code text, person_id uuid, family_id uuid, display_name text, relationship_label text, family_name text, birth_year text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line public.line_identities%rowtype;
begin
  if p_line_user_id is null or btrim(p_line_user_id) = '' then
    raise exception 'line_user_id_required';
  end if;

  select * into v_line
  from public.line_identities
  where line_user_id = p_line_user_id
  limit 1;

  if not found then raise exception 'line_identity_not_found'; end if;
  if coalesce(v_line.is_active,false) is not true then raise exception 'active_line_identity_required'; end if;
  if v_line.user_id is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_linked'; end if;

  if exists (
    select 1 from public.persons p
    where p.linked_user_id = v_line.user_id
  ) then
    return;
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1 from public.person_claim_requests pcr
    where pcr.requested_user_id = v_line.user_id
      and pcr.status in ('pending','person_confirmed','approved')
  ) then
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  select
    substr(encode(digest(fp.person_id::text || ':' || fp.family_id::text || ':' || v_line.id::text, 'sha256'),'hex'),1,12) as candidate_code,
    p.id as person_id,
    fp.family_id,
    coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.display_name),''), nullif(btrim(concat_ws(' ',p.first_name,p.last_name)),''), 'ไม่ระบุชื่อ') as display_name,
    fp.relationship_label,
    f.family_name,
    case
      when p.date_of_birth ~ '^\\d{4}-' then substr(p.date_of_birth,1,4)
      when p.date_of_birth ~ '^\\d{4}$' then p.date_of_birth
      else null
    end as birth_year
  from public.family_persons fp
  join public.persons p on p.id = fp.person_id
  join public.families f on f.id = fp.family_id
  where coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
    and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
    and p.linked_user_id is null
    and (
      exists (
        select 1 from public.family_memberships fm
        where fm.user_id = v_line.user_id
          and fm.family_id = fp.family_id
          and fm.status='active'
      )
      or exists (
        select 1 from public.person_permissions pp
        where pp.user_id = v_line.user_id
          and pp.family_person_id = fp.id
          and pp.status='active'
          and pp.can_view=true
      )
    )
  order by f.family_name nulls last, display_name, fp.created_at
  limit 20;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_list_line_access_requests_for_review(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(request_code text, request_id uuid, requester_display_name text, request_type text, requested_role text, resource text, requested_action text, person_name text, reason text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_ctx private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
  perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.line_identity_id,v_line.user_id);
  select c.* into v_ctx
  from private.line_identity_contexts c
  where c.line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;

  if v_ctx.active_scope<>'family' or v_ctx.active_family_id is null then
    raise exception 'family_context_required';
  end if;

  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',v_line.user_id::text,true);

  return query
  select
    substr(encode(digest(prq.id::text||':'||v_line.line_identity_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
    prq.id,
    private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,prq.family_id,prq.requester_user_id),
    prq.request_type,
    prq.requested_role,
    prq.resource,
    prq.requested_action,
    case when prq.family_person_id is null then null
         else private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,prq.family_person_id) end,
    prq.reason,
    prq.created_at
  from public.permission_requests prq
  where prq.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
    and prq.status='pending'
    and prq.requester_user_id<>v_line.user_id
    and (
      (prq.request_type='admin_self_bundle'
          and private.user_has_family_role(v_line.user_id,prq.family_id,array['owner']))
      or (prq.request_type='role' and private.can_grant_role(prq.family_id,prq.requested_role))
      or (prq.request_type='person_bundle'
          and private.can_review_person_access_request(v_line.user_id,prq.family_person_id))
      or (prq.request_type='delegated_person_bundle'
          and (
            prq.target_user_id is distinct from v_line.user_id
            or private.user_has_family_role(v_line.user_id,prq.family_id,array['owner'])
          )
          and private.user_has_family_role(v_line.user_id,prq.family_id,array['owner','admin']))
      or (prq.request_type='self_caregiver'
          and private.can_review_person_access_request(v_line.user_id,prq.family_person_id))
      or (prq.request_type='self_manage'
          and private.can_review_person_access_request(v_line.user_id,prq.family_person_id))
      or (prq.request_type='self_viewer'
          and private.can_review_self_viewer_request(v_line.user_id,prq.family_person_id))
      or (prq.request_type='permission' and prq.requested_action='manage_permissions'
          and private.user_has_family_role(v_line.user_id,prq.family_id,array['owner','admin']))
      or (prq.request_type='permission' and prq.requested_action<>'manage_permissions'
          and (
            (prq.family_person_id is not null
             and private.can_review_person_access_request(v_line.user_id,prq.family_person_id))
            or
            (prq.family_person_id is null
             and private.can_grant_permission(prq.family_id,null,prq.resource,prq.requested_action))
          ))
    )
  order by prq.created_at,prq.id;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_list_line_accessible_people_for_resource(p_line_user_id text, p_resource text)
 RETURNS TABLE(family_selection_code text, family_id uuid, family_name text, person_selection_code text, family_person_id uuid, person_id uuid, display_name text, relationship_label text, is_self boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line public.line_identities%rowtype;
  v_resource text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_resource,'')));
begin
  if v_resource not in ('medications','appointments','health_data') then
    raise exception 'unsupported_permission_resource';
  end if;

  select * into v_line
  from public.line_identities li
  where li.line_user_id=p_line_user_id and li.is_active=true
  order by li.updated_at desc nulls last,li.created_at desc
  limit 1;

  if not found then raise exception 'line_identity_not_found'; end if;
  if v_line.user_id is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_linked'; end if;

  return query
  select
    substr(encode(digest(f.id::text||':'||v_line.id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
    f.id,
    f.family_name,
    substr(encode(digest(fp.id::text||':'||v_line.id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
    fp.id,
    p.id,
    private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.id),
    case
      when p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id then 'ฉัน'
      else coalesce(
        nullif(btrim(v.relationship_label),''),
        nullif(btrim(fp.relationship_label),'')
      )
    end,
    coalesce(p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id,false)
  from public.family_memberships fm
  join public.families f on f.id=fm.family_id
  join public.family_persons fp on fp.family_id=f.id
  join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
  left join public.family_person_view_labels v
    on v.viewer_user_id=v_line.user_id
   and v.family_person_id=fp.id
  left join public.person_context_usage pu
    on pu.user_id=v_line.user_id
   and pu.family_person_id=fp.id
  left join private.family_person_view_preferences pref
    on pref.viewer_user_id=v_line.user_id
   and pref.family_person_id=fp.id
  where fm.user_id=v_line.user_id
    and fm.status='active'
    and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
    and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
    and private.family_person_is_visible_to_user(v_line.user_id,fp.id)
    and private.user_can_see_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id)
    and private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,v_resource,'view')
  order by
    coalesce(p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id,false) desc,
    coalesce(pref.pinned,false) desc,
    pref.sort_rank asc nulls last,
    coalesce(pu.use_count,0) desc,
    pu.last_used_at desc nulls last,
    lower(private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.id)),
    lower(coalesce(f.family_name,'')),
    fp.id;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_list_line_accessible_people_for_resource_action(p_line_user_id text, p_resource text, p_action text DEFAULT 'view'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(family_selection_code text, family_id uuid, family_name text, person_selection_code text, family_person_id uuid, person_id uuid, display_name text, relationship_label text, is_self boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line public.line_identities%rowtype;
  v_resource text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_resource,'')));
  v_action text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_action,'view')));
begin
  if v_resource not in ('medications','appointments','health_data') then
    raise exception 'unsupported_permission_resource';
  end if;
  if v_action not in ('view','create','update','delete') then
    raise exception 'unsupported_permission_action';
  end if;

  select * into v_line
  from public.line_identities li
  where li.line_user_id=p_line_user_id and li.is_active=true
  order by li.updated_at desc nulls last,li.created_at desc
  limit 1;

  if not found then raise exception 'line_identity_not_found'; end if;
  if v_line.user_id is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_linked'; end if;

  return query
  select
    substr(encode(digest(f.id::text||':'||v_line.id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
    f.id,
    f.family_name,
    substr(encode(digest(fp.id::text||':'||v_line.id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
    fp.id,
    p.id,
    private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.id),
    case
      when p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id then 'ฉัน'
      else coalesce(nullif(btrim(v.relationship_label),''),nullif(btrim(fp.relationship_label),''))
    end,
    coalesce(p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id,false)
  from public.family_memberships fm
  join public.families f on f.id=fm.family_id
  join public.family_persons fp on fp.family_id=f.id
  join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
  left join public.family_person_view_labels v
    on v.viewer_user_id=v_line.user_id and v.family_person_id=fp.id
  left join public.person_context_usage pu
    on pu.user_id=v_line.user_id and pu.family_person_id=fp.id
  left join private.family_person_view_preferences pref
    on pref.viewer_user_id=v_line.user_id and pref.family_person_id=fp.id
  where fm.user_id=v_line.user_id
    and fm.status='active'
    and coalesce(f.status,'active')='active'
    and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
    and private.family_person_is_visible_to_user(v_line.user_id,fp.id)
    and private.user_can_see_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_list_line_appointment_assignee_options(p_line_user_id text, p_record_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_items jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.phms_find_crud_record(
    p_line_user_id,'appointment',p_record_code,'update'
  )
  limit 1;

  with person_options as (
    select
      fp.id as family_person_id,
      p.linked_user_id as user_id,
      substr(fp.id::text,1,12) as selection_code,
      private.family_person_label_for_viewer(
        v_ref.actor_user_id,fp.id
      ) as display_name,
      case
        when p.linked_user_id is null then false
        else private.user_can_access_family_person(
          p.linked_user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,'appointments','view'
        )
      end as has_appointment_view,
      exists(
        select 1
        from public.line_identities li
        where li.user_id=p.linked_user_id
          and li.is_active=true
          and li.onboarding_status='ready'
      ) as line_ready,
      'person'::text as selection_type
    from public.family_persons fp
    join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
    where fp.family_id=v_ref.active_family_id
      and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
      and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
  ),
  account_only as (
    select
      null::uuid as family_person_id,
      fm.user_id,
      substr(fm.user_id::text,1,12) as selection_code,
      private.family_user_label_for_viewer(
        v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.active_family_id,fm.user_id
      ) as display_name,
      private.user_can_access_family_person(
        fm.user_id,v_ref.active_family_person_id,'appointments','view'
      ) as has_appointment_view,
      exists(
        select 1
        from public.line_identities li
        where li.user_id=fm.user_id
          and li.is_active=true
          and li.onboarding_status='ready'
      ) as line_ready,
      'account'::text as selection_type
    from public.family_memberships fm
    where fm.family_id=v_ref.active_family_id
      and fm.status='active'
      and fm.user_id is not null
      and not exists(
        select 1
        from public.family_persons fp2
        join public.persons p2 on p2.id=fp2.person_id
        where fp2.family_id=v_ref.active_family_id
          and coalesce(fp2.status,'active')='active'
          and p2.linked_user_id=fm.user_id
      )
  ),
  all_options as (
    select * from person_options
    union all
    select * from account_only
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'family_person_id',x.family_person_id,
      'user_id',x.user_id,
      'selection_code',x.selection_code,
      'display_name',x.display_name,
      'has_appointment_view',x.has_appointment_view,
      'line_ready',x.line_ready,
      'selection_type',x.selection_type
    ))
    order by
      case when x.selection_type='person' then 0 else 1 end,
      x.display_name
  ),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from all_options x;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'appointment_id',v_ref.record_id,
    'record_code',substr(v_ref.record_id::text,1,12),
    'person_name',v_ref.target_person_name,
    'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'

    and private.family_person_is_visible_to_user(v_line.user_id,fp.id)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_list_line_family_members(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(selection_code text, user_id uuid, display_name text, roles text[], is_owner boolean, can_manage_permissions boolean, is_self boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare v_line record; v_ctx private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype; v_manager boolean:=false;
begin
 select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
 perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.line_identity_id,v_line.user_id);
 select c.* into v_ctx from private.line_identity_contexts c where c.line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;
 if v_ctx.active_scope<>'family' or v_ctx.active_family_id is null then raise exception 'family_context_required'; end if;
 select exists(select 1 from public.family_role_assignments fmra where fmra.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id and fmra.user_id=v_line.user_id and fmra.status='active' and fmra.role in ('owner','admin')) into v_manager;
 return query
 select substr(encode(digest(fm.user_id::text||':'||v_line.line_identity_id::text||':'||v_ctx.active_family_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
        fm.user_id,
        private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,v_ctx.active_family_id,fm.user_id),
        case when v_manager or fm.user_id=v_line.user_id then coalesce((select array_agg(distinct fra.role order by fra.role)
                  from public.family_role_assignments fra
                  where fra.family_id=fm.family_id and fra.user_id=fm.user_id and fra.status='active'),array[]::text[]) else array[]::text[] end,
        (v_manager or fm.user_id=v_line.user_id) and exists(select 1 from public.family_role_assignments fra
               where fra.family_id=fm.family_id and fra.user_id=fm.user_id and fra.role='owner' and fra.status='active'),
        (v_manager or fm.user_id=v_line.user_id) and exists(select 1 from public.family_role_assignments fra
               where fra.family_id=fm.family_id and fra.user_id=fm.user_id
                 and fra.role in ('owner','admin') and fra.status='active'),
        fm.user_id=v_line.user_id
 from public.family_memberships fm
 where fm.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id and fm.status='active'
 order by (fm.user_id=v_line.user_id) desc,
          lower(private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,v_ctx.active_family_id,fm.user_id)),
          fm.joined_at nulls last,fm.id;
end
$function$
