CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_list_line_family_person_directory_v2(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare v_line record; v_ctx private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype; v_rows jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
begin
 select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
 perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.line_identity_id,v_line.user_id);
 select c.* into v_ctx from private.line_identity_contexts c where c.line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;
 if v_ctx.active_scope<>'family' or v_ctx.active_family_id is null then raise exception 'family_context_required'; end if;
 perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',v_line.user_id::text,true);

 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'person_code',substr(encode(digest(fp.id::text||':'||v_line.line_identity_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
   'family_person_id',fp.id,
   'display_name',private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.id),
   'relationship_label',case when p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id then 'ฉัน' else nullif(btrim(v.relationship_label),'') end,
   'can_view',private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'persons','view'),
   'is_self',coalesce(p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id,false),
   'pinned',coalesce(pref.pinned,false),
   'display_rank',pref.sort_rank,
   'usage_count',coalesce(pu.use_count,0),
   'last_used_at',pu.last_used_at,
   'is_active_context',coalesce(v_ctx.active_family_person_id=fp.id,false),
   'date_of_birth',case when private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'persons','view') then p.date_of_birth else null end,
   'birth_info',case when private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'persons','view') and p.date_of_birth is not null then public.phms_format_birth_info(p.date_of_birth) else null end,
   'access',case when private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'persons','view') then jsonb_build_object(
      'profile_update',private.can_access_family_person(fp.id,'persons','update'),
      'medications',private.can_access_family_person(fp.id,'medications','view'),
      'appointments',private.can_access_family_person(fp.id,'appointments','view'),
      'health_data',private.can_access_family_person(fp.id,'health_data','view')
   ) else null end,
   'photo_object_name',case when private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'persons','view') then coalesce(
      (select ph.object_name
       from public.person_photo_preferences pref
       join public.person_photos ph on ph.id=pref.photo_id
       where pref.viewer_user_id=v_line.user_id and pref.family_person_id=fp.id
         and ph.status='active' and (ph.uploaded_by=v_line.user_id or ph.visibility='shared')
       limit 1),
      (select ph.object_name
       from public.person_photos ph
       where ph.family_person_id=fp.id and ph.status='active'
         and ph.visibility='shared' and ph.is_person_shared_default=true
       limit 1)
   ) else null end
 ) order by coalesce(p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id,false) desc,
            coalesce(pref.pinned,false) desc,
            pref.sort_rank asc nulls last,
            coalesce(pu.use_count,0) desc,
            pu.last_used_at desc nulls last,
            lower(private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.id)),fp.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 into v_rows
 from public.family_persons fp
 join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
 left join public.family_person_view_labels v
   on v.viewer_user_id=v_line.user_id and v.family_person_id=fp.id
 left join private.family_person_view_preferences pref
   on pref.viewer_user_id=v_line.user_id and pref.family_person_id=fp.id
 left join public.person_context_usage pu
   on pu.user_id=v_line.user_id and pu.family_person_id=fp.id
 where fp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
   and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
   and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active' and private.family_person_is_visible_to_user(v_line.user_id,fp.id);

 return jsonb_build_object('count',jsonb_array_length(v_rows),'people',v_rows);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_list_line_family_roster(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
 v_line record; v_ctx private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype; v_rows jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
begin
 select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
 perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.line_identity_id,v_line.user_id);
 select c.* into v_ctx from private.line_identity_contexts c where c.line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;
 if v_ctx.active_scope<>'family' or v_ctx.active_family_id is null then raise exception 'family_context_required'; end if;
 perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',v_line.user_id::text,true);

 with person_rows as (
  select
   0 as kind_order,
   fp.id::text as stable_id,
   jsonb_build_object(
    'entry_type','person',
    'person_code',substr(encode(digest(fp.id::text||':'||v_line.line_identity_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
    'display_name',private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.id),
    'relationship_label',case when p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id then 'ฉัน' else nullif(btrim(v.relationship_label),'') end,
    'is_self',coalesce(p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id,false),
    'pinned',coalesce((select pref.pinned from private.family_person_view_preferences pref where pref.viewer_user_id=v_line.user_id and pref.family_person_id=fp.id),false),
    'display_rank',(select pref.sort_rank from private.family_person_view_preferences pref where pref.viewer_user_id=v_line.user_id and pref.family_person_id=fp.id),
    'usage_count',coalesce((select pu.use_count from public.person_context_usage pu where pu.user_id=v_line.user_id and pu.family_person_id=fp.id),0),
    'last_used_at',(select pu.last_used_at from public.person_context_usage pu where pu.user_id=v_line.user_id and pu.family_person_id=fp.id),
    'account_linked',p.linked_user_id is not null,
    'self_manage',private.family_person_self_manage_enabled(fp.id),
    'line_linked',case when p.linked_user_id is null then false else exists(
      select 1 from public.line_identities li
      where li.user_id=p.linked_user_id and li.is_active=true and li.onboarding_status='ready'
    ) end,
    'active_line_count',case when p.linked_user_id is null then 0 else (
      select count(*) from public.line_identities li
      where li.user_id=p.linked_user_id and li.is_active=true and li.onboarding_status='ready'
    ) end,
    'account_display_name',case when p.linked_user_id is null then null else private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.family_id,p.linked_user_id) end,
    'roles',case when p.linked_user_id is null then '[]'::jsonb else coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(r.role order by r.role)
      from public.family_role_assignments r
      where r.family_id=fp.family_id and r.user_id=p.linked_user_id and r.status='active'
    ),'[]'::jsonb) end,
    'caregivers',coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
       'display_name',private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.family_id,ca.caregiver_user_id),
       'is_primary',ca.is_primary,
       'user_id',ca.caregiver_user_id
      ) order by ca.is_primary desc,lower(private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.family_id,ca.caregiver_user_id)))
      from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca
      left join public.profiles pr on pr.id=ca.caregiver_user_id
      where ca.family_person_id=fp.id and ca.status='active' and ca.caregiver_user_id is distinct from p.linked_user_id
    ),'[]'::jsonb),
    'can_view',private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'persons','view'),
    'can_manage_person',private.can_access_family_person(fp.id,'persons','update'),
    'birth_info',case when private.user_can_access_family_person(v_line.user_id,fp.id,'persons','view') and p.date_of_birth is not null then public.phms_format_birth_info(p.date_of_birth) else null end,
    'medication_count',case when private.can_access_family_person(fp.id,'medications','view') then (
      select count(*) from public.person_medications pm where pm.person_id=p.id and pm.deleted_at is null
    ) else null end,
    'appointment_count',case when private.can_access_family_person(fp.id,'appointments','view') then (
      select count(*) from public.appointments a where a.person_id=p.id and a.deleted_at is null and coalesce(a.status,'scheduled') not in ('cancelled','completed')
    ) else null end,
    'next_appointment',case when private.can_access_family_person(fp.id,'appointments','view') then (
      select jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
       'code',substr(a.id::text,1,12),'title',a.title,'appointment_at',a.appointment_at,'hospital_name',a.hospital_name,'department',a.department
      ))
      from public.appointments a
      where a.person_id=p.id and a.deleted_at is null and coalesce(a.status,'scheduled') not in ('cancelled','completed')
        and (a.appointment_at is null or a.appointment_at>=now()-interval '1 day')
      order by a.appointment_at asc nulls last,a.created_at desc limit 1
    ) else null end,
    'health_count',case when private.can_access_family_person(fp.id,'health_data','view') then (
      select count(*) from public.health_measurements h where h.person_id=p.id and h.deleted_at is null
    ) else null end,
    'latest_health',case when private.can_access_family_person(fp.id,'health_data','view') then (
      select jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
       'code',substr(h.id::text,1,12),'measurement_type',h.measurement_type,'measured_at',h.measured_at,
       'value_numeric',h.value_numeric,'value_text',h.value_text,'unit',h.unit,
       'systolic',h.systolic,'diastolic',h.diastolic,'context',h.context
      ))
      from public.health_measurements h
      where h.person_id=p.id and h.deleted_at is null
      order by h.measured_at desc,h.created_at desc limit 1
    ) else null end
   ) as item
  from public.family_persons fp
  join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
  left join public.family_person_view_labels v on v.viewer_user_id=v_line.user_id and v.family_person_id=fp.id
  where fp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active' and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active' and private.family_person_is_visible_to_user(v_line.user_id,fp.id)
 ),
 account_only_rows as (
  select
   1 as kind_order,
   fm.user_id::text as stable_id,
   jsonb_build_object(
    'entry_type','account_only',
    'display_name',private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fm.family_id,fm.user_id),
    'is_self',fm.user_id=v_line.user_id,
    'account_linked',true,
    'line_linked',exists(select 1 from public.line_identities li where li.user_id=fm.user_id and li.is_active=true and li.onboarding_status='ready'),
    'active_line_count',(select count(*) from public.line_identities li where li.user_id=fm.user_id and li.is_active=true and li.onboarding_status='ready'),
    'roles',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(r.role order by r.role) from public.family_role_assignments r where r.family_id=fm.family_id and r.user_id=fm.user_id and r.status='active'),'[]'::jsonb),
    'caregivers','[]'::jsonb,
    'can_view',false
   ) as item
  from public.family_memberships fm
  left join public.profiles pr on pr.id=fm.user_id
  where fm.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id and fm.status='active'
    and not exists(
      select 1 from public.family_persons fp join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
      where fp.family_id=fm.family_id and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active' and p.linked_user_id=fm.user_id
    )
 ),
 all_rows as (
  select * from person_rows
  union all
  select * from account_only_rows
 )
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(item order by
   coalesce((item->>'is_self')::boolean,false) desc,
   kind_order,
   coalesce((item->>'pinned')::boolean,false) desc,
   case when coalesce((item->>'pinned')::boolean,false) then nullif(item->>'display_rank','')::integer end asc nulls last,
   coalesce(nullif(item->>'usage_count','')::bigint,0) desc,
   nullif(item->>'last_used_at','')::timestamptz desc nulls last,
   lower(item->>'display_name'),stable_id),'[]'::jsonb)
 into v_rows from all_rows;

 return jsonb_build_object(
  'count',jsonb_array_length(v_rows),
  'linked_count',(select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_rows) x where coalesce((x->>'line_linked')::boolean,false)),
  'unlinked_count',(select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(v_rows) x where x->>'entry_type'='person' and not coalesce((x->>'line_linked')::boolean,false)),
  'entries',v_rows
 );
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_list_line_medical_gallery(p_line_user_id text, p_category text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_days integer DEFAULT 30, p_limit integer DEFAULT 6)
 RETURNS TABLE(asset_id uuid, person_id uuid, person_name text, category text, title text, item_date timestamp with time zone, mime_type text, byte_size bigint, bucket_id text, object_name text, lifecycle_state text, document_type text, source_status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ctx record;
  v_category text := lower(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_category),''),'all'));
  v_days integer := coalesce(p_days,30);
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,6),1),10);
begin
  if v_category not in ('all','medications','appointments','health','pending') then
    raise exception 'invalid_gallery_category';
  end if;
  if v_days < 0 or v_days > 3650 then
    raise exception 'invalid_gallery_days';
  end if;

  select * into v_ctx
  from public.phms_resolve_line_command_context(
    p_line_user_id,
    null,
    'view',
    true,
    'any'
  )
  limit 1;

  if not found then raise exception 'gallery_context_not_found'; end if;
  if coalesce(v_ctx.context_ready,false) is not true or v_ctx.target_person_id is null then
    raise exception 'gallery_person_required';
  end if;

  return query
  with permitted as (
    select
      a.id as asset_id,
      a.person_id,
      v_ctx.target_person_name::text as person_name,
      a.mime_type,
      a.byte_size,
      a.bucket_id,
      a.object_name,
      a.lifecycle_state,
      a.original_filename,
      coalesce(mm.captured_at,a.captured_at,a.created_at) as item_date,
      coalesce(src.document_type,md.document_type,'unknown') as document_type,
      src.session_status as source_status,
      case
        when mm.id is not null then 'medications'
        when coalesce(src.document_type,md.document_type,'unknown')
             in ('medication_label','medication_list','prescription','dispense_summary')
          then 'medications'
        when coalesce(src.document_type,md.document_type,'unknown')='appointment'
          then 'appointments'
        when a.lifecycle_state='temporary'
             and coalesce(src.document_type,md.document_type,'unknown') in ('unknown','other')
          then 'pending'
        else 'health'
      end as category,
      md.title
    from public.phms_storage_assets a
    left join lateral (
      select
        dis.document_type,
        ds.status as session_status
      from public.data_intake_sources dis
      join public.data_intake_sessions ds on ds.id=dis.session_id
      where dis.storage_asset_id=a.id
      order by dis.created_at desc
      limit 1
    ) src on true
    left join lateral (
      select d.id,d.document_type,d.title,d.created_at
      from public.medical_documents d
      where d.storage_asset_id=a.id and d.deleted_at is null
      order by d.created_at desc
      limit 1
    ) md on true
    left join lateral (
      select m.id,m.captured_at,m.created_at
      from public.medication_media m
      where m.storage_asset_id=a.id and m.deleted_at is null
      order by m.created_at desc
      limit 1
    ) mm on true
    where a.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and a.deleted_at is null
      and a.lifecycle_state <> 'deleted'
      and (
        v_ctx.active_scope='personal'
        or exists(
          select 1
          from public.family_role_assignments fra
          where fra.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
            and fra.user_id=v_ctx.user_id
            and fra.role='owner'
            and fra.status='active'
        )
        or exists(
          select 1
          from public.person_permissions pp
          where pp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
            and pp.family_person_id=v_ctx.active_family_person_id
            and pp.user_id=v_ctx.user_id
            and pp.status='active'
            and (pp.resource=a.permission_resource or pp.resource='*')
            and coalesce(pp.can_view,false)
        )
        or exists(
          select 1
          from public.family_permissions fp
          where fp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
            and fp.user_id=v_ctx.user_id
            and (fp.resource=a.permission_resource or fp.resource='*')
            and coalesce(fp.can_view,false)
        )
      )
  ),
  labeled as (
    select
      p.*,
      coalesce(
        nullif(btrim(p.title),''),
        nullif(btrim(p.original_filename),''),
        case p.category
          when 'medications' then 'รูป/เอกสารยา'
          when 'appointments' then 'ใบนัด'
          when 'pending' then 'ไฟล์รอตรวจ'
          else 'เอกสารสุขภาพ'
        end
      ) as display_title
    from permitted p
  )
  select
    l.asset_id,
    l.person_id,
    l.person_name,
    l.category,
    l.display_title::text,
    l.item_date,
    l.mime_type,
    l.byte_size,
    l.bucket_id,
    l.object_name,
    l.lifecycle_state,
    l.document_type,
    l.source_status
  from labeled l
  where (v_category='all' or l.category=v_category)
    and (v_days=0 or l.item_date >= now() - make_interval(days=>v_days))
  order by l.item_date desc,l.asset_id desc
  limit v_limit;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_list_line_medical_gallery_v2(p_line_user_id text, p_category text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_days integer DEFAULT 30, p_limit integer DEFAULT 8, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ctx record;
  v_category text:=lower(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_category),''),'all'));
  v_days integer:=coalesce(p_days,30);
  v_limit integer:=least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,8),1),50);
  v_offset integer:=greatest(coalesce(p_offset,0),0);
  v_items jsonb;
  v_total integer;
begin
  if v_category not in ('all','medications','appointments','health','pending') then raise exception 'invalid_gallery_category'; end if;
  if v_days<0 or v_days>3650 then raise exception 'invalid_gallery_days'; end if;

  select * into v_ctx
  from public.phms_resolve_line_command_context(p_line_user_id,null,'view',true,'any')
  limit 1;
  if not found then raise exception 'gallery_context_not_found'; end if;
  if coalesce(v_ctx.context_ready,false) is not true or v_ctx.target_person_id is null then raise exception 'gallery_person_required'; end if;

  with permitted as (
    select
      a.id asset_id,a.person_id,v_ctx.target_person_name::text person_name,
      a.mime_type,a.byte_size,a.bucket_id,a.object_name,a.lifecycle_state,a.original_filename,
      a.created_by,
      coalesce(mm.captured_at,a.captured_at,a.created_at) item_date,
      coalesce(src.document_type,md.document_type,'unknown') document_type,
      src.session_status source_status,
      nullif(btrim(a.metadata->>'display_title'),'') explicit_title,
      nullif(btrim(a.metadata->>'appointment_file_role'),'') appointment_file_role,
      case
        when a.permission_resource='medications' or mm.id is not null then 'medications'
        when a.permission_resource='appointments'
          or nullif(btrim(a.metadata->>'appointment_file_role'),'') is not null
          or coalesce(src.document_type,md.document_type,'unknown')='appointment' then 'appointments'
        when a.lifecycle_state='temporary'
          and coalesce(src.document_type,md.document_type,'unknown') in ('unknown','other') then 'pending'
        else 'health'
      end category,
      md.title document_title
    from public.phms_storage_assets a
    left join lateral (
      select dis.document_type,ds.status session_status
      from public.data_intake_sources dis
      join public.data_intake_sessions ds on ds.id=dis.session_id
      where dis.storage_asset_id=a.id
      order by dis.created_at desc limit 1
    ) src on true
    left join lateral (
      select d.document_type,d.title,d.created_at
      from public.medical_documents d
      where d.storage_asset_id=a.id and d.deleted_at is null
      order by d.created_at desc limit 1
    ) md on true
    left join lateral (
      select m.id,m.captured_at,m.created_at
      from public.medication_media m
      where m.storage_asset_id=a.id and m.deleted_at is null
      order by m.created_at desc limit 1
    ) mm on true
    where a.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and (
        not exists(select 1 from public.medical_documents md where md.storage_asset_id=a.id and md.deleted_at is null)
        and not exists(select 1 from public.appointment_document_links al where al.storage_asset_id=a.id or exists(select 1 from public.medical_documents md where md.id=al.medical_document_id and md.storage_asset_id=a.id))
        or (v_ctx.active_family_person_id is not null and private.user_can_access_family_person(v_ctx.user_id,v_ctx.active_family_person_id,'documents','view'))
      )
      and (
        not exists(select 1 from public.appointment_document_links al where al.link_kind in ('receipt','payment_slip','payment_qr','payment_other')
          and (al.storage_asset_id=a.id or exists(select 1 from public.medical_documents md where md.id=al.medical_document_id and md.storage_asset_id=a.id)))
        or (v_ctx.active_family_person_id is not null and private.user_can_access_family_person(v_ctx.user_id,v_ctx.active_family_person_id,'expenses','view'))
      )
      and a.deleted_at is null and a.lifecycle_state<>'deleted'
      and (
        v_ctx.active_scope='personal'
        or exists(
          select 1 from public.family_role_assignments fra
          where fra.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id and fra.user_id=v_ctx.user_id
            and fra.role='owner' and fra.status='active'
        )
        or exists(
          select 1 from public.person_permissions pp
          where pp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id and pp.family_person_id=v_ctx.active_family_person_id
            and pp.user_id=v_ctx.user_id and pp.status='active'
            and (pp.resource=a.permission_resource or pp.resource='*') and coalesce(pp.can_view,false)
        )
        or exists(
          select 1 from public.family_permissions fp
          where fp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id and fp.user_id=v_ctx.user_id
            and (fp.resource=a.permission_resource or fp.resource='*') and coalesce(fp.can_view,false)
        )
      )
  ), labeled as (
    select p.*,
      coalesce(
        p.explicit_title,nullif(btrim(p.document_title),''),nullif(btrim(p.original_filename),''),
        case p.category when 'medications' then 'รูป/เอกสารยา'
          when 'appointments' then case when p.appointment_file_role='appointment_attachment' then 'เอกสารประกอบนัด' else 'ใบนัด' end
          when 'pending' then 'ไฟล์รอตรวจ' else 'เอกสารสุขภาพ' end
      ) display_title
    from permitted p
  ), filtered as (
    select * from labeled l
    where (v_category='all' or l.category=v_category)
      and (v_days=0 or l.item_date>=now()-make_interval(days=>v_days))
  )
  select count(*)::int into v_total from filtered;

  with permitted as (
    select
      a.id asset_id,a.person_id,v_ctx.target_person_name::text person_name,
      a.mime_type,a.byte_size,a.bucket_id,a.object_name,a.lifecycle_state,a.original_filename,
      a.created_by,
      coalesce(mm.captured_at,a.captured_at,a.created_at) item_date,
      coalesce(src.document_type,md.document_type,'unknown') document_type,
      src.session_status source_status,
      nullif(btrim(a.metadata->>'display_title'),'') explicit_title,
      nullif(btrim(a.metadata->>'appointment_file_role'),'') appointment_file_role,
      case
        when a.permission_resource='medications' or mm.id is not null then 'medications'
        when a.permission_resource='appointments'
          or nullif(btrim(a.metadata->>'appointment_file_role'),'') is not null
          or coalesce(src.document_type,md.document_type,'unknown')='appointment' then 'appointments'
        when a.lifecycle_state='temporary'
          and coalesce(src.document_type,md.document_type,'unknown') in ('unknown','other') then 'pending'
        else 'health'
      end category,
      md.title document_title
    from public.phms_storage_assets a
    left join lateral (
      select dis.document_type,ds.status session_status
      from public.data_intake_sources dis
      join public.data_intake_sessions ds on ds.id=dis.session_id
      where dis.storage_asset_id=a.id
      order by dis.created_at desc limit 1
    ) src on true
    left join lateral (
      select d.document_type,d.title,d.created_at
      from public.medical_documents d
      where d.storage_asset_id=a.id and d.deleted_at is null
      order by d.created_at desc limit 1
    ) md on true
    left join lateral (
      select m.id,m.captured_at,m.created_at
      from public.medication_media m
      where m.storage_asset_id=a.id and m.deleted_at is null
      order by m.created_at desc limit 1
    ) mm on true
    where a.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and a.deleted_at is null and a.lifecycle_state<>'deleted'
      and (
        v_ctx.active_scope='personal'
        or exists(
          select 1 from public.family_role_assignments fra
          where fra.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id and fra.user_id=v_ctx.user_id
            and fra.role='owner' and fra.status='active'
        )
        or exists(
          select 1 from public.person_permissions pp
          where pp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id and pp.family_person_id=v_ctx.active_family_person_id
            and pp.user_id=v_ctx.user_id and pp.status='active'
            and (pp.resource=a.permission_resource or pp.resource='*') and coalesce(pp.can_view,false)
        )
        or exists(
          select 1 from public.family_permissions fp
          where fp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id and fp.user_id=v_ctx.user_id
            and (fp.resource=a.permission_resource or fp.resource='*') and coalesce(fp.can_view,false)
        )
      )
  ), labeled as (
    select p.*,
      coalesce(
        p.explicit_title,nullif(btrim(p.document_title),''),nullif(btrim(p.original_filename),''),
        case p.category when 'medications' then 'รูป/เอกสารยา'
          when 'appointments' then case when p.appointment_file_role='appointment_attachment' then 'เอกสารประกอบนัด' else 'ใบนัด' end
          when 'pending' then 'ไฟล์รอตรวจ' else 'เอกสารสุขภาพ' end
      ) display_title
    from permitted p
  ), filtered as (
    select * from labeled l
    where (v_category='all' or l.category=v_category)
      and (v_days=0 or l.item_date>=now()-make_interval(days=>v_days))
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'asset_id',f.asset_id,'person_id',f.person_id,'person_name',f.person_name,
    'category',f.category,'title',f.display_title,'item_date',f.item_date,
    'mime_type',f.mime_type,'byte_size',f.byte_size,'bucket_id',f.bucket_id,
    'object_name',f.object_name,'lifecycle_state',f.lifecycle_state,
    'document_type',f.document_type,'source_status',f.source_status,
    'appointment_file_role',f.appointment_file_role,
    'created_by',f.created_by,
    'created_by_name',case
      when f.created_by is null then null
      when v_ctx.active_family_id is not null then private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_ctx.user_id,v_ctx.active_family_id,f.created_by)
      else coalesce(
        (select nullif(btrim(pr.display_name),'') from public.profiles pr where pr.id=f.created_by),
        (select nullif(btrim(li.display_name),'') from public.line_identities li where li.user_id=f.created_by and li.is_active=true order by li.updated_at desc nulls last limit 1),
        'ผู้ใช้'
      ) end
  )) order by f.item_date desc,f.asset_id desc),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from (
    select * from filtered
    order by item_date desc,asset_id desc
    limit v_limit offset v_offset
  ) f;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'person_id',v_ctx.target_person_id,'person_name',v_ctx.target_person_name,
    'category',v_category,'days',v_days,'offset',v_offset,'limit',v_limit,
    'total_count',coalesce(v_total,0),'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_list_line_member_person_access(p_line_user_id text, p_member_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_member record;
  v_rows jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
  v_self_fp uuid;
  v_self_name text;
  v_self_manage boolean:=true;
  v_helpers jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_member
  from private.resolve_line_family_member(p_line_user_id,p_member_code);
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',v_member.actor_user_id::text,true);

  select fp.id,
         private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_member.actor_user_id,fp.id)
  into v_self_fp,v_self_name
  from public.family_persons fp
  join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
  where fp.family_id=v_member.family_id
    and p.linked_user_id=v_member.target_user_id
    and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
  order by fp.created_at
  limit 1;

  if v_self_fp is not null then
    v_self_manage:=private.family_person_self_manage_enabled(v_self_fp);

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'display_name',private.family_user_label_for_viewer(
        v_member.actor_user_id,v_member.family_id,ca.caregiver_user_id
      ),
      'is_primary',ca.is_primary
    ) order by ca.is_primary desc,
      lower(private.family_user_label_for_viewer(
        v_member.actor_user_id,v_member.family_id,ca.caregiver_user_id
      ))),'[]'::jsonb)
    into v_helpers
    from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca
    where ca.family_person_id=v_self_fp
      and ca.status='active'
      and ca.caregiver_user_id<>v_member.target_user_id;
  end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'person_code',substr(encode(digest(fp.id::text||':'||v_member.line_identity_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
    'family_person_id',fp.id,
    'person_name',private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_member.actor_user_id,fp.id),
    'is_self',p.linked_user_id=v_member.target_user_id,
    'is_caregiver',exists(
      select 1 from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca
      where ca.family_person_id=fp.id
        and ca.caregiver_user_id=v_member.target_user_id
        and ca.status='active'
        and ca.caregiver_user_id is distinct from p.linked_user_id
    ),
    'profile',case
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(v_member.target_user_id,fp.id,'persons','update') then 'manage'
      when private.user_can_see_family_person(v_member.target_user_id,fp.id) then 'view'
      else 'none' end,
    'medications',case
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(v_member.target_user_id,fp.id,'medications','update')
        or private.user_can_access_family_person(v_member.target_user_id,fp.id,'medications','create') then 'manage'
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(v_member.target_user_id,fp.id,'medications','view') then 'view'
      else 'none' end,
    'appointments',case
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(v_member.target_user_id,fp.id,'appointments','update')
        or private.user_can_access_family_person(v_member.target_user_id,fp.id,'appointments','create') then 'manage'
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(v_member.target_user_id,fp.id,'appointments','view') then 'view'
      else 'none' end,
    'health',case
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(v_member.target_user_id,fp.id,'health_data','update')
        or private.user_can_access_family_person(v_member.target_user_id,fp.id,'health_data','create') then 'manage'
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(v_member.target_user_id,fp.id,'health_data','view') then 'view'
      else 'none' end,
    'receive_notifications',
      exists(
        select 1 from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca
        where ca.family_person_id=fp.id
          and ca.caregiver_user_id=v_member.target_user_id
          and ca.status='active'
          and ca.can_receive_notifications=true
      )
      or exists(
        select 1 from public.person_permissions pp
        where pp.family_person_id=fp.id
          and pp.user_id=v_member.target_user_id
          and pp.status='active'
          and pp.can_receive_notifications=true
      )
  ) order by (p.linked_user_id=v_member.target_user_id) desc,
             lower(private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_member.actor_user_id,fp.id))),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_rows
  from public.family_persons fp
  join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
  where fp.family_id=v_member.family_id
    and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
    and (
      private.user_can_see_family_person(v_member.target_user_id,fp.id)
      or p.linked_user_id=v_member.target_user_id
      or exists(
        select 1 from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca
        where ca.family_person_id=fp.id
          and ca.caregiver_user_id=v_member.target_user_id
          and ca.status='active'
      )
    );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'member_code',lower(btrim(p_member_code)),
    'target_user_id',v_member.target_user_id,
    'self_person_code',case when v_self_fp is null then null
      else substr(encode(digest(v_self_fp::text||':'||v_member.line_identity_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12) end,
    'self_person_name',v_self_name,
    'self_manage',v_self_manage,
    'helpers',v_helpers,
    'people',v_rows
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_list_line_person_display_preferences(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_ctx private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype;
  v_items jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
  perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.line_identity_id,v_line.user_id);
  select * into v_ctx from private.line_identity_contexts where line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;
  if v_ctx.active_scope<>'family' or v_ctx.active_family_id is null then raise exception 'family_context_required'; end if;

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.j order by x.is_self desc,x.is_pinned desc,x.display_order nulls last,x.use_count desc,x.last_used_at desc nulls last,x.label),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from (
    select
      coalesce(p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id,false) is_self,
      coalesce(pu.is_pinned,false) is_pinned,
      pu.display_order,
      coalesce(pu.use_count,0) use_count,
      pu.last_used_at,
      lower(private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.id)) label,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'person_code',substr(encode(digest(fp.id::text||':'||v_line.line_identity_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
        'family_person_id',fp.id,
        'is_self',coalesce(p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id,false),
        'is_pinned',coalesce(pu.is_pinned,false),
        'display_order',pu.display_order,
        'use_count',coalesce(pu.use_count,0),
        'last_used_at',pu.last_used_at
      ) j
    from public.family_persons fp
    join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
    left join public.person_context_usage pu on pu.user_id=v_line.user_id and pu.family_person_id=fp.id
    where fp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
      and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
      and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
  ) x;

  return jsonb_build_object('items',v_items);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_list_line_self_viewers(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_ctx private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype;
  v_self_fp uuid;
  v_self_manage boolean;
  v_items jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
  perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.line_identity_id,v_line.user_id);
  select * into v_ctx
  from private.line_identity_contexts
  where line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;

  if v_ctx.active_scope<>'family' or v_ctx.active_family_id is null then
    raise exception 'family_context_required';
  end if;

  select fp.id into v_self_fp
  from public.family_persons fp
  join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
  where fp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
    and p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id
    and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
  limit 1;

  if v_self_fp is null then raise exception 'self_family_person_not_found'; end if;

  v_self_manage:=private.family_person_self_manage_enabled(v_self_fp);

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'member_code',substr(encode(digest(fm.user_id::text||':'||v_line.line_identity_id::text||':'||v_ctx.active_family_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
    'user_id',fm.user_id,
    'display_name',private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,v_ctx.active_family_id,fm.user_id),
    'roles',coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(distinct fra.role order by fra.role)
      from public.family_role_assignments fra
      where fra.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
        and fra.user_id=fm.user_id
        and fra.status='active'
    ),'[]'::jsonb),
    'is_primary',private.phms_is_medical_primary(fm.user_id,v_self_fp),
    'is_caregiver',exists(
      select 1 from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca
      where ca.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
        and ca.family_person_id=v_self_fp
        and ca.caregiver_user_id=fm.user_id
        and ca.status='active'
    ),
    'profile',case
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'persons','update') then 'manage'
      when private.user_can_see_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp) then 'view'
      else 'none' end,
    'emergency',case
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'emergency','update')
        or private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'emergency','create') then 'manage'
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'emergency','view') then 'view'
      else 'none' end,
    'medications',case
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'medications','update')
        or private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'medications','create')
        or private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'medications','delete') then 'manage'
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'medications','view') then 'view'
      else 'none' end,
    'appointments',case
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'appointments','update')
        or private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'appointments','create')
        or private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'appointments','delete') then 'manage'
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'appointments','view') then 'view'
      else 'none' end,
    'health',case
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'health_data','update')
        or private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'health_data','create')
        or private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'health_data','delete') then 'manage'
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'health_data','view') then 'view'
      else 'none' end,
    'receive_notifications',
      exists(
        select 1 from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca
        where ca.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
          and ca.family_person_id=v_self_fp
          and ca.caregiver_user_id=fm.user_id
          and ca.status='active'
          and ca.can_receive_notifications=true
      )
      or exists(
        select 1 from public.person_permissions pp
        where pp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
          and pp.family_person_id=v_self_fp
          and pp.user_id=fm.user_id
          and pp.status='active'
          and pp.can_receive_notifications=true
      ),
    'view_resource_count',(
      select count(*)::int
      from public.person_permissions pp
      where pp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
        and pp.family_person_id=v_self_fp
        and pp.user_id=fm.user_id
        and pp.resource in ('medications','appointments','health_data')
        and pp.status='active'
        and coalesce(pp.can_view,false)
    ),
    'view_all',(
      private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'medications','view')
      and private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'appointments','view')
      and private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'health_data','view')
    ),
    'has_manage_access',(
      private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'medications','update')
      or private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'appointments','update')
      or private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'health_data','update')
      or private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'medications','create')
      or private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'appointments','create')
      or private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'health_data','create')
    ),
    'pending_request',exists(
      select 1
      from public.permission_requests pr
      where pr.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
        and pr.family_person_id=v_self_fp
        and (
          (pr.request_type='self_viewer' and pr.requester_user_id=v_line.user_id and pr.target_user_id=fm.user_id)
          or
          (pr.request_type='admin_self_bundle' and pr.requester_user_id=fm.user_id)
        )
        and pr.status='pending'
    )
  ) order by
    case
      when exists(
        select 1 from public.person_caregiver_assignments ca
        where ca.family_person_id=v_self_fp and ca.caregiver_user_id=fm.user_id and ca.status='active'
      ) then 0
      when private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'medications','view')
        or private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'appointments','view')
        or private.user_can_access_family_person(fm.user_id,v_self_fp,'health_data','view') then 1
      else 2
    end,
    lower(private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,v_ctx.active_family_id,fm.user_id))
  ),'[]'::jsonb)
  into v_items
  from public.family_memberships fm
  where fm.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
    and fm.status='active'
    and fm.user_id<>v_line.user_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'family_id',v_ctx.active_family_id,
    'person_code',substr(encode(digest(v_self_fp::text||':'||v_line.line_identity_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
    'person_name',private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,v_self_fp),
    'self_manage',v_self_manage,
    'items',v_items
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_list_my_families_for_context()
 RETURNS TABLE(family_id uuid, family_name text, family_code text, family_status text, membership_status text, is_active_context boolean, family_person_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if v_uid is null then
    raise exception 'authentication_required';
  end if;

  return query
  select f.id,
         f.family_name,
         f.family_code,
         f.status,
         fm.status,
         (uc.active_scope = 'family' and uc.active_family_id = f.id) as is_active_context,
         count(fp.id) filter (where fp.status = 'active') as family_person_count
    from public.family_memberships fm
    join public.families f on f.id = fm.family_id
    left join public.user_contexts uc on uc.user_id = v_uid
    left join public.family_persons fp on fp.family_id = f.id
   where fm.user_id = v_uid
     and fm.status = 'active'
     and f.status = 'active'
   group by f.id, f.family_name, f.family_code, f.status, fm.status, uc.active_scope, uc.active_family_id
   order by lower(coalesce(f.family_name,'')), f.created_at, f.id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_list_person_claims_for_review_from_line(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(review_code text, person_display_name text, claimant_display_name text, family_name text, claim_status text, person_confirmed_at timestamp with time zone, expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare v_line public.line_identities%rowtype;
begin
 if p_line_user_id is null or btrim(p_line_user_id)='' then raise exception 'line_user_id_required'; end if;
 select * into v_line from public.line_identities where line_user_id=p_line_user_id limit 1;
 if not found then raise exception 'line_identity_not_found'; end if;
 if coalesce(v_line.is_active,false) is not true then raise exception 'active_line_identity_required'; end if;
 if v_line.user_id is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_linked'; end if;

 return query
 select
   substr(encode(digest(pcr.id::text||':'||v_line.id::text||':'||pcr.family_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),1,12),
   coalesce(private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.id),'ไม่ระบุชื่อ')::text,
   private.family_user_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,pcr.family_id,pcr.requested_user_id)::text,
   coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว')::text,
   pcr.status,pcr.person_confirmed_at,pcr.expires_at
 from public.person_claim_requests pcr
 join public.persons p on p.id=pcr.person_id
 join public.family_persons fp on fp.family_id=pcr.family_id and fp.person_id=pcr.person_id
 left join public.families f on f.id=pcr.family_id
 where pcr.status='person_confirmed'
   and pcr.requires_approval=true
   and pcr.family_id is not null
   and (pcr.expires_at is null or pcr.expires_at>now())
   and private.user_has_family_role(v_line.user_id,pcr.family_id,array['owner','admin'])
 order by pcr.person_confirmed_at asc nulls last,pcr.created_at asc;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_mark_line_intake_extraction_failed(p_source_id uuid, p_error_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_source public.data_intake_sources%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_source
  from public.data_intake_sources
  where id=p_source_id
  for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'intake_source_not_found'; end if;

  update public.data_intake_sources
  set source_metadata=
    coalesce(source_metadata,'{}'::jsonb)
    || jsonb_build_object(
         'extraction_status','failed',
         'extraction_error',left(coalesce(p_error_code,'unknown_error'),200),
         'auto_commit',false,
         'updated_at',now()
       )
  where id=v_source.id;

  update public.data_intake_sessions
  set status='failed',updated_at=now()
  where id=v_source.session_id;

  insert into public.data_intake_actions(
    session_id,actor_user_id,action,after_data,reason
  )
  values(
    v_source.session_id,v_source.submitted_by,'fail',
    jsonb_build_object('source_id',v_source.id,'stage','extraction'),
    left(coalesce(p_error_code,'unknown_error'),200)
  );

  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'source_id',v_source.id,'status','failed');
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_med_v23_generate_all_today()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE person_row record; date_bkk date:=(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date; count_persons int:=0; created_total int:=0; skipped_total int:=0; outcome jsonb;
BEGIN
 FOR person_row IN
 SELECT DISTINCT pm.person_id
 FROM public.medication_order_versions v
 JOIN public.person_medications pm ON pm.id=v.person_medication_id
 JOIN public.medication_regimen_doses rule ON rule.order_version_id=v.id
 WHERE v.status='verified' AND v.verified_at IS NOT NULL
 AND pm.deleted_at IS NULL AND pm.status='regular'
 AND rule.local_time IS NOT NULL
 LOOP
  outcome:=public.phms_med_v23_generate_day(person_row.person_id,date_bkk,'Asia/Bangkok');
  count_persons:=count_persons+1;
  created_total:=created_total+coalesce((outcome->>'created')::int,0);
  skipped_total:=skipped_total+coalesce((outcome->>'already_present')::int,0);
 END LOOP;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('date',date_bkk,'persons_checked',count_persons,'created',created_total,'already_present',skipped_total);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_med_v23_invalidate_future_doses()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.status='verified' AND (TG_OP='INSERT' OR OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status) THEN
  UPDATE public.medication_scheduled_doses s
  SET state='superseded'
  WHERE s.person_medication_id=NEW.person_medication_id
  AND s.order_version_id<>NEW.id
  AND s.scheduled_at>=coalesce(NEW.effective_from,now())
  AND s.state='planned'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_med_v23_line_inventory_intake_options(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE ctx record; admin_ok boolean;pool_items jsonb;drug_items jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO ctx FROM private.phms_line_crud_context(p_line_user_id,'medication','create');
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.family_role_assignments r WHERE r.family_id=ctx.active_family_id
 AND r.user_id=ctx.actor_user_id AND r.role IN('owner','admin') AND r.status='active') INTO admin_ok;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'id',p.id,'name',p.name,'type',p.pool_type,
 'locations',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',l.id,'name',l.name)),'[]'::jsonb)
  FROM public.medication_stock_locations l WHERE l.pool_id=p.id AND l.active)
 ) ORDER BY p.name),'[]'::jsonb) INTO pool_items
 FROM public.medication_stock_pools p WHERE p.family_id=ctx.active_family_id
 AND ((p.pool_type='patient_assigned' AND p.assigned_person_id=ctx.target_person_id)
 OR (p.pool_type IN('shared','quarantine') AND admin_ok));
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'id',m.id,'name',coalesce(m.brand_name,m.generic_name),
 'generic_name',m.generic_name,'dosage_form',m.dosage_form,'strength_value',m.strength_value,'strength_unit',m.strength_unit
 ) ORDER BY coalesce(m.brand_name,m.generic_name)),'[]'::jsonb) INTO drug_items
 FROM public.medication_master m WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.person_medications pm WHERE pm.medication_id=m.id AND pm.person_id=ctx.target_person_id AND pm.deleted_at IS NULL);
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'person_name',ctx.target_person_name,'pools',pool_items,'medications',drug_items,'can_manage_shared',admin_ok);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_med_v23_line_inventory_summary(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE ctx record; result jsonb;can_admin boolean;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO ctx FROM private.phms_line_crud_context(p_line_user_id,'medication','view');
 IF ctx.active_family_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'family_required'; END IF;
 SELECT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.family_role_assignments f WHERE f.family_id=ctx.active_family_id AND f.user_id=ctx.actor_user_id
  AND f.role IN ('owner','admin') AND f.status='active'
 ) INTO can_admin;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'pool_id',p.id,'pool_name',p.name,'pool_type',p.pool_type,'location',l.name,
 'medication_name',coalesce(m.brand_name,m.generic_name),'unit',b.quantity_unit,
 'quantity',b.quantity,'reserved',coalesce((SELECT sum(a.quantity) FROM public.medication_stock_allocations a WHERE a.balance_id=b.id AND a.status='reserved'),0),
 'available',b.quantity-coalesce((SELECT sum(a.quantity) FROM public.medication_stock_allocations a WHERE a.balance_id=b.id AND a.status='reserved'),0),
 'lot',lot.lot_number,'expiry',coalesce(stock.manufacturer_expiry_date,lot.manufacturer_expiry_date),
 'container',coalesce(stock.bottle_id,c.container_label),'opened_at',coalesce(stock.opened_at,c.opened_at),
 'beyond_use_at',coalesce(stock.beyond_use_at,c.beyond_use_at)
 ) ORDER BY p.name,m.generic_name,l.name),'[]'::jsonb) INTO result
 FROM public.medication_inventory_balances b
 JOIN public.medication_stock_pools p ON p.id=b.pool_id
 JOIN public.medication_stock_locations l ON l.id=b.location_id
 JOIN public.medication_master m ON m.id=b.medication_id
 LEFT JOIN public.medication_lots lot ON lot.id=b.lot_id
 LEFT JOIN public.medication_containers c ON c.id=b.container_id
 LEFT JOIN public.medication_stock_containers stock ON stock.id=b.stock_container_id
 WHERE p.family_id=ctx.active_family_id
 AND ((p.pool_type='patient_assigned' AND p.assigned_person_id=ctx.target_person_id)
    OR (p.pool_type IN('shared','quarantine') AND can_admin))
 AND b.quantity>0;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'person_name',ctx.target_person_name,'items',result);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_med_v23_line_preparation_detail(p_line_user_id text, p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE ctx record;s record;items jsonb;impacts jsonb;checks jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO ctx FROM private.phms_line_crud_context(p_line_user_id,'medication','view');
 SELECT * INTO s FROM public.medication_preparation_sessions WHERE id=p_session_id AND person_id=ctx.target_person_id;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'session_not_found_or_denied';END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',i.id,'date',d.planned_date,'slot',d.slot_key,
 'name',coalesce(mm.brand_name,mm.generic_name),'quantity',i.quantity,'unit',i.unit,'state',i.state,
 'has_allocation',i.allocation_id IS NOT NULL,'packaging_verified',i.packaging_verified)
 ORDER BY d.planned_date,d.scheduled_at),'[]'::jsonb) INTO items
 FROM public.medication_preparation_items i JOIN public.medication_scheduled_doses d ON d.id=i.scheduled_dose_id
 JOIN public.medication_master mm ON mm.id=i.medication_id WHERE i.session_id=s.id;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',i.id,'item_id',i.item_id,
 'reason',i.reason,'state',i.status,'detected_at',i.detected_at,'resolution_notes',i.resolution_notes)
 ORDER BY i.detected_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb) INTO impacts
 FROM public.medication_preparation_impacts i WHERE i.session_id=s.id;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('type',x.check_type,'passed',x.passed,'checked_at',x.checked_at)
 ORDER BY x.checked_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb) INTO checks
 FROM public.medication_preparation_checks x WHERE x.session_id=s.id;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'person_name',ctx.target_person_name,'session_id',s.id,'status',s.status,
 'start_date',s.start_date,'end_date',s.end_date,'items',items,'impacts',impacts,'checks',checks);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_med_v23_line_preparation_pack_options(p_line_user_id text, p_item_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE c record;i record;s record;allocations jsonb;sources jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO c FROM private.phms_line_crud_context(p_line_user_id,'medication','view');
 SELECT i0.* INTO i FROM public.medication_preparation_items i0
 JOIN public.medication_preparation_sessions s0 ON s0.id=i0.session_id
 WHERE i0.id=p_item_id AND s0.person_id=c.target_person_id;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'item_not_found_or_denied';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO s FROM public.medication_preparation_sessions WHERE id=i.session_id;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'balance_id',a.balance_id,'quantity',a.quantity,'unit',a.quantity_unit,
 'lot_id',b.lot_id,'stock_container_id',b.stock_container_id,'location_id',b.location_id)
 ORDER BY a.created_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb) INTO allocations
 FROM public.medication_stock_allocations a

 WHERE a.patient_id=s.person_id AND a.status='reserved' AND b.medication_id=i.medication_id
 AND a.quantity>=i.quantity AND a.quantity_unit=i.unit
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.medication_preparation_items used WHERE used.allocation_id=a.id AND used.id<>i.id AND used.state<>'REMOVED');
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',src.id,'kind',src.source_kind,'summary',left(src.source_text,150))
 ORDER BY src.verified_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb) INTO sources

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_med_v23_line_preparation_transition(p_line_user_id text, p_session_id uuid, p_new_status text)

 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE c record;sid uuid;

 UPDATE public.medication_preparation_sessions
 SET status=p_new_status,last_action_by=c.actor_user_id,updated_at=now(),
 reviewed_by=CASE WHEN p_new_status='REVIEWED' THEN c.actor_user_id ELSE reviewed_by END,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_med_v23_line_today(p_line_user_id text, p_day date DEFAULT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE ctx record; items jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO ctx FROM private.phms_line_crud_context(p_line_user_id,'medication','view');
 IF p_day IS NULL OR p_day > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date + 31 OR p_day < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date - 365 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'date_out_of_range'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'scheduled_dose_id',s.id,'time',s.scheduled_at,'slot',s.slot_key,'name',coalesce(m.brand_name,m.generic_name),
 'planned_dose',s.planned_dose,'unit',s.planned_unit,'state',s.state,
 'verification',v.status,'snapshot',s.order_snapshot,'administration_event_id',e.id,
 'outcome',CASE WHEN c_void.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'voided' ELSE coalesce(c_amend.corrected_values->>'outcome',e.outcome) END,
 'actual_at',coalesce(c_amend.corrected_values->>'occurred_at',e.occurred_at::text),
 'evidence_type',coalesce(c_amend.corrected_values->>'evidence_type',e.evidence_type),
 'corrected',c_amend.id IS NOT NULL OR c_void.id IS NOT NULL,'correction_type',CASE WHEN c_void.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'void' WHEN c_amend.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'amend' ELSE NULL END
 ) ORDER BY s.scheduled_at,s.occurrence_no),'[]'::jsonb) INTO items
 FROM public.medication_scheduled_doses s
 JOIN public.person_medications pm ON pm.id=s.person_medication_id AND pm.person_id=ctx.target_person_id
 JOIN public.medication_master m ON m.id=pm.medication_id
 JOIN public.medication_order_versions v ON v.id=s.order_version_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.* FROM public.medication_administration_events x WHERE x.scheduled_dose_id=s.id ORDER BY x.recorded_at DESC,x.id DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.id FROM public.medication_administration_corrections x WHERE x.administration_event_id=e.id AND x.correction_type='void' LIMIT 1) c_void ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.id,x.corrected_values FROM public.medication_administration_corrections x WHERE x.administration_event_id=e.id AND x.correction_type='amend' ORDER BY x.corrected_at DESC,x.id DESC LIMIT 1) c_amend ON true
 WHERE s.person_id=ctx.target_person_id AND s.planned_date=p_day;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'person_name',ctx.target_person_name,'date',p_day,'items',items);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_med_v23_preparation_alert_on_impact()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.notifications(
   family_id,family_person_id,person_id,recipient_user_id,event_type,title,message,
   related_record_id,channel,priority,status,dedupe_key,payload)
  SELECT fp.family_id,fp.id,s.person_id,rec.uid,
   'medication_preparation_rework',
   '⚠️ ต้องตรวจสอบยาที่จัดไว้',
   'คำสั่งยาเปลี่ยนและอาจกระทบยาที่จัดไว้ กรุณาเปิด 💊 รอบจัดยา เพื่อตรวจสอบก่อนใช้ ห้ามใช้ชุดยาที่ระบบทำเครื่องหมายว่าต้องแก้ไข',
   s.id,'line','high','pending',
   'med_prep_impact:'||NEW.id::text||':'||rec.uid::text,
   jsonb_build_object('preparation_session_id',s.id,'requires_review',true)
  FROM public.medication_preparation_sessions s
  JOIN public.family_persons fp ON fp.person_id=s.person_id AND fp.status='active'
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT DISTINCT u.uid FROM (VALUES(s.prepared_by),(s.reviewed_by)) u(uid) WHERE u.uid IS NOT NULL
  ) rec

  ON CONFLICT(dedupe_key) WHERE dedupe_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING;
 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  RAISE WARNING 'Phase04: medication preparation notification enqueue failed; core order change preserved (%).',SQLSTATE;
 END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_med_v23_preparation_legacy_med_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.status AND NEW.end_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.end_date
 AND NEW.deleted_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.deleted_at THEN RETURN NEW;END IF;
 INSERT INTO public.medication_preparation_impacts(session_id,item_id,changed_order_version_id,reason)
 SELECT s.id,i.id,i.order_version_id,'Medication status, end date, or deletion changed; recheck prepared doses'
 FROM public.medication_preparation_items i JOIN public.medication_preparation_sessions s ON s.id=i.session_id
 WHERE i.person_medication_id=NEW.id AND s.status IN ('REVIEWED','PREPARING','PREPARED','RELEASED')
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 UPDATE public.medication_preparation_sessions s SET status='BLOCKED',last_action_by=NULL,updated_at=now()
 WHERE s.status IN ('REVIEWED','PREPARING','PREPARED','RELEASED')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.medication_preparation_items i WHERE i.session_id=s.id AND i.person_medication_id=NEW.id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.medication_preparation_impacts x WHERE x.session_id=s.id AND x.status='PENDING_REVIEW');
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_med_v23_preparation_order_impact()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.status NOT IN ('verified','superseded','cancelled') THEN RETURN NEW;END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NEW.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.status THEN RETURN NEW;END IF;
 INSERT INTO public.medication_preparation_impacts(session_id,item_id,changed_order_version_id,reason)
 SELECT s.id,i.id,NEW.id,
 CASE WHEN i.order_version_id=NEW.id THEN 'Prepared instruction withdrawn or changed status'
 ELSE 'Different medication order version activated; recheck already-prepared medication' END
 FROM public.medication_preparation_items i JOIN public.medication_preparation_sessions s ON s.id=i.session_id
 WHERE i.person_medication_id=NEW.person_medication_id
 AND (i.order_version_id<>NEW.id OR NEW.status IN ('superseded','cancelled'))
 AND s.status IN ('REVIEWED','PREPARING','PREPARED','RELEASED')
 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 UPDATE public.medication_preparation_sessions s SET status='BLOCKED',updated_at=now()
 WHERE s.status IN ('REVIEWED','PREPARING','PREPARED','RELEASED')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.medication_preparation_impacts x WHERE x.session_id=s.id AND x.changed_order_version_id=NEW.id AND x.status='PENDING_REVIEW');
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_med_v23_protect_order_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Order version deletion is forbidden'; END IF;
 IF OLD.person_medication_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.person_medication_id OR OLD.regimen_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.regimen_id
 OR OLD.version_no IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.version_no OR OLD.order_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.order_snapshot
 OR OLD.effective_from IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.effective_from OR OLD.effective_to IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.effective_to
 OR OLD.recorded_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.recorded_at
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Order snapshot is immutable; append new version'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_med_v23_protect_schedule_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Scheduled dose deletion forbidden; supersede or cancel';END IF;
 IF NEW.person_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.person_id OR
    NEW.person_medication_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.person_medication_id OR
    NEW.regimen_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.regimen_id OR
    NEW.order_version_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.order_version_id OR
    NEW.round_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.round_id OR
    NEW.slot_key IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.slot_key OR
    NEW.scheduled_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.scheduled_at OR
    NEW.planned_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.planned_date OR
    NEW.timezone IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.timezone OR
    NEW.planned_dose IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.planned_dose OR
    NEW.planned_unit IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.planned_unit OR
    NEW.order_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.order_snapshot OR
    NEW.occurrence_no IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.occurrence_no
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Scheduled dose snapshot immutable'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_med_v23_refill_detail(p_line_user_id text, p_appointment_id uuid)

 LANGUAGE plpgsql

BEGIN

 IF ctx.actor_user_id IS NULL OR ctx.active_family_id IS NULL OR ctx.target_person_id IS NULL
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'refill_permission_denied'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO apt FROM public.appointments a
 WHERE a.id=p_appointment_id AND a.family_id=ctx.active_family_id
 AND a.person_id=ctx.target_person_id AND a.appointment_type='medication_refill'
 AND a.deleted_at IS NULL;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'refill_not_found_or_denied'; END IF;
 SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'id',r.id,'person_medication_id',r.person_medication_id,
 'medication_id',COALESCE(r.medication_id,pm.medication_id),
 'expected_quantity',r.expected_quantity,'expected_unit',r.expected_unit,
 'received_quantity',r.received_quantity,'received_unit',r.received_unit,
 'status',r.status,'dispense_id',r.dispense_id,
 'notes',r.notes) ORDER BY r.created_at,r.id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO entries
 FROM public.medication_refill_items r
 LEFT JOIN public.person_medications pm ON pm.id=r.person_medication_id AND pm.person_id=apt.person_id
 WHERE r.appointment_id=apt.id AND
 (r.person_medication_id IS NULL OR pm.id IS NOT NULL);
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'appointment_id',apt.id,
 'person_id',apt.person_id,'appointment_at',apt.appointment_at,
 'hospital_name',apt.hospital_name,'location_detail',apt.location_detail,
 'status',apt.status,'preparation_notes',apt.preparation_notes,
 'items',entries);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_med_v23_refill_options(p_line_user_id text)

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'pg_temp'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_queue_daily_pending_request_digest()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_rec record;
  v_count integer:=0;
  v_day date:=(now() at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok')::date;
begin
  for v_rec in
    with pending as (
      select r.family_id,'line_group_review'::text kind,r.requested_at as started_at
      from public.line_group_link_requests r where r.status='pending'
      union all
      select r.family_id,'line_group_setup'::text,coalesce(r.reviewed_at,r.requested_at)
      from public.line_group_link_requests r
      join public.family_channels fc on fc.id=r.family_channel_id
      where r.status='approved' and fc.setup_completed_at is null
      union all
      select pr.family_id,'permission'::text,pr.created_at
      from public.permission_requests pr where pr.status='pending'
      union all
      select pr.family_id,'person_change'::text,pr.created_at
      from public.person_change_requests pr where pr.status='pending'
      union all
      select pr.family_id,'person_claim'::text,pr.created_at
      from public.person_claim_requests pr where pr.status='pending'
      union all
      select r.family_id,'household_request'::text,r.created_at
      from private.household_owner_transfer_requests r where r.status='pending'
      union all
      select r.family_id,'household_request'::text,r.created_at
      from private.household_admin_resignation_requests r where r.status='pending'
      union all
      select r.family_id,'household_request'::text,r.created_at
      from private.medical_primary_transfer_requests r where r.status='pending'
      union all
      select r.family_id,'household_request'::text,r.created_at
      from private.family_removal_requests r where r.status='pending'
    ),
    fam as (
      select family_id,
        count(*)::int total,
        count(*) filter(where kind='line_group_review')::int line_group_review,
        count(*) filter(where kind='line_group_setup')::int line_group_setup,
        count(*) filter(where kind='permission')::int permission_count,
        count(*) filter(where kind='person_change')::int person_change_count,
        count(*) filter(where kind='person_claim')::int person_claim_count,
        count(*) filter(where kind='household_request')::int household_request_count,
        max(greatest(0,floor(extract(epoch from (now()-started_at))/86400)))::int oldest_days
      from pending group by family_id
    )
    select
      fm.user_id recipient_user_id,
      f.id family_id,
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(f.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว') family_name,
      fam.*
    from fam
    join public.families f on f.id=fam.family_id
    join public.family_memberships fm on fm.family_id=fam.family_id and fm.status='active'
    where private.user_has_family_role(fm.user_id,fam.family_id,array['owner','admin'])
      and exists(
        select 1 from public.line_identities li
        where li.user_id=fm.user_id and li.is_active=true and li.onboarding_status='ready'
      )
  loop
    insert into public.notifications(
      family_id,recipient_user_id,event_type,title,message,
      channel,priority,status,scheduled_for,next_attempt_at,payload,dedupe_key,
      created_at,updated_at
    ) values(
      v_rec.family_id,v_rec.recipient_user_id,'daily_pending_request_digest',
      '📋 มีเรื่องรอตรวจสอบ '||v_rec.total::text||' เรื่อง',
      concat(
        '🏠 ',v_rec.family_name,E'\n',
        case when v_rec.line_group_review>0 then '• คำขอเชื่อม LINE กลุ่มรอตรวจสอบ '||v_rec.line_group_review::text||E'\n' else '' end,
        case when v_rec.line_group_setup>0 then '• LINE กลุ่มอนุมัติแล้ว รอตั้งค่าต่อ '||v_rec.line_group_setup::text||E'\n' else '' end,
        case when v_rec.permission_count>0 then '• คำขอสิทธิ์ '||v_rec.permission_count::text||E'\n' else '' end,
        case when v_rec.person_change_count>0 then '• คำขอแก้ข้อมูลบุคคล '||v_rec.person_change_count::text||E'\n' else '' end,
        case when v_rec.person_claim_count>0 then '• คำขอเชื่อมบุคคล '||v_rec.person_claim_count::text||E'\n' else '' end,
        case when v_rec.household_request_count>0 then '• คำขอจัดการบ้าน/ผู้ดูแล '||v_rec.household_request_count::text||E'\n' else '' end,
        'รอนานที่สุด ',v_rec.oldest_days::text,' วัน'
      ),
      'line','normal','pending',now(),now(),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'family_name',v_rec.family_name,
        'total',v_rec.total,
        'line_group_review',v_rec.line_group_review,
        'line_group_setup',v_rec.line_group_setup,
        'permission_count',v_rec.permission_count,
        'person_change_count',v_rec.person_change_count,
        'person_claim_count',v_rec.person_claim_count,
        'household_request_count',v_rec.household_request_count,
        'oldest_days',v_rec.oldest_days,
        'digest_date',v_day
      ),
      'daily-pending-requests:'||v_day::text||':'||v_rec.recipient_user_id::text||':'||v_rec.family_id::text,
      now(),now()
    )
    on conflict(dedupe_key) where dedupe_key is not null do nothing;
    if found then v_count:=v_count+1; end if;
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_record_line_group_seen(p_line_group_id text, p_channel_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_picture_url text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT 'pending_link'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_id uuid;
  v_status text:=case
    when lower(btrim(coalesce(p_status,''))) in ('pending_link','active','left','disabled')
      then lower(btrim(p_status))
    else 'pending_link'
  end;
begin
  if length(btrim(coalesce(p_line_group_id,'')))<8 then
    raise exception 'invalid_line_group_id';
  end if;

  insert into public.family_channels(
    family_id,channel_type,external_channel_id,channel_name,channel_picture_url,
    status,can_receive_notifications,can_query_bot,privacy_level,
    linked_at,created_at,updated_at,last_seen_at
  ) values(
    null,'line_group',btrim(p_line_group_id),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_channel_name,'')),''),
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_picture_url,'')),''),
    v_status,
    case when v_status='active' then true else false end,
    false,
    'summary',
    null,now(),now(),now()
  )
  on conflict(channel_type,external_channel_id) where external_channel_id is not null
  do update set
    channel_name=coalesce(excluded.channel_name,public.family_channels.channel_name),
    channel_picture_url=coalesce(excluded.channel_picture_url,public.family_channels.channel_picture_url),
    status=case
      when public.family_channels.status='active' and v_status='pending_link'
        then 'active'
      else v_status
    end,
    can_receive_notifications=case
      when public.family_channels.status='active' then public.family_channels.can_receive_notifications
      else excluded.can_receive_notifications
    end,
    can_query_bot=case
      when public.family_channels.status='active' then public.family_channels.can_query_bot
      else false
    end,
    last_seen_at=now(),
    updated_at=now()
  returning id into v_id;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'family_channel_id',v_id,'status',v_status);
end
$function$
