CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_resolve_line_appointment_clinician(p_line_user_id text, p_doctor_query text, p_hospital_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_department text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
 declare
  v_ctx record;
  v_q text;
  v_top record;
  v_top_count integer:=0;
 begin
  select * into v_ctx
  from private.phms_line_crud_context(p_line_user_id,'appointment','view')
  limit 1;

  v_q:=lower(regexp_replace(
    coalesce(p_doctor_query,''),
    '(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)',
    '',
    'g'
  ));

  if length(v_q)<2 then
    return jsonb_build_object('matched',false,'reason','doctor_query_too_short');
  end if;

  with candidates as (
    select
      a.doctor_name as display_name,
      null::uuid as clinician_id,
      a.hospital_name,
      a.department,
      'appointment_history'::text as source,
      greatest(
        case
          when lower(regexp_replace(a.doctor_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g'))=v_q then 100
          when lower(regexp_replace(a.doctor_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g')) like v_q||'%' then 85
          when lower(regexp_replace(a.doctor_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g')) like '%'||v_q||'%' then 70
          else 0
        end
        + case when nullif(btrim(p_hospital_name),'') is not null
                 and lower(coalesce(a.hospital_name,'')) like '%'||lower(btrim(p_hospital_name))||'%' then 8 else 0 end
        + case when nullif(btrim(p_department),'') is not null
                 and lower(coalesce(a.department,'')) like '%'||lower(btrim(p_department))||'%' then 8 else 0 end,
        0
      ) score,
      max(coalesce(a.updated_at,a.created_at)) last_seen
    from public.appointments a
    where a.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and a.deleted_at is null
      and nullif(btrim(a.doctor_name),'') is not null
      and lower(regexp_replace(a.doctor_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g')) like '%'||v_q||'%'
    group by a.doctor_name,a.hospital_name,a.department

    union all

    select
      c.display_name,c.id,null::text,c.specialty,'clinician_directory'::text,
      greatest(
        case
          when lower(regexp_replace(c.display_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g'))=v_q then 100
          when lower(regexp_replace(c.display_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g')) like v_q||'%' then 85
          when lower(regexp_replace(c.display_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g')) like '%'||v_q||'%' then 70
          else 0
        end
        + case when nullif(btrim(p_department),'') is not null
                 and lower(coalesce(c.specialty,'')) like '%'||lower(btrim(p_department))||'%' then 8 else 0 end,
        0
      ),
      c.updated_at
    from public.healthcare_clinicians c
    where c.deleted_at is null
      and lower(regexp_replace(c.display_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g')) like '%'||v_q||'%'
  ),
  ranked as (
    select *,dense_rank() over(order by score desc) score_rank
    from candidates
    where score>=70
  )
  select count(*) filter(where score_rank=1)
  into v_top_count
  from ranked;

  if v_top_count<>1 then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'matched',false,
      'reason',case when v_top_count>1 then 'ambiguous' else 'not_found' end,
      'top_match_count',v_top_count
    );
  end if;

  with candidates as (
    select
      a.doctor_name as display_name,
      null::uuid as clinician_id,
      a.hospital_name,
      a.department,
      'appointment_history'::text as source,
      greatest(
        case
          when lower(regexp_replace(a.doctor_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g'))=v_q then 100
          when lower(regexp_replace(a.doctor_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g')) like v_q||'%' then 85
          when lower(regexp_replace(a.doctor_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g')) like '%'||v_q||'%' then 70
          else 0
        end
        + case when nullif(btrim(p_hospital_name),'') is not null
                 and lower(coalesce(a.hospital_name,'')) like '%'||lower(btrim(p_hospital_name))||'%' then 8 else 0 end
        + case when nullif(btrim(p_department),'') is not null
                 and lower(coalesce(a.department,'')) like '%'||lower(btrim(p_department))||'%' then 8 else 0 end,
        0
      ) score,
      max(coalesce(a.updated_at,a.created_at)) last_seen
    from public.appointments a
    where a.person_id=v_ctx.target_person_id
      and a.deleted_at is null
      and nullif(btrim(a.doctor_name),'') is not null
      and lower(regexp_replace(a.doctor_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g')) like '%'||v_q||'%'
    group by a.doctor_name,a.hospital_name,a.department

    union all

    select
      c.display_name,c.id,null::text,c.specialty,'clinician_directory'::text,
      greatest(
        case
          when lower(regexp_replace(c.display_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g'))=v_q then 100
          when lower(regexp_replace(c.display_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g')) like v_q||'%' then 85
          when lower(regexp_replace(c.display_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g')) like '%'||v_q||'%' then 70
          else 0
        end
        + case when nullif(btrim(p_department),'') is not null
                 and lower(coalesce(c.specialty,'')) like '%'||lower(btrim(p_department))||'%' then 8 else 0 end,
        0
      ),
      c.updated_at
    from public.healthcare_clinicians c
    where c.deleted_at is null
      and lower(regexp_replace(c.display_name,'(นายแพทย์|แพทย์หญิง|นพ\.?|พญ\.?|หมอ|แพทย์|\s+)','','g')) like '%'||v_q||'%'
  )
  select * into v_top
  from candidates
  where score>=70
  order by score desc,last_seen desc nulls last
  limit 1;

  return jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'matched',true,
    'reason','unique_match',
    'doctor_name',v_top.display_name,
    'clinician_id',v_top.clinician_id,
    'hospital_name',v_top.hospital_name,
    'department',v_top.department,
    'source',v_top.source,
    'score',v_top.score
  ));
 end
 $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_resolve_line_appointment_facility_history(p_line_user_id text, p_hospital_query text, p_department_query text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_ctx private.line_identity_contexts%rowtype;
  v_query text:=nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_hospital_query,'')),'');
  v_qnorm text;
  v_dept text:=nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_department_query,'')),'');
  v_dnorm text;
  v_hit record;
begin
  if v_query is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('matched',false,'reason','hospital_query_empty');
  end if;

  select * into v_line
  from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);

  perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.line_identity_id,v_line.user_id);

  select * into v_ctx
  from private.line_identity_contexts
  where line_identity_id=v_line.line_identity_id;

  if v_ctx.active_family_id is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('matched',false,'reason','family_context_required');
  end if;

  v_qnorm:=regexp_replace(
    regexp_replace(lower(v_query),'^(โรงพยาบาล|รพ[.]?)[[:space:]]*','','i'),
    '[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g'
  );
  if v_dept is not null then
    v_dnorm:=lower(regexp_replace(private.phms_normalize_appointment_department(v_dept),'[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g'));
  end if;

  with src as (
    select
      a.id,
      a.hospital_name,
      a.department,
      a.doctor_name,
      a.organization_id,
      a.service_unit_id,
      a.clinician_id,
      a.location_detail,
      a.contact_phone,
      a.contact_email,
      a.arrival_lead_minutes,
      a.status,
      a.appointment_at,
      a.updated_at,
      regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(lower(btrim(split_part(a.hospital_name,'(',1))),
          '^(โรงพยาบาล|รพ[.]?)[[:space:]]*','','i'),
        '[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g'
      ) base_norm,
      case when position('(' in a.hospital_name)>0
        then lower(regexp_replace(
          btrim(split_part(split_part(a.hospital_name,'(',2),')',1)),
          '[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g'
        ))
        else ''
      end code_norm,
      regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(lower(a.hospital_name),
          '^(โรงพยาบาล|รพ[.]?)[[:space:]]*','','i'),
        '[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g'
      ) full_norm,
      lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(private.phms_normalize_appointment_department(a.department),''),'[^0-9a-zก-๙]+','','g')) dept_norm,
      (
        (case when nullif(btrim(a.department),'') is not null then 1 else 0 end) +
        (case when nullif(btrim(a.doctor_name),'') is not null then 1 else 0 end) +
        (case when nullif(btrim(a.location_detail),'') is not null then 1 else 0 end) +
        (case when nullif(btrim(a.contact_phone),'') is not null then 1 else 0 end) +
        (case when nullif(btrim(a.contact_email),'') is not null then 1 else 0 end) +
        (case when coalesce(a.arrival_lead_minutes,0)>0 then 1 else 0 end)
      ) completeness
    from public.appointments a
    join public.family_persons fp
      on fp.id=a.family_person_id
     and fp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
     and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    where a.deleted_at is null
      and nullif(btrim(a.hospital_name),'') is not null
      and private.user_can_access_family_person(
        v_line.user_id,fp.id,'appointments','view'
      )
  ),
  ranked as (
    select src.*,
      case
        when nullif(code_norm,'')=v_qnorm then 120
        when base_norm=v_qnorm then 110
        when full_norm=v_qnorm then 108
        when base_norm like v_qnorm||'%' then 95
        when v_qnorm like base_norm||'%' then 90
        else 0
      end hospital_score,
      case
        when v_dnorm is null or v_dnorm='' then 0
        when dept_norm=v_dnorm then 25
        when dept_norm like v_dnorm||'%' or v_dnorm like dept_norm||'%' then 15
        else 0
      end department_score,
      case
        when status in ('confirmed','completed') then 3
        when status='scheduled' then 2
        else 1
      end status_score
    from src
  )
  select * into v_hit
  from ranked
  where hospital_score>=90
  order by
    hospital_score desc,
    department_score desc,
    status_score desc,
    completeness desc,
    coalesce(updated_at,appointment_at) desc nulls last,
    id desc
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'matched',false,'source','family_hospital_memory','raw_name',v_query
    );
  end if;

  return jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'matched',true,
    'source','family_hospital_memory',
    'confidence',case when v_hit.hospital_score>=108 then 'exact' else 'prefix' end,
    'display_name',v_hit.hospital_name,
    'organization_id',v_hit.organization_id,
    'service_unit_id',v_hit.service_unit_id,
    'clinician_id',v_hit.clinician_id,
    'service_unit_name',v_hit.department,
    'doctor_name',v_hit.doctor_name,
    'contact_phone',v_hit.contact_phone,
    'contact_email',v_hit.contact_email,
    'location_detail',v_hit.location_detail,
    'arrival_lead_minutes',v_hit.arrival_lead_minutes,
    'master_source_appointment_id',v_hit.id,
    'master_last_used_at',coalesce(v_hit.updated_at,v_hit.appointment_at),
    'raw_name',v_query
  ));
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_resolve_line_command_context(p_line_user_id text, p_resource text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_action text DEFAULT 'view'::text, p_require_person boolean DEFAULT true, p_required_scope text DEFAULT 'any'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(line_identity_id uuid, user_id uuid, active_scope text, active_family_id uuid, active_family_person_id uuid, target_person_id uuid, target_person_name text, family_name text, context_valid boolean, context_ready boolean, permission_checked boolean, permission_granted boolean, resolution_code text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line public.line_identities%rowtype;
begin
  if p_line_user_id is null or btrim(p_line_user_id)='' then raise exception 'line_user_id_required'; end if;

  select * into v_line
  from public.line_identities
  where line_user_id=p_line_user_id and is_active=true
  order by updated_at desc nulls last,created_at desc
  limit 1;

  if not found then raise exception 'line_identity_not_found'; end if;
  if v_line.user_id is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_linked'; end if;

  return query
  select
    v_line.id,
    r.user_id,
    r.active_scope,
    r.active_family_id,
    r.active_family_person_id,
    r.target_person_id,
    case
      when r.target_person_id is null then null
      else private.person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,r.target_person_id)
    end,
    r.family_name,
    r.context_valid,
    r.context_ready,
    r.permission_checked,
    r.permission_granted,
    r.resolution_code
  from private.resolve_line_identity_command_context(
    v_line.id,v_line.user_id,p_resource,p_action,p_require_person,p_required_scope
  ) r;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_restart_line_intake_source(p_line_user_id text, p_source_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line public.line_identities%rowtype;
  v_old_source public.data_intake_sources%rowtype;
  v_old_session public.data_intake_sessions%rowtype;
  v_asset public.phms_storage_assets%rowtype;
  v_existing_source_id uuid;
  v_existing_session_id uuid;
  v_existing_session_status text;
  v_existing_storage_asset_id uuid;
  v_new_session_id uuid;
  v_new_source_id uuid;
begin
  if p_source_id is null then raise exception 'source_id_required'; end if;

  select * into v_line
  from public.line_identities
  where line_user_id=p_line_user_id
    and coalesce(is_active,false)=true
  limit 1;

  if not found or v_line.user_id is null then
    raise exception 'line_identity_not_linked';
  end if;

  select * into v_old_source
  from public.data_intake_sources
  where id=p_source_id
    and submitted_by=v_line.user_id
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'intake_source_not_found_or_not_owned';
  end if;

  select * into v_old_session
  from public.data_intake_sessions
  where id=v_old_source.session_id
    and submitted_by=v_line.user_id
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'intake_session_not_found_or_not_owned';
  end if;

  if v_old_session.status not in ('cancelled','rejected') then
    raise exception 'intake_session_not_restartable';
  end if;

  select s.id,s.session_id,ds.status,s.storage_asset_id
  into v_existing_source_id,v_existing_session_id,v_existing_session_status,v_existing_storage_asset_id
  from public.data_intake_sources s
  join public.data_intake_sessions ds on ds.id=s.session_id
  where s.submitted_by=v_line.user_id
    and s.source_metadata->>'restarted_from_source_id'=v_old_source.id::text
    and ds.status in ('collecting','extracted','classified','validated','review','failed')
  order by s.created_at desc
  limit 1;

  if found then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok',true,
      'idempotent_replay',true,
      'source_id',v_existing_source_id,
      'source_code',substr(v_existing_source_id::text,1,12),
      'session_id',v_existing_session_id,
      'session_status',v_existing_session_status,
      'restarted_from_source_id',v_old_source.id,
      'restarted_from_session_id',v_old_session.id,
      'storage_asset_id',v_existing_storage_asset_id,
      'canonical_commit',false
    );
  end if;

  if v_old_source.storage_asset_id is null then
    raise exception 'storage_asset_required';
  end if;

  select * into v_asset
  from public.phms_storage_assets
  where id=v_old_source.storage_asset_id
    and deleted_at is null;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'storage_asset_not_found';
  end if;

  insert into public.data_intake_sessions(
    submitted_by,person_id,family_id,family_person_id,
    channel,status,input_count,context_snapshot
  )
  values(
    v_old_session.submitted_by,
    v_old_session.person_id,
    v_old_session.family_id,
    v_old_session.family_person_id,
    'line',
    'collecting',
    1,
    coalesce(v_old_session.context_snapshot,'{}'::jsonb)
      || jsonb_build_object(
           'restarted_from_session_id',v_old_session.id,
           'restarted_from_source_id',v_old_source.id,
           'restarted_at',now()
         )
  )
  returning id into v_new_session_id;

  insert into public.data_intake_sources(
    session_id,submitted_by,source_kind,document_type,
    raw_text,classification_confidence,source_url,
    source_metadata,storage_asset_id,line_message_id
  )
  values(
    v_new_session_id,
    v_old_source.submitted_by,
    v_old_source.source_kind,
    'unknown',
    null,
    null,
    v_old_source.source_url,
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'restarted_from_source_id',v_old_source.id,
      'restarted_from_session_id',v_old_session.id,
      'storage_bucket',v_asset.bucket_id,
      'storage_path',v_asset.object_name,
      'mime_type',v_asset.mime_type,
      'byte_size',v_asset.byte_size,
      'checksum_sha256',v_asset.checksum_sha256,
      'original_filename',v_asset.original_filename,
      'storage_status','stored',
      'person_pending',v_old_session.person_id is null,
      'review_required',true,
      'auto_commit',false,
      'canonical_commit',false,
      'ingestion_stage','restarted_from_existing_asset',
      'restarted_at',now()
    )),
    v_old_source.storage_asset_id,
    null
  )
  returning id into v_new_source_id;

  insert into public.data_intake_actions(
    session_id,actor_user_id,action,after_data
  )
  values(
    v_new_session_id,
    v_line.user_id,
    'create',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source_id',v_new_source_id,
      'restarted_from_source_id',v_old_source.id,
      'restarted_from_session_id',v_old_session.id,
      'storage_asset_id',v_old_source.storage_asset_id,
      'canonical_commit',false
    )
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'idempotent_replay',false,
    'source_id',v_new_source_id,
    'source_code',substr(v_new_source_id::text,1,12),
    'session_id',v_new_session_id,
    'session_status','collecting',
    'restarted_from_source_id',v_old_source.id,
    'restarted_from_session_id',v_old_session.id,
    'storage_asset_id',v_old_source.storage_asset_id,
    'canonical_commit',false
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_review_line_group_link_request(p_line_user_id text, p_request_code text, p_decision text, p_review_note text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid;
  v_req public.line_group_link_requests%rowtype;
  v_channel public.family_channels%rowtype;
  v_family public.families%rowtype;
  v_code text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_request_code,'')));
  v_decision text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_decision,'')));
  v_count integer;
  v_requester_label text;
begin
  if v_decision not in ('approve','reject') then raise exception 'invalid_decision'; end if;

  select li.user_id into v_actor
  from public.line_identities li
  where li.line_user_id=p_line_user_id
    and li.is_active=true
    and li.onboarding_status='ready'
  order by li.updated_at desc nulls last,li.created_at desc
  limit 1;
  if v_actor is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_ready'; end if;

  select count(*) into v_count
  from public.line_group_link_requests r
  where r.status='pending'
    and lower(r.id::text) like v_code||'%';
  if v_count=0 then raise exception 'group_link_request_not_found_or_done'; end if;
  if v_count>1 then raise exception 'group_link_request_code_ambiguous'; end if;

  select * into v_req
  from public.line_group_link_requests r
  where r.status='pending'
    and lower(r.id::text) like v_code||'%'
  limit 1
  for update;

  if not private.user_has_family_role(v_actor,v_req.family_id,array['owner','admin']) then
    raise exception 'group_link_review_permission_denied';
  end if;

  select * into v_channel
  from public.family_channels
  where id=v_req.family_channel_id
  for update;

  if v_channel.status not in ('pending_link','active') then raise exception 'line_group_not_present'; end if;
  if v_channel.status='pending_link' and v_channel.last_completed_at is not null
     and exists(select 1 from public.family_channel_family_links l where l.family_channel_id=v_channel.id and l.status='active')
    then raise exception 'group_reconfirmation_required'; end if;

  select * into v_family
  from public.families
  where id=v_req.family_id;

  if v_decision='approve' then
    update public.family_channels
    set family_id=coalesce(family_id,v_req.family_id),
        status='active',
        can_receive_notifications=true,
        can_query_bot=coalesce(can_query_bot,false),
        privacy_level='summary',
        linked_by=coalesce(linked_by,v_actor),
        linked_at=coalesce(linked_at,now()),
        last_seen_at=now(),
        updated_at=now()
    where id=v_channel.id
    returning * into v_channel;

    insert into public.family_channel_family_links(
      family_channel_id,family_id,status,linked_by,linked_at,created_at,updated_at
    ) values(
      v_channel.id,v_req.family_id,'active',v_actor,now(),now(),now()
    )
    on conflict(family_channel_id,family_id)
    do update set
      status='active',
      linked_by=v_actor,
      linked_at=now(),
      updated_at=now();

    update public.line_group_link_requests
    set status='approved',
        reviewed_by=v_actor,
        reviewed_at=now(),
        review_note=nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_review_note,'')),''),
        updated_at=now()
    where id=v_req.id;

    update public.line_group_link_requests
    set status='cancelled',
        reviewed_by=v_actor,
        reviewed_at=now(),
        review_note='same_family_linked_by_other_request',
        updated_at=now()
    where family_channel_id=v_channel.id
      and family_id=v_req.family_id
      and id<>v_req.id
      and status='pending';

    update public.notifications
    set status='cancelled',
        last_error='request_already_reviewed',
        updated_at=now()
    where event_type='line_group_link_request'
      and related_record_id=v_req.id
      and status in ('pending','failed');

    v_requester_label:=private.family_user_label_for_viewer(
      v_req.requested_by,v_req.family_id,v_req.requested_by
    );

    insert into public.notifications(
      family_id,recipient_user_id,event_type,title,message,related_record_id,
      channel,priority,status,scheduled_for,next_attempt_at,payload,dedupe_key,
      created_at,updated_at
    ) values(
      v_req.family_id,v_req.requested_by,'line_group_link_request_result',
      '✅ เชื่อม LINE กลุ่มแล้ว',
      concat(
        'LINE กลุ่ม “',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_channel.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
        '” เชื่อมกับ ',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_family.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),' แล้ว'
      ),
      v_req.id,'line','normal','pending',now(),now(),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'decision','approved',
        'request_code',substr(v_req.id::text,1,12),
        'group_code',substr(v_channel.id::text,1,12),
        'group_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_channel.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
        'family_code',substr(v_family.id::text,1,12),
        'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_family.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว')
      ),
      'line-group-link-result:'||v_req.id::text||':approved',
      now(),now()
    )
    on conflict(dedupe_key) where dedupe_key is not null
    do update set
      title=excluded.title,message=excluded.message,payload=excluded.payload,
      status='pending',scheduled_for=now(),next_attempt_at=now(),
      last_error=null,updated_at=now();

    insert into public.audit_logs(
      family_id,actor_user_id,event_type,resource,record_id,new_data,description
    ) values(
      v_req.family_id,v_actor,'line_group_link_request_approved',
      'line_group_link_request',v_req.id,
      jsonb_build_object('family_channel_id',v_channel.id,'requested_by',v_req.requested_by),
      'เจ้าของบ้านหรือแอดมินอนุมัติคำขอเชื่อม LINE กลุ่มกับครอบครัว'
    );

    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok',true,'decision','approved',
      'request_code',substr(v_req.id::text,1,12),
      'group_code',substr(v_channel.id::text,1,12),
      'line_group_id',v_channel.external_channel_id,
      'group_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_channel.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
      'family_code',substr(v_family.id::text,1,12),
      'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_family.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว')
    );
  end if;

  update public.line_group_link_requests
  set status='rejected',
      reviewed_by=v_actor,
      reviewed_at=now(),
      review_note=nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_review_note,'')),''),
      updated_at=now()
  where id=v_req.id;

  update public.notifications
  set status='cancelled',
      last_error='request_already_reviewed',
      updated_at=now()
  where event_type='line_group_link_request'
    and related_record_id=v_req.id
    and status in ('pending','failed');

  insert into public.notifications(
    family_id,recipient_user_id,event_type,title,message,related_record_id,
    channel,priority,status,scheduled_for,next_attempt_at,payload,dedupe_key,
    created_at,updated_at
  ) values(
    v_req.family_id,v_req.requested_by,'line_group_link_request_result',
    '↩️ ยังไม่ได้เชื่อม LINE กลุ่ม',
    concat(
      'คำขอเชื่อม LINE กลุ่ม “',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_channel.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
      '” กับ ',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_family.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),' ยังไม่ได้รับอนุมัติ'
    ),
    v_req.id,'line','normal','pending',now(),now(),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'decision','rejected',
      'request_code',substr(v_req.id::text,1,12),
      'group_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_channel.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
      'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_family.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว'),
      'review_note',nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_review_note,'')),'')
    ),
    'line-group-link-result:'||v_req.id::text||':rejected',
    now(),now()
  )
  on conflict(dedupe_key) where dedupe_key is not null
  do update set
    title=excluded.title,message=excluded.message,payload=excluded.payload,
    status='pending',scheduled_for=now(),next_attempt_at=now(),
    last_error=null,updated_at=now();

  insert into public.audit_logs(
    family_id,actor_user_id,event_type,resource,record_id,new_data,description
  ) values(
    v_req.family_id,v_actor,'line_group_link_request_rejected',
    'line_group_link_request',v_req.id,
    jsonb_build_object('family_channel_id',v_channel.id,'requested_by',v_req.requested_by),
    'เจ้าของบ้านหรือแอดมินไม่อนุมัติคำขอเชื่อม LINE กลุ่ม'
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,'decision','rejected',
    'request_code',substr(v_req.id::text,1,12),
    'group_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_channel.channel_name),''),'LINE กลุ่ม'),
    'family_name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_family.family_name),''),'ครอบครัว')
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_revoke_family_permission(p_family_id uuid, p_target_user_id uuid, p_resource text, p_action text, p_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid;
begin

  v_actor := auth.uid();

  if v_actor is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required';
  end if;

  if not private.can_manage_permissions(p_family_id) then
    raise exception 'Insufficient permission';
  end if;

  -- Permission manager may not revoke permissions they themselves
  -- are not authorized to grant.
  if not private.is_family_owner(p_family_id)
     and not private.can_grant_permission(
       p_family_id,
       null,
       p_resource,
       p_action
     )
  then
    raise exception 'Cannot revoke permission outside your authority';
  end if;

  update public.family_permissions
  set
    can_view =
      case when p_action = 'view'
           then false else can_view end,

    can_create =
      case when p_action = 'create'
           then false else can_create end,

    can_update =
      case when p_action = 'update'
           then false else can_update end,

    can_delete =
      case when p_action = 'delete'
           then false else can_delete end,

    can_manage_permissions =
      case when p_action = 'manage_permissions'
           then false else can_manage_permissions end,

    updated_at = now()

  where family_id = p_family_id
    and user_id = p_target_user_id
    and resource = p_resource;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Family permission record not found';
  end if;

  insert into public.audit_logs (
    family_id,
    actor_user_id,
    target_user_id,
    event_type,
    resource,
    old_data,
    description,
    created_at
  )
  values (
    p_family_id,
    v_actor,
    p_target_user_id,
    'permission_revoked',
    p_resource,
    jsonb_build_object('action', p_action),
    coalesce(p_reason, 'Family permission revoked'),
    now()
  );

  perform private.notify_family_owners(
    p_family_id,
    'permission_revoked',
    'มีการถอนสิทธิ์',
    'มีการถอนสิทธิ์ระดับครอบครัว',
    null,
    null
  );

  return 'permission_revoked';

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_revoke_person_permission(p_family_id uuid, p_family_person_id uuid, p_target_user_id uuid, p_resource text, p_action text, p_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid;
begin

  v_actor := auth.uid();

  if v_actor is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required';
  end if;

  if not private.phms_can_manage_medical_grants(v_actor,p_family_person_id) then
    raise exception 'Insufficient permission';
  end if;

  if not exists(select 1 from public.family_persons fp where fp.id=p_family_person_id and fp.family_id=p_family_id) then
    raise exception 'family_scope_mismatch';
  end if;

  update public.person_permissions
  set
    can_view =
      case when p_action = 'view'
           then false else can_view end,

    can_create =
      case when p_action = 'create'
           then false else can_create end,

    can_update =
      case when p_action = 'update'
           then false else can_update end,

    can_delete =
      case when p_action = 'delete'
           then false else can_delete end,

    can_receive_notifications =
      case when p_action = 'receive_notifications'
           then false else can_receive_notifications end,

    updated_at = now()

  where family_id = p_family_id
    and family_person_id = p_family_person_id
    and user_id = p_target_user_id
    and resource = p_resource
    and status = 'active';

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Person permission record not found';
  end if;

  insert into public.audit_logs (
    family_id,
    actor_user_id,
    target_user_id,
    family_person_id,
    event_type,
    resource,
    old_data,
    description,
    created_at
  )
  values (
    p_family_id,
    v_actor,
    p_target_user_id,
    p_family_person_id,
    'person_permission_revoked',
    p_resource,
    jsonb_build_object('action', p_action),
    coalesce(p_reason, 'Person permission revoked'),
    now()
  );

  perform private.notify_family_owners(
    p_family_id,
    'person_permission_revoked',
    'มีการเปลี่ยนแปลงสิทธิ์ผู้ดูแล',
    'มีการถอนสิทธิ์ที่เกี่ยวข้องกับบุคคลในครอบครัว',
    null,
    null
  );

  return 'person_permission_revoked';

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_select_line_person_setup_draft(p_line_user_id text, p_person_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ref record;
  v_p public.persons%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_ref
  from private.resolve_line_family_person_code(p_line_user_id,p_person_code)
  limit 1;

  if not private.can_manage_family_person_setup(v_ref.actor_user_id,v_ref.family_person_id) then
    raise exception 'draft_setup_denied';
  end if;

  update private.line_identity_contexts
  set active_scope='family',
      active_family_id=v_ref.family_id,
      active_family_person_id=v_ref.family_person_id,
      context_changed_at=now(),
      updated_at=now()

  select p.* into v_p
  from public.family_persons fp
  join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'status','ok',
    'person_code',lower(btrim(p_person_code)),
    'family_person_id',v_ref.family_person_id,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_set_family_context(p_family_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, active_scope text, active_family_id uuid, active_family_person_id uuid, family_name text, family_status text, membership_status text, context_ready boolean, context_changed_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_family_name text;
  v_family_status text;
  v_membership_status text;
begin
  if v_uid is null then
    raise exception 'authentication_required';
  end if;

  if p_family_id is null then
    raise exception 'family_id_required';
  end if;

  select f.family_name, f.status, fm.status
    into v_family_name, v_family_status, v_membership_status
    from public.families f
    join public.family_memberships fm
      on fm.family_id = f.id
     and fm.user_id = v_uid
   where f.id = p_family_id
   limit 1;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'family_not_accessible';
  end if;

  if coalesce(v_family_status, '') <> 'active' then
    raise exception 'family_inactive';
  end if;

  if coalesce(v_membership_status, '') <> 'active' then
    raise exception 'family_membership_inactive';
  end if;

  insert into public.user_contexts(
    user_id,
    active_scope,
    active_family_id,
    active_family_person_id,
    context_changed_at
  )
  values(v_uid, 'family', p_family_id, null, now())
  on conflict on constraint user_contexts_pkey do update
    set active_scope = 'family',
        active_family_id = excluded.active_family_id,
        active_family_person_id = null,
        context_changed_at = case
          when public.user_contexts.active_scope is distinct from 'family'
            or public.user_contexts.active_family_id is distinct from excluded.active_family_id
            or public.user_contexts.active_family_person_id is not null
          then now()
          else public.user_contexts.context_changed_at
        end,
        updated_at = now();

  return query
  select uc.user_id,
         uc.active_scope,
         uc.active_family_id,
         uc.active_family_person_id,
         v_family_name,
         v_family_status,
         v_membership_status,
         true,
         uc.context_changed_at
    from public.user_contexts uc
   where uc.user_id = v_uid;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_set_line_person_display_preference(p_line_user_id text, p_person_code text, p_action text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_ref record;
  v_action text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_action,'')));
  v_current int;
  v_neighbor int;
  v_pinned boolean;
begin
  if v_action not in ('pin','unpin','move_up','move_down') then raise exception 'invalid_display_preference_action'; end if;
  select * into v_line from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
  select * into v_ref from private.resolve_line_family_person_code(p_line_user_id,p_person_code) limit 1;

  insert into public.person_context_usage(user_id,family_person_id,use_count,first_used_at,last_used_at,is_pinned)
  values(v_line.user_id,v_ref.family_person_id,0,now(),now(),false)
  on conflict(user_id,family_person_id) do nothing;

  if v_action='pin' then
    update public.person_context_usage set is_pinned=true where user_id=v_line.user_id and family_person_id=v_ref.family_person_id;
  elsif v_action='unpin' then
    update public.person_context_usage set is_pinned=false where user_id=v_line.user_id and family_person_id=v_ref.family_person_id;
  else
    insert into public.person_context_usage(user_id,family_person_id,use_count,first_used_at,last_used_at,is_pinned)
    select v_line.user_id,fp.id,0,now(),now(),false
    from public.family_persons fp
    join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
    where fp.family_id=v_ref.family_id
      and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
      and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
    on conflict(user_id,family_person_id) do nothing;

    with ordered as (
      select pu.family_person_id,
             row_number() over (
               order by
                 coalesce(p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id,false) desc,
                 pu.is_pinned desc,
                 pu.display_order nulls last,
                 pu.use_count desc,
                 pu.last_used_at desc nulls last,
                 lower(private.family_person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,fp.id)),
                 fp.id
             )::int rn
      from public.person_context_usage pu
      join public.family_persons fp on fp.id=pu.family_person_id
      join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
      where pu.user_id=v_line.user_id
        and fp.family_id=v_ref.family_id
        and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
        and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
    )
    update public.person_context_usage pu
    set display_order=o.rn
    from ordered o
    where pu.user_id=v_line.user_id and pu.family_person_id=o.family_person_id;

    select display_order,is_pinned into v_current,v_pinned
    from public.person_context_usage
    where user_id=v_line.user_id and family_person_id=v_ref.family_person_id;

    if v_action='move_up' then
      select max(pu.display_order) into v_neighbor
      from public.person_context_usage pu
      join public.family_persons fp on fp.id=pu.family_person_id
      join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
      where pu.user_id=v_line.user_id
        and fp.family_id=v_ref.family_id
        and pu.is_pinned=v_pinned
        and pu.display_order<v_current
        and coalesce(p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id,false)=false;
    else
      select min(pu.display_order) into v_neighbor
      from public.person_context_usage pu
      join public.family_persons fp on fp.id=pu.family_person_id
      join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
      where pu.user_id=v_line.user_id
        and fp.family_id=v_ref.family_id
        and pu.is_pinned=v_pinned
        and pu.display_order>v_current
        and coalesce(p.linked_user_id=v_line.user_id,false)=false;
    end if;

    if v_neighbor is not null then
      update public.person_context_usage
      set display_order=case
        when family_person_id=v_ref.family_person_id then v_neighbor
        when display_order=v_neighbor then v_current
        else display_order
      end
      where user_id=v_line.user_id
        and (family_person_id=v_ref.family_person_id or display_order=v_neighbor);
    end if;
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'person_code',lower(btrim(p_person_code)),'action',v_action);
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_set_line_person_self_access(p_line_user_id text, p_person_code text, p_mode text, p_resource text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_action text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_enabled boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor record;
  v_person record;
  v_mode text:=lower(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_mode),''),''));
  v_resource text:=lower(nullif(btrim(p_resource),''));
  v_action text:=lower(nullif(btrim(p_action),''));
  v_linked uuid;
begin
  select * into v_actor from private.resolve_line_user_for_service(p_line_user_id);
  select * into v_person from private.resolve_line_family_person_code(p_line_user_id,p_person_code);
  perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',v_actor.user_id::text,true);

  if not (
    private.is_family_owner(v_person.family_id)
    or private.can_grant_permission(v_person.family_id,v_person.family_person_id,'persons','update')
    or (
      v_mode='view_only'
      and exists(
        select 1
        from public.family_persons fp
        join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
        where fp.id=v_person.family_person_id
          and fp.family_id=v_person.family_id
          and p.linked_user_id=v_actor.user_id
          and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
          and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
      )
    )
  ) then raise exception 'self_access_management_denied'; end if;

  insert into public.person_self_access(
    family_person_id,family_id,
    can_view_profile,can_update_profile,
    can_view_medications,can_create_medications,can_update_medications,can_delete_medications,
    can_view_appointments,can_create_appointments,can_update_appointments,can_delete_appointments,
    can_view_health,can_create_health,can_update_health,can_delete_health,
    configured_by,created_at,updated_at
  )
  values(
    v_person.family_person_id,v_person.family_id,
    true,false,
    true,false,false,false,
    true,false,false,false,
    true,false,false,false,
    v_actor.user_id,now(),now()
  )
  on conflict(family_person_id) do nothing;

  select p.linked_user_id into v_linked
  from public.family_persons fp
  join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
  where fp.id=v_person.family_person_id
    and fp.family_id=v_person.family_id
    and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
    and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
  limit 1;

  if v_mode='view_only' then
    update public.person_self_access set
      can_view_profile=true,can_update_profile=false,
      can_view_medications=true,can_create_medications=false,can_update_medications=false,can_delete_medications=false,
      can_view_appointments=true,can_create_appointments=false,can_update_appointments=false,can_delete_appointments=false,
      can_view_health=true,can_create_health=false,can_update_health=false,can_delete_health=false,
      can_view_documents=true,can_create_documents=false,can_update_documents=false,can_delete_documents=false,
      can_view_expenses=true,can_create_expenses=false,can_update_expenses=false,can_delete_expenses=false,
      configured_by=v_actor.user_id,updated_at=now()
    where family_person_id=v_person.family_person_id;

  elsif v_mode='self_manage' then
    update public.person_self_access set
      can_view_profile=true,can_update_profile=true,
      can_view_medications=true,can_create_medications=true,can_update_medications=true,can_delete_medications=false,
      can_view_appointments=true,can_create_appointments=true,can_update_appointments=true,can_delete_appointments=false,
      can_view_health=true,can_create_health=true,can_update_health=true,can_delete_health=false,
      can_view_documents=true,can_create_documents=true,can_update_documents=true,can_delete_documents=false,
      can_view_expenses=true,can_create_expenses=true,can_update_expenses=true,can_delete_expenses=false,
      configured_by=v_actor.user_id,updated_at=now()
    where family_person_id=v_person.family_person_id;

  elsif v_mode='custom' then
    if v_resource not in ('persons','medications','appointments','health_data','documents','expenses')
       or v_action not in ('view','create','update','delete')
       or p_enabled is null then
      raise exception 'invalid_self_access_custom';
    end if;

    update public.person_self_access s set
      can_view_profile=case when v_resource='persons' and v_action='view' then p_enabled else s.can_view_profile end,
      can_update_profile=case when v_resource='persons' and v_action='update' then p_enabled else s.can_update_profile end,
      can_view_medications=case when v_resource='medications' and v_action='view' then p_enabled else s.can_view_medications end,
      can_create_medications=case when v_resource='medications' and v_action='create' then p_enabled else s.can_create_medications end,
      can_update_medications=case when v_resource='medications' and v_action='update' then p_enabled else s.can_update_medications end,
      can_delete_medications=case when v_resource='medications' and v_action='delete' then p_enabled else s.can_delete_medications end,
      can_view_appointments=case when v_resource='appointments' and v_action='view' then p_enabled else s.can_view_appointments end,
      can_create_appointments=case when v_resource='appointments' and v_action='create' then p_enabled else s.can_create_appointments end,
      can_update_appointments=case when v_resource='appointments' and v_action='update' then p_enabled else s.can_update_appointments end,
      can_delete_appointments=case when v_resource='appointments' and v_action='delete' then p_enabled else s.can_delete_appointments end,
      can_view_health=case when v_resource='health_data' and v_action='view' then p_enabled else s.can_view_health end,
      can_create_health=case when v_resource='health_data' and v_action='create' then p_enabled else s.can_create_health end,
      can_update_health=case when v_resource='health_data' and v_action='update' then p_enabled else s.can_update_health end,
      can_delete_health=case when v_resource='health_data' and v_action='delete' then p_enabled else s.can_delete_health end,
      can_view_documents=case when v_resource='documents' and v_action='view' then p_enabled else s.can_view_documents end,
      can_create_documents=case when v_resource='documents' and v_action='create' then p_enabled else s.can_create_documents end,
      can_update_documents=case when v_resource='documents' and v_action='update' then p_enabled else s.can_update_documents end,
      can_delete_documents=case when v_resource='documents' and v_action='delete' then p_enabled else s.can_delete_documents end,
      can_view_expenses=case when v_resource='expenses' and v_action='view' then p_enabled else s.can_view_expenses end,
      can_create_expenses=case when v_resource='expenses' and v_action='create' then p_enabled else s.can_create_expenses end,
      can_update_expenses=case when v_resource='expenses' and v_action='update' then p_enabled else s.can_update_expenses end,
      can_delete_expenses=case when v_resource='expenses' and v_action='delete' then p_enabled else s.can_delete_expenses end,
      configured_by=v_actor.user_id,updated_at=now()
    where s.family_person_id=v_person.family_person_id;
  else
    raise exception 'invalid_self_access_mode';
  end if;

  insert into public.audit_logs(
    family_id,actor_user_id,target_user_id,family_person_id,
    event_type,resource,new_data,description,created_at
  )
  values(
    v_person.family_id,v_actor.user_id,v_linked,v_person.family_person_id,
    'person_self_access_updated','persons',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'mode',v_mode,'resource',v_resource,'action',v_action,'enabled',p_enabled,
      'account_linked',v_linked is not null
    ),
    'Updated self access policy independently from caregiver role',
    now()
  );

  return (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'status','ok',
      'person_code',lower(btrim(p_person_code)),
      'mode',v_mode,
      'account_linked',v_linked is not null,
      'preconfigured',v_linked is null,
      'settings',jsonb_build_object(
        'profile',jsonb_build_object('view',s.can_view_profile,'update',s.can_update_profile),
        'medications',jsonb_build_object('view',s.can_view_medications,'create',s.can_create_medications,'update',s.can_update_medications,'delete',s.can_delete_medications),
        'appointments',jsonb_build_object('view',s.can_view_appointments,'create',s.can_create_appointments,'update',s.can_update_appointments,'delete',s.can_delete_appointments),
        'health_data',jsonb_build_object('view',s.can_view_health,'create',s.can_create_health,'update',s.can_update_health,'delete',s.can_delete_health),
        'documents',jsonb_build_object('view',s.can_view_documents,'create',s.can_create_documents,'update',s.can_update_documents,'delete',s.can_delete_documents),
        'expenses',jsonb_build_object('view',s.can_view_expenses,'create',s.can_create_expenses,'update',s.can_update_expenses,'delete',s.can_delete_expenses)
      )
    )
    from public.person_self_access s
    where s.family_person_id=v_person.family_person_id
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_set_line_personal_context(p_line_user_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, active_scope text, active_family_id uuid, active_family_person_id uuid, self_person_id uuid, self_person_name text, context_ready boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line public.line_identities%rowtype;
  v_person public.persons%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_line
  from public.line_identities
  where line_user_id=p_line_user_id and is_active=true
  order by updated_at desc nulls last,created_at desc
  limit 1;

  if not found then raise exception 'line_identity_not_found'; end if;
  if v_line.user_id is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_linked'; end if;

  perform private.ensure_line_identity_context(v_line.id,v_line.user_id);

  update private.line_identity_contexts c
  set active_scope='personal',
      active_family_id=null,
      active_family_person_id=null,
      context_changed_at=case
        when c.active_scope is distinct from 'personal'
          or c.active_family_id is not null
          or c.active_family_person_id is not null
        then now() else c.context_changed_at end,
      updated_at=now()
  where c.line_identity_id=v_line.id;

  select * into v_person
  from public.persons
  where linked_user_id=v_line.user_id and coalesce(status,'active')='active'
  order by created_at,id
  limit 1;

  return query
  select
    v_line.user_id,
    'personal'::text,
    null::uuid,
    null::uuid,
    v_person.id,
    case when v_person.id is null then null
         else private.person_label_for_viewer(v_line.user_id,v_person.id) end,
    v_person.id is not null;
end
$function$

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_set_personal_context()
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, active_scope text, active_family_id uuid, active_family_person_id uuid, self_person_id uuid, self_person_status text, context_ready boolean, context_changed_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if v_uid is null then
    raise exception 'authentication_required';
  end if;

  if not exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = v_uid) then
    raise exception 'profile_not_found';
  end if;

  insert into public.user_contexts(user_id, active_scope, active_family_id, active_family_person_id, context_changed_at)
  values(v_uid, 'personal', null, null, now())
  on conflict on constraint user_contexts_pkey do update
    set active_scope = 'personal',
        active_family_id = null,
        active_family_person_id = null,
        context_changed_at = case
          when public.user_contexts.active_scope is distinct from 'personal'
            or public.user_contexts.active_family_id is not null
            or public.user_contexts.active_family_person_id is not null
          then now()
          else public.user_contexts.context_changed_at
        end,
        updated_at = now();

  return query
  select uc.user_id,
         uc.active_scope,
         uc.active_family_id,
         uc.active_family_person_id,
         p.id as self_person_id,
         p.status as self_person_status,
         (p.id is not null and p.status = 'active') as context_ready,
         uc.context_changed_at
    from public.user_contexts uc
    left join public.persons p on p.linked_user_id = uc.user_id
   where uc.user_id = v_uid
   limit 1;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_set_real_data_pilot_status(p_family_id uuid, p_status text, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_old private.phms_real_data_pilot_families%rowtype;
  v_new private.phms_real_data_pilot_families%rowtype;
  v_status text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_status,'')));
  v_cancelled integer:=0;
begin
  if v_status not in ('active','paused','completed') then
    raise exception 'invalid_pilot_status';
  end if;

  select * into v_old
  from private.phms_real_data_pilot_families
  where family_id=p_family_id
  for update;

  if not found then raise exception 'pilot_family_not_found'; end if;

  update private.phms_real_data_pilot_families
  set status=v_status,
      updated_at=now(),
      metadata=coalesce(metadata,'{}'::jsonb)
        || jsonb_build_object(
             'last_status_reason',nullif(btrim(p_reason),''),
             'last_status_changed_at',now(),
             'last_status_changed_by',p_actor_user_id
           )
  where family_id=p_family_id
  returning * into v_new;

  if v_status in ('paused','completed') then
    update public.notifications n
    set status='cancelled',
        last_error='real_data_pilot_'||v_status,
        next_attempt_at=null,
        locked_at=null,
        lock_token=null,
        updated_at=now()
    where n.status in ('pending','failed','sending')
      and n.person_id in (
        select fp.person_id
        from public.family_persons fp
        where fp.family_id=p_family_id
      );

    get diagnostics v_cancelled=row_count;

    update public.appointment_reminders ar
    set status='cancelled',
        updated_at=now()
    where ar.status in ('pending','failed')
      and ar.appointment_id in (
        select a.id
        from public.appointments a
        join public.family_persons fp on fp.person_id=a.person_id
        where fp.family_id=p_family_id
      );
  end if;

  insert into public.audit_logs(
    family_id,actor_user_id,event_type,resource,record_id,
    old_data,new_data,description
  )
  values(
    p_family_id,p_actor_user_id,
    'real_data_pilot_status_changed',
    'real_data_pilot',
    p_family_id,
    to_jsonb(v_old),
    to_jsonb(v_new),
    coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_reason),''),'Real-data pilot status changed')
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'family_id',p_family_id,
    'old_status',v_old.status,
    'status',v_new.status,
    'notifications_cancelled',v_cancelled,
    'ends_at',v_new.ends_at
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_start_line_medical_intake(p_line_user_id text, p_line_message_id text, p_source_kind text DEFAULT 'image'::text, p_source_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  v_line public.line_identities%rowtype;
  v_ctx record;
  v_person_id uuid;
  v_family_person_id uuid;
  v_session_id uuid;
  v_source_id uuid;
  v_label text;
  v_existing record;
begin
  if p_line_user_id is null or btrim(p_line_user_id)='' then
    raise exception 'line_user_id_required';
  end if;
  if p_line_message_id is null or btrim(p_line_message_id)='' then
    raise exception 'line_message_id_required';
  end if;
  if coalesce(nullif(p_source_kind,''),'image') not in ('image','document') then
    raise exception 'unsupported_line_intake_source_kind';
  end if;

  -- LINE may redeliver the same webhook. Reuse the original source/session.
  select
    s.id as source_id,
    s.session_id,
    s.storage_asset_id,
    ds.person_id,
    ds.family_id,
    ds.family_person_id,
    ds.context_snapshot
  into v_existing
  from public.data_intake_sources s
  join public.data_intake_sessions ds on ds.id=s.session_id
  where s.line_message_id=p_line_message_id
  limit 1;

  if found then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok',true,
      'idempotent_replay',true,
      'session_id',v_existing.session_id,
      'source_id',v_existing.source_id,
      'storage_asset_id',v_existing.storage_asset_id,
      'person_id',v_existing.person_id,
      'person_label',v_existing.context_snapshot->>'person_label',
      'person_required',v_existing.person_id is null,
      'active_scope',v_existing.context_snapshot->>'active_scope',
      'family_id',v_existing.family_id
    );
  end if;

  select * into v_line
  from public.line_identities
  where line_user_id=p_line_user_id
  limit 1;

  if not found then raise exception 'line_identity_not_found'; end if;
  if coalesce(v_line.is_active,false) is not true then raise exception 'active_line_identity_required'; end if;
  if v_line.user_id is null then raise exception 'line_identity_not_linked'; end if;

  select * into v_ctx
  from public.phms_get_line_context_state(p_line_user_id)
  limit 1;

  if v_ctx.active_scope='personal' then
    select id,display_name
      into v_person_id,v_label
    from public.persons
    where linked_user_id=v_line.user_id
      and coalesce(status,'active')='active'
    limit 1;
  elsif v_ctx.active_scope='family' and v_ctx.active_family_person_id is not null then
    select fp.person_id,fp.id,p.display_name
      into v_person_id,v_family_person_id,v_label
    from public.family_persons fp
    join public.persons p on p.id=fp.person_id
    where fp.id=v_ctx.active_family_person_id
      and fp.family_id=v_ctx.active_family_id
      and coalesce(fp.status,'active')='active'
      and coalesce(p.status,'active')='active'
    limit 1;
  end if;

  insert into public.data_intake_sessions(
    submitted_by,person_id,family_id,family_person_id,
    channel,status,input_count,context_snapshot
  )
  values(
    v_line.user_id,v_person_id,v_ctx.active_family_id,v_family_person_id,
    'line','collecting',1,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'line_user_id',p_line_user_id,
      'line_message_id',p_line_message_id,
      'active_scope',v_ctx.active_scope,
      'family_name',v_ctx.family_name,
      'person_label',coalesce(v_label,v_ctx.family_person_name),
      'person_pending',v_person_id is null
    )
  )
  returning id into v_session_id;

  insert into public.data_intake_sources(
    session_id,submitted_by,source_kind,document_type,
    source_metadata,line_message_id
  )
  values(
    v_session_id,
    v_line.user_id,
    coalesce(nullif(p_source_kind,''),'image'),
    'unknown',
    coalesce(p_source_metadata,'{}'::jsonb)
      || jsonb_build_object(
          'line_message_id',p_line_message_id,
          'person_pending',v_person_id is null
         ),
    p_line_message_id
  )
  returning id into v_source_id;

  insert into public.data_intake_actions(session_id,actor_user_id,action,after_data)
  values(
    v_session_id,
    v_line.user_id,
    'create',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source_id',v_source_id,
      'person_id',v_person_id,
      'person_pending',v_person_id is null,
      'line_message_id',p_line_message_id
    )
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok',true,
    'idempotent_replay',false,
    'session_id',v_session_id,
    'source_id',v_source_id,
    'storage_asset_id',null,
    'person_id',v_person_id,
    'person_label',coalesce(v_label,v_ctx.family_person_name),
    'person_required',v_person_id is null,
    'active_scope',v_ctx.active_scope,
    'family_id',v_ctx.active_family_id
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_touch_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ begin new.updated_at=now(); return new; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phms_upsert_line_rich_menu_config(p_key text, p_rich_menu_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.line_rich_menu_configs(key, rich_menu_id, status, updated_at)
  values (p_key, p_rich_menu_id, 'active', now())
  on conflict (key) do update
  set rich_menu_id = excluded.rich_menu_id,
      status = 'active',
      updated_at = now();
end;
$function$
